    export interface ServiceDraft {
      readonly id: string;
      readonly name: string;
      readonly opens: string | null;
      readonly lastSeating: string | null;
      readonly closes: string | null;
      /** While true, last seating follows close minus {@link LAST_SEATING_LEAD_MINUTES}. */
      readonly lastSeatingLinked: boolean;
    }
    export interface QuickSetupDraft {
      readonly services: readonly ServiceDraft[];
      /** Stored weekday indexes, 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. */
      readonly days: readonly number[];
    }
    export const LAST_SEATING_LEAD_MINUTES = 45;
    export const SERVICE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH = 40;
    export const WEEK_DISPLAY_ORDER: readonly number[] = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 0];
    export const WEEKDAY_SHORTCUT: readonly number[] = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
    export const WEEKEND_SHORTCUT: readonly number[] = [6, 0];
    export const SERVICE_PRESETS = {
      lunch: { opens: "11:30", closes: "14:30" },
      brunch: { opens: "10:00", closes: "14:00" },
      dinner: { opens: "17:00", closes: "22:00" },
      late: { opens: "22:00", closes: "01:00" },
    } as const;
    export type ServicePresetId = keyof typeof SERVICE_PRESETS;
    export const SERVICE_PRESET_IDS = Object.keys(SERVICE_PRESETS) as ServicePresetId[];
    export function emptyService(id: string): ServiceDraft {
      return { id, name: "", opens: null, lastSeating: null, closes: null, lastSeatingLinked: true };
    }
    export function emptyDraft(firstServiceId: string): QuickSetupDraft {
      return { services: [emptyService(firstServiceId)], days: [] };
    }
    function toMinutes(hhmm: string): number {
      const [h = 0, m = 0] = hhmm.split(":").map(Number);
      return h * 60 + m;
    }
    export function toClock(minutes: number): string {
      const wrapped = ((minutes % MINUTES_PER_DAY) + MINUTES_PER_DAY) % MINUTES_PER_DAY;
      const hh = String(Math.floor(wrapped / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
      const mm = String(wrapped % 60).padStart(2, "0");
      return `${hh}:${mm}`;
    }
    export function autoLastSeating(closes: string): string {
      return toClock(toMinutes(closes) - LAST_SEATING_LEAD_MINUTES);
    }
    export function applyPreset(service: ServiceDraft, preset: ServicePresetId, name: string) {
      const { opens, closes } = SERVICE_PRESETS[preset];
      return {
        ...service,
        name,
        opens,
        closes,
        lastSeating: autoLastSeating(closes),
        lastSeatingLinked: true,
      };
    }
    export function setServiceTime(
      service: ServiceDraft,
      field: "opens" | "lastSeating" | "closes",
      value: string | null
    ): ServiceDraft {
      if (field === "lastSeating") return { ...service, lastSeating: value, lastSeatingLinked: false };
      if (field === "closes" && service.lastSeatingLinked) {
        return {
          ...service,
          closes: value,
          lastSeating: value === null ? null : autoLastSeating(value),
        };
      }
      return { ...service, [field]: value };
    }
    export function replaceService(draft: QuickSetupDraft, next: ServiceDraft): QuickSetupDraft {
      return { ...draft, services: draft.services.map((s) => (s.id === next.id ? next : s)) };
    }
    export function toggleDay(draft: QuickSetupDraft, day: number): QuickSetupDraft {
      const days = draft.days.includes(day)
        ? draft.days.filter((d) => d !== day)
        : [...draft.days, day];
      return { ...draft, days };
    }
    export type QuickSetupField = "name" | "opens" | "lastSeating" | "closes";
    export type QuickSetupIssueCode =
      | "name_required"
      | "name_too_long"
      | "time_required"
      | "close_after_open"
      | "last_seating_after_close"
      | "span_too_long"
      | "overlap"
      | "days_required";
    export interface QuickSetupIssue {
      /** `null` for the whole card (days). */
      readonly serviceId: string | null;
      readonly field: QuickSetupField | "days";
      readonly code: QuickSetupIssueCode;
    }
    interface ServiceMinutes {
      readonly opensAt: number;
      readonly lastSeatingAt: number;
      readonly closesAt: number;
    }
    function minutesOf(service: ServiceDraft): ServiceMinutes | null {
      if (service.opens === null || service.lastSeating === null || service.closes === null)
        return null;
      const opensAt = toMinutes(service.opens);
      const afterOpen = (hhmm: string, strict: boolean) => {
        const m = toMinutes(hhmm);
        return strict
          ? m <= opensAt
            ? m + MINUTES_PER_DAY
            : m
          : m < opensAt
            ? m + MINUTES_PER_DAY
            : m;
      };
      return {
        opensAt,
        closesAt: afterOpen(service.closes, true),
        lastSeatingAt: afterOpen(service.lastSeating, false),
      };
    }
    function completenessIssues(service: ServiceDraft): QuickSetupIssue[] {
      const missing = TIME_FIELDS.filter(([key]) => service[key] === null).map(
        ([, field]): QuickSetupIssue => ({
          serviceId: service.id,
          field,
          code: "time_required",
        })
      );
      const name = service.name.trim();
      const unnamed: QuickSetupIssue[] =
        name === ""
          ? [{ serviceId: service.id, field: "name", code: "name_required" }]
          : name.length > SERVICE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH
            ? [{ serviceId: service.id, field: "name", code: "name_too_long" }]
            : [];
      return [...unnamed, ...missing];
    }
    function orderIssues(service: ServiceDraft, m: ServiceMinutes): QuickSetupIssue[] {
      const at = (field: QuickSetupField, code: QuickSetupIssueCode): QuickSetupIssue => ({
        serviceId: service.id,
        field,
        code,
      });
      if (service.opens === service.closes) return [at("closes", "close_after_open")];
      return m.lastSeatingAt > m.closesAt ? [at("lastSeating", "last_seating_after_close")] : [];
    }
    export function validateDraft(draft: QuickSetupDraft): QuickSetupIssue[] {
      const perService = draft.services.flatMap((service) => {
        const missing = completenessIssues(service);
        const minutes = minutesOf(service);
        return missing.length > 0 || minutes === null ? missing : orderIssues(service, minutes);
      });
      const daysIssue: QuickSetupIssue[] =
        draft.days.length === 0 ? [{ serviceId: null, field: "days", code: "days_required" }] : [];
      if (perService.length > 0) return [...perService, ...daysIssue];
    
      const config = draftToConfig(draft, () => "check");
      const overlaps = validateConfig(config)
        .filter((issue) => issue.code === "overlap")
        .flatMap((issue): QuickSetupIssue[] => {
          const index = Number(/scheduleServices\[(\d+)\]/.exec(issue.path)?.[1]);
          const service = draft.services[index];
          return service ? [{ serviceId: service.id, field: "opens", code: "overlap" }] : [];
        });
      return [...overlaps, ...spanIssues(draft), ...daysIssue];
    }
    function spanIssues(draft: QuickSetupDraft): QuickSetupIssue[] {
      const read = normalizeLegacyHours(draftToLegacyHours(draft));
      const tooLong =
        read.ok &&
        WEEKDAYS.some((day) =>
          read.hours.weekly[day].some(
            (w) => w.wrapped === true && w.close - w.open > MAX_PAST_MIDNIGHT_SPAN
          )
        );
      if (!tooLong) return [];
      const latest = draft.services.reduce<{ id: string; closesAt: number } | null>((acc, s) => {
        const m = minutesOf(s);
        return m && (!acc || m.closesAt > acc.closesAt) ? { id: s.id, closesAt: m.closesAt } : acc;
      }, null);
      return latest ? [{ serviceId: latest.id, field: "closes", code: "span_too_long" }] : [];
    }
    export function draftToConfig(
      draft: QuickSetupDraft,
      newId: () => string,
      existing?: { regularScheduleId?: string; venueServiceIds?: Readonly<Record<string, string>> }
    ): AvailabilityConfig {
      const scheduleId = existing?.regularScheduleId ?? newId();
      const schedule: Schedule = {
        id: scheduleId,
        name: "Regular week",
        kind: "regular",
        isRegular: true,
      };
      const venueServices: VenueService[] = [];
      const scheduleServices: ScheduleService[] = [];
      draft.services.forEach((service, position) => {
        const m = minutesOf(service);
        if (m === null) return;
        const name = service.name.trim();
        const venueServiceId = existing?.venueServiceIds?.[name.toLowerCase()] ?? newId();
        venueServices.push({ id: venueServiceId, name, position });
        scheduleServices.push({
          id: newId(),
          scheduleId,
          venueServiceId,
          ...m,
          seating: { version: 1, interval: SEATING_INTERVAL_MINUTES },
          bookingTypes: ["online", "phone"],
        });
      });
      const assignment: ScheduleAssignment = {
        id: newId(),
        scheduleId,
        weekdays: [...draft.days].sort((a, b) => a - b),
        precedence: 0,
      };
      return {
        schedules: [schedule],
        venueServices,
        scheduleServices,
        assignments: [assignment],
        dateRules: [],
      };
    }
    export function draftToChanges(
      draft: QuickSetupDraft,
      stored: AvailabilityConfig,
      newId: () => string
    ): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const regular = stored.schedules.find((s) => s.isRegular);
      const venueServiceIds = Object.fromEntries(
        stored.venueServices.filter((s) => !s.archivedAt).map((s) => [s.name.toLowerCase(), s.id])
      );
      const next = draftToConfig(draft, newId, {
        ...(regular ? { regularScheduleId: regular.id } : {}),
        venueServiceIds,
      });
      const scheduleId = next.schedules[0]?.id;
      const storedServiceIds = new Set(stored.venueServices.map((s) => s.id));
      return {
        upsert: {
          schedules: next.schedules,
          venueServices: next.venueServices.filter((s) => !storedServiceIds.has(s.id)),
          scheduleServices: next.scheduleServices,
          assignments: next.assignments,
        },
        remove: {
          scheduleServices: stored.scheduleServices
            .filter((s) => s.scheduleId === scheduleId)
            .map((s) => s.id),
          assignments: stored.assignments.filter((a) => a.scheduleId === scheduleId).map((a) => a.id),
        },
      };
    }
    export function validateQuickSetupHours(
      hours: OperatingHours,
      t: TFunction = localeRuntime.i18n.t
    ): OperatingHoursValidationErrors | null {
      return Object.keys(hours).length === 0 ? { global: t("onboarding.hours.atLeastOne") } : null;
    }
    export function draftToLegacyHours(draft: QuickSetupDraft): OperatingHours {
      const projected = projectLegacyOperatingHours(draftToConfig(draft, () => "wizard"));
      const hours: OperatingHours = {};
      for (const [day, value] of Object.entries(projected)) {
        if (!value.closed)
          hours[day as keyof OperatingHours] = { open: value.open, close: value.close };
      }
      return hours;
    }
    export function draftFromLegacyHours(hours: OperatingHours, serviceId: string): QuickSetupDraft {
      const order = [
        "sunday",
        "monday",
        "tuesday",
        "wednesday",
        "thursday",
        "friday",
        "saturday",
      ] as const;
      const open = order.flatMap((day, index) => {
        const value = hours[day];
        return value && !value.closed ? [{ index, value }] : [];
      });
      const first = open[0]?.value;
      if (!first) return emptyDraft(serviceId);
      return {
        services: [
          {
            ...emptyService(serviceId),
            opens: first.open,
            closes: first.close,
            lastSeating: autoLastSeating(first.close),
          },
        ],
        days: open.map((o) => o.index),
      };
    }

    type Channel = keyof BookingOpen;
    export type RemovalChange =
      | { kind: "serviceOpens"; name: string; opensAt: number; closesAt: number }
      | { kind: "serviceCloses"; name: string }
      | { kind: "opensAtChanges"; name: string; minute: number }
      | { kind: "closesAtChanges"; name: string; minute: number; later: boolean }
      | { kind: "lastSeatingChanges"; name: string; minute: number }
      | { kind: "closureLifted"; closure: ResolvedClosure; serviceName?: string }
      | { kind: "closureApplies"; closure: ResolvedClosure }
      | { kind: "bookingOn"; channel: Channel }
      | { kind: "bookingOff"; channel: Channel }
      | { kind: "pacingLifted" }
      | { kind: "pacingSet"; covers: number };
    function serviceChanges(
      current: readonly ResolvedService[],
      removed: readonly ResolvedService[]
    ): RemovalChange[] {
      const now = new Map(current.map((s) => [s.venueServiceId, s]));
      const then = new Map(removed.map((s) => [s.venueServiceId, s]));
      const opening = removed
        .filter((s) => !now.has(s.venueServiceId))
        .map((s): RemovalChange => ({
          kind: "serviceOpens",
          name: s.name,
          opensAt: s.opensAt,
          closesAt: s.closesAt,
        }));
      const closing = current
        .filter((s) => !then.has(s.venueServiceId))
        .map((s): RemovalChange => ({ kind: "serviceCloses", name: s.name }));
      const adjusted = removed.flatMap((after): RemovalChange[] => {
        const before = now.get(after.venueServiceId);
        if (!before) return [];
        return [
          ...(before.opensAt !== after.opensAt
            ? [{ kind: "opensAtChanges" as const, name: after.name, minute: after.opensAt }]
            : []),
          ...(before.closesAt !== after.closesAt
            ? [
                {
                  kind: "closesAtChanges" as const,
                  name: after.name,
                  minute: after.closesAt,
                  later: after.closesAt > before.closesAt,
                },
              ]
            : []),
          ...(before.lastSeatingAt !== after.lastSeatingAt
            ? [
                {
                  kind: "lastSeatingChanges" as const,
                  name: after.name,
                  minute: after.lastSeatingAt,
                },
              ]
            : []),
        ];
      });
      return [...opening, ...closing, ...adjusted];
    }
    function closureChanges(
      current: readonly ResolvedClosure[],
      removed: readonly ResolvedClosure[],
      services: readonly ResolvedService[]
    ): RemovalChange[] {
      const nameOf = (c: ResolvedClosure) =>
        c.targetKind === "service"
          ? services.find((s) => s.venueServiceId === c.venueServiceId)?.name
          : undefined;
      // A whole-day closure of services or booking channels already shows up as those changes.
      const worthSaying = (c: ResolvedClosure) => !isWholeDay(c) || c.targetKind === "tables";
      return [
        ...current
          .filter((c) => !removed.some((r) => sameClosure(r, c)) && worthSaying(c))
          .map((closure): RemovalChange => ({
            kind: "closureLifted",
            closure,
            serviceName: nameOf(closure),
          })),
        ...removed
          .filter((c) => !current.some((r) => sameClosure(r, c)) && worthSaying(c))
          .map((closure): RemovalChange => ({ kind: "closureApplies", closure })),
      ];
    }
    function bookingChanges(current: BookingOpen, removed: BookingOpen): RemovalChange[] {
      return CHANNELS.flatMap((channel): RemovalChange[] => {
        if (current[channel] === removed[channel]) return [];
        return [{ kind: removed[channel] ? "bookingOn" : "bookingOff", channel }];
      });
    }
    function pacingChanges(current: ResolvedDaySummary, removed: ResolvedDaySummary): RemovalChange[] {
      if (current.pacingCovers === removed.pacingCovers) return [];
      return removed.pacingCovers === undefined
        ? [{ kind: "pacingLifted" }]
        : [{ kind: "pacingSet", covers: removed.pacingCovers }];
    }
    export function diffRemoval(
      current: ResolvedDaySummary,
      removed: ResolvedDaySummary
    ): RemovalChange[] {
      return [
        ...serviceChanges(current.services, removed.services),
        ...closureChanges(current.closures, removed.closures, current.services),
        ...bookingChanges(current.bookingOpen, removed.bookingOpen),
        ...pacingChanges(current, removed),
      ];
    }
    function liftedText(
      change: Extract<RemovalChange, { kind: "closureLifted" }>,
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat
    ): string {
      const { closure } = change;
      if (isWholeDay(closure)) return t("availability.drawer.removal.reopensAllDay");
      const range = {
        from: minuteText(closure.from, t, format),
        to: minuteText(closure.to, t, format),
      };
      if (closure.targetKind === "booking") {
        const channels = (closure.bookingTypes ?? []).map((c) =>
          t(`availability.drawer.removal.channel.${c}`)
        );
        return t("availability.drawer.removal.channelBackOn", {
          ...range,
          channels: new Intl.ListFormat(format.locale, { type: "conjunction" }).format(channels),
        });
      }
      if (closure.targetKind === "service" && change.serviceName) {
        return t("availability.drawer.removal.serviceReopens", { ...range, name: change.serviceName });
      }
      return t("availability.drawer.removal.reopens", range);
    }
    export function removalChangeText(
      change: RemovalChange,
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat
    ): string {
      const at = (minute: number) => minuteText(minute, t, format);
      switch (change.kind) {
        case "serviceOpens":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.serviceOpens", {
            name: change.name,
            from: at(change.opensAt),
            to: at(change.closesAt),
          });
        case "serviceCloses":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.serviceCloses", { name: change.name });
        case "opensAtChanges":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.opensAt", {
            name: change.name,
            time: at(change.minute),
          });
        case "closesAtChanges":
          return t(
            change.later
              ? "availability.drawer.removal.closesLater"
              : "availability.drawer.removal.closesEarlier",
            { name: change.name, time: at(change.minute) }
          );
        case "lastSeatingChanges":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.lastSeating", {
            name: change.name,
            time: at(change.minute),
          });
        case "closureLifted":
          return liftedText(change, t, format);
        case "closureApplies":
          return isWholeDay(change.closure)
            ? t("availability.calendar.closedAllDayName")
            : t("availability.drawer.removal.closes", {
                from: at(change.closure.from),
                to: at(change.closure.to),
              });
        case "bookingOn":
          return t(`availability.drawer.removal.bookingOn.${change.channel}`);
        case "bookingOff":
          return t(`availability.drawer.removal.bookingOff.${change.channel}`);
        case "pacingLifted":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.pacingLifted");
        case "pacingSet":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.pacingSet", { covers: change.covers });
      }
    }

    export interface UseOn {
      readonly weekdays: readonly number[];
      readonly startsOn?: string | null;
      readonly endsOn?: string | null;

    export type Winner = "new" | "existing";
    export function weekdayRuns(weekdays: readonly number[]): [number, number][] {
      const positions = MONDAY_FIRST.flatMap((d, i) => (weekdays.includes(d) ? [i] : []));
      const runs: [number, number][] = [];
      let start = -1;
      positions.forEach((p, i) => {
        if (start < 0) start = p;
        if (positions[i + 1] !== p + 1) {
          runs.push([MONDAY_FIRST[start]!, MONDAY_FIRST[p]!]);
          start = -1;
        }
      });
      return runs;
    }
    export function isScheduleUnused(config: AvailabilityConfig, scheduleId: string): boolean {
      const schedule = config.schedules.find((s) => s.id === scheduleId);
      if (!schedule || schedule.isRegular) return false;
      return (
        !config.assignments.some((a) => a.scheduleId === scheduleId) &&
        !config.dateRules.some((r) => r.kind === "use_schedule" && r.useScheduleId === scheduleId)
      );
    }
    export function buildDeleteScheduleChanges(scheduleId: string): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      return { upsert: {}, remove: { schedules: [scheduleId] } };
    }
    function meets(a: UseOn, b: UseOn): boolean {
      const shared = a.weekdays.filter((d) => b.weekdays.includes(d));
      if (shared.length === 0) return false;
      const from = [a.startsOn, b.startsOn]
        .filter((d): d is string => d != null)
        .sort()
        .at(-1);
      const to = [a.endsOn, b.endsOn].filter((d): d is string => d != null).sort()[0];
      if (from == null && to == null) return true;
      if (from != null && to != null && from > to) return false;
      // Open ends are unbounded; a week of the common range holds every weekday it can.
      const lo = from ?? addDays(to!, -6);
      const hi = to ?? addDays(from!, 6);
      for (let d = lo, n = 0; d <= hi && n < 7; d = addDays(d, 1), n += 1) {
        if (shared.includes(weekdayIndexOf(d))) return true;
      }
      return false;
    }
    function rankedAssignments(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      ignoreScheduleId?: string
    ): ScheduleAssignment[] {
      const live = new Set(
        liveSchedules(config)
          .filter((s) => !s.isRegular)
          .map((s) => s.id)
      );
      return config.assignments
        .filter((a) => live.has(a.scheduleId) && a.scheduleId !== ignoreScheduleId)
        .sort((a, b) => a.precedence - b.precedence);
    }
    export function overlappingSchedules(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      useOn: UseOn,
      ignoreScheduleId?: string
    ): Schedule[] {
      const ids = new Set(
        rankedAssignments(config, ignoreScheduleId)
          .filter((a) => meets(a, useOn))
          .map((a) => a.scheduleId)
      );
      return liveSchedules(config).filter((s) => ids.has(s.id));
    }
    function placeAssignment(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      mine: ScheduleAssignment,
      winner: Winner
    ): ScheduleAssignment[] {
      const existing = rankedAssignments(config);
      const lowestMeeting = existing.findIndex((a) => meets(a, mine));
      const at = winner === "existing" && lowestMeeting >= 0 ? lowestMeeting : existing.length;
      const order = [...existing.slice(0, at), mine, ...existing.slice(at)];
      return order
        .map((a, i) => ({ ...a, precedence: i + 1 }))
        .filter(
          (a) =>
            a.id === mine.id ||
            a.precedence !== config.assignments.find((x) => x.id === a.id)?.precedence
        );
    }
    function mergeChanges(
      a: AvailabilityConfigChanges,
      b: AvailabilityConfigChanges
    ): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const tables = [
        "schedules",
        "venueServices",
        "scheduleServices",
        "assignments",
        "dateRules",
      ] as const;
      const join = <T>(x: T[] | undefined, y: T[] | undefined) => [...(x ?? []), ...(y ?? [])];
      const pick = <K extends "upsert" | "remove">(side: K) =>
        Object.fromEntries(
          tables.flatMap((t) => {
            const rows = join<unknown>(
              (a[side] as Record<string, unknown[] | undefined>)[t],
              (b[side] as Record<string, unknown[] | undefined>)[t]
            );
            return rows.length > 0 ? [[t, rows]] : [];
          })
        );
      return { upsert: pick("upsert"), remove: pick("remove") } as AvailabilityConfigChanges;
    }
    interface NewScheduleInput {
      readonly config: AvailabilityConfig;
      readonly name: string;
      /** Rows for the new schedule; a copy's rows must have `scheduleServiceId: null`. */
      readonly services: readonly DraftService[];
      readonly useOn: UseOn;
      readonly winner: Winner;
      readonly makeId: () => string;
    }
    export function buildNewScheduleChanges(input: NewScheduleInput): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const { config, name, useOn, winner, makeId } = input;
      const scheduleId = makeId();
      const schedule: Schedule = { id: scheduleId, name, kind: "alternate", isRegular: false };
      const rows = buildDraftChanges({
        config,
        scope: { kind: "schedule", scheduleId },
        services: freshRows(input.services),
        makeId,
      });
      const assignments =
        useOn.weekdays.length === 0
          ? []
          : placeAssignment(
              config,
              {
                id: makeId(),
                scheduleId,
                weekdays: [...useOn.weekdays].sort((x, y) => x - y),
                startsOn: useOn.startsOn ?? null,
                endsOn: useOn.endsOn ?? null,
                precedence: 0,
              },
              winner
            );
      return mergeChanges(rows, {
        upsert: { schedules: [schedule], ...(assignments.length > 0 ? { assignments } : {}) },
        remove: {},
      });
    }
    interface RegularWeekInput extends Omit<NewScheduleInput, "useOn"> {
      readonly startsOn: string;
      readonly endsOn: string | null;
    }
    export function buildRegularWeekChanges(input: RegularWeekInput): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const { config, startsOn, endsOn } = input;
      if (endsOn !== null) {
        return buildNewScheduleChanges({
          ...input,
          useOn: { weekdays: EVERY_DAY, startsOn, endsOn },
        });
      }
      const scheduleId = input.makeId();
      const schedule: Schedule = { id: scheduleId, name: input.name, kind: "regular", isRegular: true };
      const rows = buildDraftChanges({
        config,
        scope: { kind: "schedule", scheduleId },
        services: freshRows(input.services),
        makeId: input.makeId,
      });
      const old = liveSchedules(config).find((s) => s.isRegular);
      const oldAssignments = config.assignments.filter((a) => a.scheduleId === old?.id);
      const dropped = oldAssignments.filter((a) => a.startsOn != null && a.startsOn >= startsOn);
      const truncated = oldAssignments
        .filter((a) => !dropped.includes(a) && (a.endsOn == null || a.endsOn >= startsOn))
        .map((a) => ({ ...a, endsOn: addDays(startsOn, -1) }));
      // The new week sits at 0, so every dated schedule must rank above it to keep winning its days
      // (legacy venues store every assignment at 0, which would tie).
      const renumbered = rankedAssignments(config)
        .map((a, i) => ({ ...a, precedence: i + 1 }))
        .filter((a) => a.precedence !== config.assignments.find((x) => x.id === a.id)?.precedence);
      return mergeChanges(rows, {
        upsert: {
          schedules: [
            schedule,
            ...(old ? [{ ...old, isRegular: false, kind: "alternate" as const }] : []),
          ],
          assignments: [
            {
              id: input.makeId(),
              scheduleId,
              weekdays: EVERY_DAY,
              startsOn,
              endsOn: null,
              precedence: 0,
            },
            ...truncated,
            ...renumbered,
          ],
        },
        remove: { assignments: dropped.map((a) => a.id) },
      });
    }
    export function buildEditScheduleChanges(input: {
      readonly config: AvailabilityConfig;
      readonly scheduleId: string;
      readonly name: string;
      readonly services: readonly DraftService[];
      readonly makeId: () => string;
    }): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const { config, scheduleId, name, makeId } = input;
      const rows = buildDraftChanges({
        config,
        scope: { kind: "schedule", scheduleId },
        services: input.services,
        makeId,
      });
      const stored = config.schedules.find((s) => s.id === scheduleId);
      const rename = stored && stored.name !== name ? { schedules: [{ ...stored, name }] } : {};
      return mergeChanges(rows, { upsert: rename, remove: {} });
    }
    function freshRows(services: readonly DraftService[]): DraftService[] {
      return services.map((s) => ({ ...s, scheduleServiceId: null }));
    }
    export function datesOfUse(useOn: UseOn, today: string): string[] {
      const dates: string[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < SCOPE_HORIZON_DAYS; i += 1) {
        const d = addDays(today, i);
        if (useOn.endsOn != null && d > useOn.endsOn) break;
        if (
          (useOn.startsOn == null || d >= useOn.startsOn) &&
          useOn.weekdays.includes(weekdayIndexOf(d))
        ) {
          dates.push(d);
        }
      }
      return dates;
    }

    export const SCOPE_HORIZON_DAYS = 366;
    interface ScopeContext {
      readonly config: AvailabilityConfig;
      readonly timezone: string;
      /** Today on the venue clock. */
      readonly today: string;
    }
    function eachDate(from: string, to: string, step: number): string[] {
      const dates: string[] = [];
      for (let d = from; d <= to; d = addDays(d, step)) dates.push(d);
      return dates;
    }
    export function scopeDates(scope: EditScope, context: ScopeContext): string[] {
      if (scope.kind === "date") return [scope.date];
      if (scope.kind === "dates") return [...scope.dates];
      if (scope.kind === "weekday") {
        const horizon = addDays(scope.from, SCOPE_HORIZON_DAYS - 1);
        const last = scope.until !== null && scope.until < horizon ? scope.until : horizon;
        return eachDate(scope.from, last, 7);
      }
      if (scope.kind === "rule") {
        const rule = context.config.dateRules.find((r) => r.id === scope.ruleId);
        if (!rule) return [];
        // A past date is not edited: "all dates" reaches the rule's dates still ahead.
        const first = scope.mode === "following" ? scope.from : maxDate(rule.startsOn, context.today);
        const horizon = addDays(first, SCOPE_HORIZON_DAYS - 1);
        const last = rule.endsOn != null && rule.endsOn < horizon ? rule.endsOn : horizon;
        return eachDate(first, last, 1).filter((d) => coversDate(rule, d));
      }
      const week = {
        timezone: context.timezone,
        config: { ...context.config, dateRules: [] },
      };
      return eachDate(context.today, addDays(context.today, SCOPE_HORIZON_DAYS - 1), 1).filter(
        (d) => resolveDay(week, d).scheduleId === scope.scheduleId
      );
    }
    export function coversDate(rule: DateRule, date: string): boolean {
      return (
        rule.startsOn <= date &&
        (rule.endsOn == null || date <= rule.endsOn) &&
        (rule.repeat == null || rule.repeat.weekdays.includes(weekdayIndexOf(date)))
      );
    }
    export function ownChangeDates(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      dates: readonly string[],
      ignoreRuleId: string | null
    ): string[] {
      const skipped = new Set(
        config.dateRules.filter((r) => r.kind === "skip").map((r) => `${r.seriesId}@${r.startsOn}`)
      );
      const rules = config.dateRules.filter((r) => isHoursRule(r) && r.id !== ignoreRuleId);
      return dates.filter((date) =>
        rules.some((rule) => coversDate(rule, date) && !skipped.has(`${rule.id}@${date}`))
      );
    }

    export function normalizeDates(dates: readonly string[]): string[] {
      return [...new Set(dates)].sort();
    }
    export function dateRange(a: string, b: string): string[] {
      const [from, to] = a <= b ? [a, b] : [b, a];
      const dates: string[] = [];
      for (let d = from; d <= to; d = addDays(d, 1)) dates.push(d);
      return dates;
    }
    export function toggleDate(selection: readonly string[], date: string): string[] {
      return selection.includes(date)
        ? selection.filter((d) => d !== date)
        : normalizeDates([...selection, date]);
    }
    export function columnDates(
      grid: readonly string[],
      column: number,
      view: CalendarView,
      anchor: string
    ): string[] {
      const month = anchor.slice(0, 7);
      return grid.filter((d, i) => i % 7 === column && (view === "week" || d.startsWith(month)));
    }
    export function weekdayDatesInMonth(anchor: string): string[] {
      const month = anchor.slice(0, 7);
      const weekday = weekdayIndexOf(anchor);
      const dates: string[] = [];
      for (let d = `${month}-01`; d.startsWith(month); d = addDays(d, 1)) {
        if (weekdayIndexOf(d) === weekday) dates.push(d);
      }
      return dates;
    }
    export function datesUsingSchedule(
      days: readonly { readonly serviceDate: string; readonly scheduleId: string | null }[],
      scheduleId: string
    ): string[] {
      return normalizeDates(days.filter((d) => d.scheduleId === scheduleId).map((d) => d.serviceDate));
    }

    export type SeriesScope = "following" | "all";
    export interface SeriesEdit {
      readonly weekdays: readonly number[];
      /** `null`: until reopened. */
      readonly endsOn: string | null;
    }
    export type SpecialHoursRule = Extract<DateRule, { kind: "special_hours" }>;
    export function isSeries(rule: DateRule): boolean {
      return rule.kind === "closure" && rule.repeat != null && rule.seriesId == null;
    }
    export function coversDate(series: DateRule, date: string): boolean {
      return (
        series.startsOn <= date &&
        (series.endsOn == null || date <= series.endsOn) &&
        (series.repeat?.weekdays.includes(weekdayIndexOf(date)) ?? false)
      );
    }
    export function nextOccurrence(series: DateRule, from: string): string {
      const start = from > series.startsOn ? from : series.startsOn;
      for (let i = 0; i < 7; i += 1) {
        const date = addDays(start, i);
        if (coversDate(series, date)) return date;
      }
      return series.startsOn;
    }
    export function dateOverride(
      rules: readonly DateRule[],
      seriesId: string,
      date: string
    ): DateRule | undefined {
      return rules.find((r) => r.seriesId === seriesId && r.startsOn === date);
    }
    export function skipRows(rules: readonly DateRule[], seriesId: string): DateRule[] {
      return rules
        .filter((r) => r.kind === "skip" && r.seriesId === seriesId)
        .sort((a, b) => a.startsOn.localeCompare(b.startsOn));
    }
    export function skippedDates(rules: readonly DateRule[], seriesId: string): string[] {
      return skipRows(rules, seriesId).map((r) => r.startsOn);
    }
    export function restoreDate(skip: DateRule): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      return { upsert: {}, remove: { dateRules: [skip.id] } };
    }
    export function skipDate(
      series: DateRule,
      date: string,
      makeId: () => string
    ): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const skip: DateRule = {
        id: makeId(),
        kind: "skip",
        targetKind: "venue",
        startsOn: date,
        endsOn: date,
        seriesId: series.id,
      };
      return { upsert: { dateRules: [skip] }, remove: {} };
    }
    export function growsSeries(series: DateRule, edit: SeriesEdit): boolean {
      const had = series.repeat?.weekdays ?? [];
      const later = series.endsOn != null && (edit.endsOn == null || edit.endsOn > series.endsOn);
      return edit.weekdays.some((d) => !had.includes(d)) || later;
    }
    export function growthClosure(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      series: DateRule,
      scope: SeriesScope,
      date: string,
      edit: SeriesEdit,
      makeId: () => string
    ): { rule: DateRule; alongside: ClosureAlongside } {
      const from = scope === "all" || date <= series.startsOn ? series.startsOn : date;
      const rule: DateRule = { ...withEdit(series, edit), id: makeId(), startsOn: from };
      const moved = config.dateRules
        .filter((r) => r.seriesId === series.id && r.startsOn >= from)
        .map((r) => ({ ...r, seriesId: rule.id }));
      if (from === series.startsOn) return { rule, alongside: { upsert: moved, remove: [series.id] } };
      const ended: DateRule = { ...series, endsOn: addDays(from, -1) };
      return { rule, alongside: { upsert: [ended, ...moved], remove: [] } };
    }
    export function editHoursRule(
      rule: SpecialHoursRule,
      scope: SeriesScope,
      date: string,
      payload: SpecialHoursRule["payload"],
      makeId: () => string,
      today = ""
    ): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const edited: SpecialHoursRule = { ...rule, payload };
      // "All dates" reaches the dates still ahead: dates already past keep their hours.
      const from = scope === "all" ? (today > rule.startsOn ? today : rule.startsOn) : date;
      if (from <= rule.startsOn) {
        return { upsert: { dateRules: [edited] }, remove: {} };
      }
      const created: SpecialHoursRule = { ...edited, id: makeId(), startsOn: from };
      const ended: SpecialHoursRule = { ...rule, endsOn: addDays(from, -1) };
      return { upsert: { dateRules: [ended, created] }, remove: {} };
    }
    export function editSeriesDates(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      series: DateRule,
      scope: SeriesScope,
      date: string,
      edit: SeriesEdit,
      makeId: () => string
    ): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      if (scope === "all" || date <= series.startsOn) {
        return { upsert: { dateRules: [withEdit(series, edit)] }, remove: {} };
      }
      const created: DateRule = { ...withEdit(series, edit), id: makeId(), startsOn: date };
      const moved = config.dateRules
        .filter((r) => r.seriesId === series.id && r.startsOn >= date)
        .map((r) => ({ ...r, seriesId: created.id }));
      const ended: DateRule = { ...series, endsOn: addDays(date, -1) };
      return { upsert: { dateRules: [ended, created, ...moved] }, remove: {} };
    }

    export function hoursEditDate(rule: DateRule, today: string): string | null {
      if (rule.repeat != null) {
        // `nextOccurrence` falls back to the rule's start when nothing is covered ahead.
        const next = nextOccurrence(rule, today);
        return next >= today && coversDate(rule, next) ? next : null;
      }
      return rule.startsOn > today ? rule.startsOn : today;
    }

    export type TonightChange =
      | { readonly ruleId: string; readonly kind: "pause_online" }
      | { readonly ruleId: string; readonly kind: "close_early"; readonly closeAt: number }
      | {
          readonly ruleId: string;
          readonly kind: "stop_window";
          readonly from: number;
          readonly to: number;
        }
      | {
          readonly ruleId: string;
          readonly kind: "block_tables";
          readonly tableCount: number;
          readonly from: number;
          readonly to: number;
        }
      | { readonly ruleId: string; readonly kind: "pacing"; readonly covers: number };
    type TonightRule = Extract<DateRule, { kind: "tonight" }>;
    function describe(rule: TonightRule): TonightChange | null {
      const ruleId = rule.id;
      const { payload } = rule;
      if ("closeAt" in payload) return { ruleId, kind: "close_early", closeAt: payload.closeAt };
      if ("pacing" in payload) return { ruleId, kind: "pacing", covers: payload.pacing.covers };
      if (rule.targetKind === "booking") return { ruleId, kind: "pause_online" };
      if (rule.targetKind === "tables") {
        return {
          ruleId,
          kind: "block_tables",
          tableCount: rule.tableIds?.length ?? 0,
          from: payload.stop.from,
          to: payload.stop.to,
        };
      }
      return { ruleId, kind: "stop_window", from: payload.stop.from, to: payload.stop.to };
    }
    export function tonightTimeMinutes(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      timezone: string,
      serviceDate: string
    ): readonly number[] {
      const { services } = resolveDay(
        {
          timezone,
          config: { ...config, dateRules: config.dateRules.filter((r) => r.kind !== "tonight") },
        },
        serviceDate
      );
      const first = services.length ? Math.min(...services.map((s) => s.opensAt)) : 0;
      const last = services.length
        ? Math.max(...services.map((s) => s.closesAt))
        : FALLBACK_LAST_MINUTE;
      const start = Math.floor(first / STEP_MINUTES) * STEP_MINUTES;
      const end = Math.min(MAX_MINUTE, last);
      return Array.from(
        { length: Math.max(0, Math.floor((end - start) / STEP_MINUTES)) + 1 },
        (_, i) => start + i * STEP_MINUTES
      );
    }
    export interface TonightDefaults {
      readonly closeAt: number;
      readonly stopFrom: number;
      readonly stopTo: number;
    }
    function nearestAtOrBefore(options: readonly number[], target: number): number {
      const before = options.filter((m) => m <= target);
      return before.length ? before[before.length - 1]! : options[options.length - 1]!;
    }
    export function tonightDefaults(options: readonly number[]): TonightDefaults {
      const closeAt = nearestAtOrBefore(options, DEFAULT_CLOSE_AT);
      const fromChoices = options.slice(0, -1);
      const stopFrom = nearestAtOrBefore(fromChoices.length ? fromChoices : options, DEFAULT_STOP_FROM);
      const after = options.filter((m) => m > stopFrom);
      const stopTo = after.find((m) => m >= DEFAULT_STOP_TO) ?? after[0] ?? stopFrom;
      return { closeAt, stopFrom, stopTo };
    }
    export function activeTonightChanges(
      rules: readonly DateRule[],
      today: string,
      now: Date
    ): readonly TonightChange[] {
      return rules.flatMap((rule) => {
        if (rule.kind !== "tonight" || rule.startsOn !== today) return [];
        if (rule.expiresAt && new Date(rule.expiresAt).getTime() <= now.getTime()) return [];
        const change = describe(rule);
        return change ? [change] : [];
      });
    }

  <file path="apps/hospitality/src/components/availability/use-discard-guard.ts">
    export function useDiscardGuard<T>(apply: (next: T) => void) {
      const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
      const [pending, setPending] = useState<{ readonly next: T } | null>(null);
    
      /** Moves on now, with the draft gone: after a save, or once it has been thrown away. */
      const release = (next: T) => {
        setDirty(false);
        setPending(null);
        apply(next);
      };
    
      return {
        dirty,
        setDirty,
        pending,
        request: (next: T) => (dirty ? setPending({ next }) : apply(next)),
        release,
        keepEditing: () => setPending(null),
        confirmDiscard: () => {
          if (pending) release(pending.next);
        },
      };
    }

    export function useScheduleSave(
      onStale: () => void,
      strandedKey:
        | "availabilitySchedules.stranded"
        | "availabilitySpecial.series.stranded"
        | "availabilitySpecial.rowStranded" = "availabilitySchedules.stranded"
    ) {
      const { t } = useTranslation();
      const { mutateAsync, isPending } = useSaveAvailabilityConfig();
      const [failure, setFailure] = useState<readonly string[]>([]);
    
      const reject = (error: unknown) => {
        const details = (error as { problemDetails?: unknown } | null)?.problemDetails;
        const parsed = AvailabilityConfigProblemSchema.safeParse(details);
        const problem = parsed.success ? parsed.data : null;
        if (problem?.code === "version-conflict") {
          onStale();
          setFailure([t("availabilitySchedules.conflict")]);
        } else if (problem?.code === "invalid-config" && problem.issues?.length) {
          setFailure(problem.issues.map((i) => i.message));
        } else if (problem?.code === "stranded-bookings") {
          setFailure([t(strandedKey, { count: problem.reservations?.length ?? 0 })]);
        } else {
          setFailure([describeApiError(error).detail]);
        }
      };
    
      /** Resolves the save result (truthy) when the change was saved, `null` when it was refused. */
      const save = async (
        venueId: string,
        state: AvailabilityConfigState,
        changes: AvailabilityConfigChanges,
        scopeConflicts: ScopeConflictMode
      ): Promise<AvailabilityConfigSaveResult | null> => {
        setFailure([]);
        try {
          return await mutateAsync({
            venueId,
            body: { expectedVersion: state.version, changes, scopeConflicts },
          });
        } catch (error) {
          reject(error);
          return null;
        }
      };
    
      return { save, isPending, failure, clearFailure: () => setFailure([]) };
    }

    export const LONG_PRESS_MS = 500;
    export interface DateSelectionOptions {
      readonly selection: readonly string[];
      readonly onSelectionChange: (dates: string[]) => void;
      readonly onOpenDay: (date: string) => void;
    }
    export interface DateGestureHandlers {
      readonly onClick: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
      readonly onMouseDown: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
      readonly onMouseEnter: () => void;
      readonly onTouchStart: () => void;
      readonly onTouchMove: () => void;
      readonly onTouchEnd: (event: TouchEvent) => void;
      readonly onContextMenu: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
    }
    export function useDateSelection(options: DateSelectionOptions) {
      const { selection, onSelectionChange, onOpenDay } = options;
      const pivot = useRef<string | null>(null);
      const drag = useRef<{ from: string; moved: boolean } | null>(null);
      const suppressClick = useRef(false);
      const touchMode = useRef(false);
      const pressTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
      const pressed = useRef(false);
    
      useEffect(() => {
        const endDrag = () => {
          if (drag.current?.moved) {
            // The click that follows a drag's mouseup fires synchronously; clear the flag after it.
            suppressClick.current = true;
            setTimeout(() => {
              suppressClick.current = false;
            }, 0);
          }
          drag.current = null;
        };
        window.addEventListener("mouseup", endDrag);
        return () => window.removeEventListener("mouseup", endDrag);
      }, []);
    
      const clearTimer = () => {
        if (pressTimer.current) clearTimeout(pressTimer.current);
        pressTimer.current = null;
      };
    
      /** Select from `from` through `to`, keeping `from` as the pivot (Shift+Arrow, drag). */
      const extendSelection = (from: string, to: string) => {
        pivot.current = from;
        onSelectionChange(dateRange(from, to));
      };
    
      /** Add or remove one day, and make it the pivot a later Shift-click or Shift+Arrow grows from. */
      const toggleSelected = (date: string) => {
        pivot.current = date;
        onSelectionChange(toggleDate(selection, date));
      };
    
      const handlersFor = (date: string): DateGestureHandlers => ({
        onMouseDown: (event) => {
          if (event.button === 0 && !event.shiftKey && !event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey) {
            drag.current = { from: date, moved: false };
          }
        },
        onMouseEnter: () => {
          const d = drag.current;
          if (!d || (date === d.from && !d.moved)) return;
          d.moved = true;
          extendSelection(d.from, date);
        },
        onClick: (event) => {
          if (suppressClick.current) return;
          if (event.shiftKey) {
            onSelectionChange(dateRange(pivot.current ?? date, date));
          } else if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || (touchMode.current && selection.length > 0)) {
            toggleSelected(date);
          } else {
            pivot.current = date;
            touchMode.current = false;
            onOpenDay(date);
          }
        },
        onTouchStart: () => {
          pressed.current = false;
          clearTimer();
          pressTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
            pressed.current = true;
            touchMode.current = true;
            pivot.current = date;
            onSelectionChange(normalizeDates([...selection, date]));
          }, LONG_PRESS_MS);
        },
        onTouchMove: clearTimer,
        onTouchEnd: (event) => {
          clearTimer();
          // Swallow the click the browser synthesises after a long-press.
          if (pressed.current) event.preventDefault();
          pressed.current = false;
        },
        onContextMenu: (event) => {
          if (pressTimer.current || pressed.current) event.preventDefault();
        },
      });
    
      return { handlersFor, extendSelection, toggleSelected, pivot };
    }

    export interface EffectiveDepositPolicyParams {
      depositConfig: DepositConfig | null;
      venueSlug: string | undefined;
      stripePublishableKey: string | undefined;
      guestIsRisky: boolean;
    }
    export function effectiveDepositPolicy({
      depositConfig,
      venueSlug,
      stripePublishableKey,
      guestIsRisky,
    }: EffectiveDepositPolicyParams): DepositConfig | null {
      if (!venueSlug || !stripePublishableKey || !depositConfig) return null;
      if (depositConfig.enabled) return depositConfig;
      return guestIsRisky ? depositConfig : null;
    }
    export function guestRiskMatters(
      depositConfig: DepositConfig | null,
      venueSlug: string | undefined,
      stripePublishableKey: string | undefined
    ): boolean {
      return !depositConfig?.enabled && Boolean(venueSlug) && Boolean(stripePublishableKey);
    }
    export function provisionalDepositRequired(
      depositConfig: DepositConfig | null,
      venueSlug: string | undefined,
      stripePublishableKey: string | undefined
    ): boolean {
      return (
        effectiveDepositPolicy({
          depositConfig,
          venueSlug,
          stripePublishableKey,
          guestIsRisky: false,
        }) !== null
      );
    }

    export function hasOperatingHours(operatingHours: OperatingHours | null | undefined): boolean {
      if (!operatingHours) return false;
      return DAYS.some((day) => {
        const schedule = operatingHours[day];
        return schedule != null && schedule.closed !== true;
      });

    export type BookingStep =
      | "date-party"
      | "time-slot"
      | "guest-details"
      | "payment"
      | "confirmation"
      | "waitlist-join"
      | "waitlist-confirmation";
    export interface WaitlistResult {
      statusToken: string;
      position: number;
      estimatedWaitMinutes: number | null;
    }
    export interface ClosedMidBooking {
      /** The venue's guest message for the closure. */
      message: string;
      /** The time the guest had chosen, so alternatives can be offered near it. */
      lostTime: string;
    }
    export interface SlotListing {
      slots: TimeSlot[];
      closure?: { message: string };
