    async function checkCollaboratorPermission(
      username: string,
      repository: string,
      githubToken: string
    ): Promise<boolean> {
      if (!GITHUB_REPO_RE.test(repository) || !GITHUB_USERNAME_RE.test(username)) {
        return false;
      }
    
      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          `${GITHUB_API_BASE}/repos/${repository}/collaborators/${username}/permission`,
          {
            headers: {
              Authorization: `Bearer ${githubToken}`,
              Accept: "application/vnd.github.v3+json",
              "User-Agent": "mattbutlerengineering-agent-service",
            },
          }
        );
    
        if (!response.ok) {
          return false;
        }
    
        const data = (await response.json()) as CollaboratorPermission;
        const permissionLevel = data.permission || data.role_name;
    
        const permissionHierarchy: Record<string, number> = {
          admin: 4,
          maintain: 3,
          write: 2,
          read: 1,
          none: 0,
        };
    
        const userLevel = permissionHierarchy[permissionLevel] ?? 0;
        const requiredLevel = permissionHierarchy[REQUIRED_PERMISSION] ?? 2;
    
        return userLevel >= requiredLevel;
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    }
    export const webhookRoutes: FastifyPluginAsync = async (fastify) => {
      fastify.addHook("preParsing", createRawBodyCaptureHook());
      fastify.addHook(
        "preHandler",
        createVerifiedBodyPreHandler({
          header: "x-hub-signature-256",
          secretEnv: "GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET",
          format: "sha256=",
        })
      );
    
      // POST /v1/webhooks/github — Handle GitHub webhook events
      // github[js/missing-rate-limiting] — restrictive limit for high-impact webhook
      fastify.post<{
        Body: unknown;
        Reply: { received: true } | ProblemDetails;
      }>(
        "/github",
        {
          schema: {
            summary: "GitHub webhook receiver",
            operationId: "handleGitHubWebhook",
            description:
              "Handles GitHub webhook events to automatically trigger agent sessions. " +
              "Supports: issue labeled 'agent', PR comments with '/agent', and CI failure retries.",
            tags: ["Webhooks"],
            response: {
              200: {
                type: "object",
                properties: { received: { type: "boolean" } },
              },
              401: { $ref: "AgentProblemDetails#" },
            },
          },
          config: { rateLimit: { max: 20, timeWindow: "1 minute" } },
        },
        async (request, reply) => {
          const githubToken = process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN;
          if (!githubToken) {
            fastify.log.warn("GITHUB_TOKEN not configured — cannot verify collaborator permissions");
            return reply
              .code(401)
              .send(createProblemDetails(401, "Unauthorized", "GitHub token not configured"));
          }
    
          const eventType = request.headers["x-github-event"] as string | undefined;
          const deliveryId = request.headers["x-github-delivery"] as string | undefined;
    
          // Redeliveries carry the same x-github-delivery id as the original
          // attempt. Claim it before doing any work so a replay is a synchronous
          // no-op — it never reaches dispatchGitHubEvent, let alone triggerSession.
          if (deliveryId && !defaultDeliveryDedupStore.claim(deliveryId)) {
            fastify.log.info({ deliveryId, eventType }, "Duplicate GitHub webhook delivery — skipping");
            return { received: true };
          }
    
          // Acknowledge inside GitHub's 10s delivery window. The work below
          // (extractIssueIntent's Haiku call, checkCollaboratorPermission's REST
          // round trip, triggerSession) can exceed that window on its own, which
          // is what causes GitHub to mark the delivery failed and redeliver it.
          // Dispatch fire-and-forget — the same shape triggerSession itself uses
          // for executeSession() in services/session-trigger.ts — and log any
          // failure via the structured (pino) fastify.log instead of losing it.
          dispatchGitHubEvent(fastify, eventType, request.body, githubToken).catch((err) => {
            fastify.log.error({ err, eventType, deliveryId }, "GitHub webhook event handling failed");
          });
    
          return { received: true };
        }
      );
    };
    async function dispatchGitHubEvent(
      fastify: FastifyInstance,
      eventType: string | undefined,
      body: unknown,
      githubToken: string
    ): Promise<void> {
      switch (eventType) {
        case "issues":
          await handleIssueEvent(fastify, body as GitHubIssueEvent, githubToken);
          return;
    
        case "issue_comment":
          await handleIssueCommentEvent(fastify, body as GitHubIssueCommentEvent, githubToken);
          return;
    
        case "check_run":
          await handleCheckRunEvent(fastify, body as GitHubCheckRunEvent);
          return;
    
        default:
          fastify.log.debug({ eventType }, "Ignoring unhandled GitHub event");
      }
    }
    async function handleIssueEvent(
      fastify: {
        log: {
          info: (...args: unknown[]) => void;
          warn: (...args: unknown[]) => void;
          error: (...args: unknown[]) => void;
        };
      },
      event: GitHubIssueEvent,
      githubToken: string
    ): Promise<void> {
      // Only handle "labeled" action with the agent label
      if (event.action !== "labeled") return;
      if (event.label?.name !== AGENT_LABEL) return;
    
      const hasPermission = await checkCollaboratorPermission(
        event.sender.login,
        event.repository.full_name,
        githubToken
      );
    
      if (!hasPermission) {
        fastify.log.warn(
          { user: event.sender.login, issue: event.issue.number },
          "Unauthorized user attempted to trigger agent session"
        );
        return;
      }
    
      // Attempt structured intent extraction via Haiku
      const intent = await extractIssueIntent(
        event.issue.title,
        event.issue.body ?? "",
        event.issue.number
      );
    
      let taskDescription: string;
      if (intent) {
        taskDescription = intent.taskDescription;
        fastify.log.info(
          { issueNumber: event.issue.number, scope: intent.estimatedScope },
          "Issue intent extracted"
        );
      } else {
        // Fall back to raw concatenation if extraction fails
        taskDescription =
          `Issue #${event.issue.number}: ${event.issue.title}\n\n` +
          `${event.issue.body ?? "No description provided."}\n\n` +
          `Source: ${event.issue.html_url}`;
        fastify.log.warn(
          { issueNumber: event.issue.number },
          "Intent extraction failed — using raw issue text"
        );
      }
    
      // Route the model: use intent-derived context when available, regex-only otherwise.
      const issueInput: IssueInput = {
        title: event.issue.title,
        labels: event.issue.labels.map((l) => l.name),
        body: event.issue.body ?? "",
      };
      const routingCtx = intent ? intentToRoutingContext(intent) : undefined;
      const { modelId } = routeModelWithReason(issueInput, routingCtx);
    
      const result = await triggerSession({
        taskDescription,
        baseBranch: event.repository.default_branch,
        model: modelId,
      });
    
      if (!result.accepted) {
        fastify.log.warn(
          { issueNumber: event.issue.number },
          "Concurrency cap reached — session not created"
        );
      }
    }
    async function handleIssueCommentEvent(
      fastify: {
        log: {
          info: (...args: unknown[]) => void;
          warn: (...args: unknown[]) => void;
          error: (...args: unknown[]) => void;
        };
      },
      event: GitHubIssueCommentEvent,
      githubToken: string
    ): Promise<void> {
      if (event.action !== "created") return;
    
      // Only handle PR comments (issues with a pull_request field)
      if (!event.issue.pull_request) return;
    
      const match = event.comment.body.match(AGENT_COMMAND_PATTERN);
      if (!match) return;
    
      const hasPermission = await checkCollaboratorPermission(
        event.comment.user.login,
        event.repository.full_name,
        githubToken
      );
    
      if (!hasPermission) {
        fastify.log.warn(
          { user: event.comment.user.login, pr: event.issue.number },
          "Unauthorized user attempted to trigger agent session via comment"
        );
        return;
      }
    
      const instructionMatch = match[1];
      if (!instructionMatch) return;
      const taskInstruction = instructionMatch.trim();
    
      const taskDescription =
        `PR #${event.issue.number}: ${event.issue.title}\n\n` +
        `Instruction from @${event.comment.user.login}: ${taskInstruction}\n\n` +
        `Source: ${event.comment.html_url}`;
    
      fastify.log.info(
        { prNumber: event.issue.number, user: event.comment.user.login },
        "Creating session from PR comment"
      );
    
      const result = await triggerSession({
        taskDescription,
        baseBranch: event.repository.default_branch,
      });
    
      if (!result.accepted) {
        fastify.log.warn(
          { prNumber: event.issue.number },
          "Concurrency cap reached — session not created"
        );
      }
    }
    async function handleCheckRunEvent(
      fastify: {
        log: {
          info: (...args: unknown[]) => void;
          warn: (...args: unknown[]) => void;
          error: (...args: unknown[]) => void;
        };
      },
      event: GitHubCheckRunEvent
    ): Promise<void> {
      if (event.action !== "completed") return;
      if (event.check_run.conclusion !== "failure") return;
    
      // Only retry on agent-created branches
      const branch = event.check_run.check_suite.head_branch;
      if (!branch || !branch.startsWith(AGENT_BRANCH_PREFIX)) return;
    
      const retryCount = await sessionService.countCiRetries(branch);
    
      if (retryCount >= MAX_CI_RETRIES) {
        fastify.log.info({ branch, retries: retryCount }, "Max CI retries reached — skipping");
        return;
      }
    
      const taskDescription =
        `[CI Retry ${retryCount + 1}/${MAX_CI_RETRIES}] ` +
        `Fix CI failure on branch ${branch}.\n\n` +
        `Check run "${event.check_run.name}" failed at commit ${event.check_run.head_sha}.\n` +
        `Review the CI output and fix the failing tests or build errors.`;
    
      fastify.log.info({ branch, attempt: retryCount + 1 }, "Creating CI retry session");
    
      const result = await triggerSession({
        taskDescription,
        baseBranch: event.repository.default_branch,
      });
    
      if (!result.accepted) {
        fastify.log.warn({ branch }, "Concurrency cap reached — CI retry session not created");
      }
    }

      const { availabilityChangesService } = fastify.services;
    
      registerEndpoint(fastify, availabilityConfigEndpoints.listChanges, {
        docs: {
          summary: "List a venue's availability history",
          operationId: "listAvailabilityChanges",
          description:
            "Who changed availability, when and what, newest first. `revertible` marks the one change that can still be undone. Filter by the UTC dates a change was made, by person (`actorId`) and by `kind`.",
          tags: ["Availability"],
          security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        },

          const page = await availabilityChangesService.list(venueId, request.query);
          if (!page) {
            return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", "Venue not found"));
          }
          return { data: page };
        }),
      });
    
      registerEndpoint(fastify, availabilityConfigEndpoints.revertChange, {
        docs: {
          summary: "Undo an availability change",
          operationId: "revertAvailabilityChange",
          description:
            "Applies the change's stored inverse as a new save (compare-and-set on `expectedVersion`, validation and the stranded-bookings check all apply). Refused with 409 `guests-notified` when the change told guests, and `already-reverted`, `superseded` or `not-revertable` otherwise. Requires a Manager (owner or manager) membership, or the admin role.",
          tags: ["Availability"],
          security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        },
        preHandler: requireAuth,
        handler: venueScoped(
          { ...VENUE_FROM_ID, access: "manager" },
          async (request, reply, { venueId }) => {
            const outcome = await availabilityChangesService.revert({
              venueId,
              changeId: request.params.changeId,
              actorId: request.user?.id ?? "unknown",
              expectedVersion: request.body.expectedVersion,
              now: new Date(),
            });
            switch (outcome.kind) {
              case "saved":
                return { data: { version: outcome.version, changeId: outcome.changeId } };
              case "not_found":
                return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", "Venue not found"));
              case "change_not_found":
                return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", "Change not found"));
              case "refused": {
                const { code, detail } = REFUSALS[outcome.reason];
                return reply.code(409).send(conflict("Conflict", detail, { code }));
              }
              case "version_conflict":
                return reply.code(409).send(
                  conflict("Conflict", "Availability changed since you loaded it.", {
                    code: "version-conflict",
                    winningChange: outcome.winningChange,
                  })
                );
              case "stranded":
                return reply
                  .code(409)
                  .send(
                    conflict(
                      "Conflict",
                      "Undoing this would leave existing bookings without service.",
                      { code: "stranded-bookings", reservations: outcome.reservations }
                    )
                  );
              case "invalid":
                return reply.code(422).send({
                  type: "about:blank",
                  title: "Unprocessable Entity",
                  status: 422,
                  detail: "The change can no longer be undone against the current availability.",
                  code: "invalid-config",
                  issues: outcome.issues,
                } satisfies AvailabilityConfigProblem);
            }
          }
        ),
      });
    };

    function configProblem(
      status: 409 | 422 | 503,
      title: string,
      detail: string,
      extension: Omit<AvailabilityConfigProblem, "type" | "title" | "status" | "detail">
    ): AvailabilityConfigProblem {
      return { type: "about:blank", title, status, detail, ...extension };
    }
    type ConfigReply = FastifyReply;
    function sendRefusal(
      reply: ConfigReply,
      outcome: Exclude<SaveOutcome | PreviewOutcome, { kind: "saved" | "ok" }>
    ) {
      switch (outcome.kind) {
        case "not_found":
          return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", VENUE_NOT_FOUND));
        case "version_conflict":
          return reply.code(409).send(
            configProblem(409, "Conflict", "Availability changed since you loaded it.", {
              code: "version-conflict",
              winningChange: outcome.winningChange,
            })
          );
        case "invalid":
          return reply.code(422).send(
            configProblem(422, "Unprocessable Entity", "The availability config is not valid.", {
              code: "invalid-config",
              issues: outcome.issues,
            })
          );
        case "timeout":
          return reply.code(503).send(
            configProblem(503, "Service Unavailable", "The preview took too long; try again.", {
              code: "preview-timeout",
            })
          );
        case "stranded":
          return reply
            .code(409)
            .send(
              configProblem(
                409,
                "Conflict",
                "This change affects existing bookings; save it through a closure so each one gets a decision.",
                { code: "stranded-bookings", reservations: outcome.reservations }
              )
            );
      }
    }

    type SlotsRoute = {
      Params: { venueId: string };
      Querystring: { date: string; partySize: string; duration?: string };
      Reply: ApiResponse<TimeSlot[]> | ProblemDetails;
    };
    type DatesRoute = {

    export const availabilityRoutes: FastifyPluginAsync = async (fastify) => {
      // Resolve domain services from the buildApp seam (issue #3357) rather than
      // importing the sibling singletons directly — tests inject fakes via
      // buildApp({ services }).
      const { availabilityService, venueService } = fastify.services;
    
      // Register schemas
      fastify.addSchema(TimeSlotSchema);
      fastify.addSchema(DateAvailabilitySchema);
    
      // GET /:venueId - Get available time slots for a date
      fastify.get<SlotsRoute>(
        "/:venueId",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Get available time slots",
            operationId: "getAvailability",
            description:
              "Get all available time slots for a venue on a specific date for a given party size.",
            tags: ["Availability"],
            params: {
              type: "object",
              required: ["venueId"],
              properties: {
                venueId: {
                  type: "string",
                  description: "The venue ID",
                },
              },
            },
            querystring: availabilityQueryJsonSchema,
            response: {
              200: {
                type: "object",
                properties: {
                  data: {
                    type: "array",
                    items: { $ref: "TimeSlot#" },
                  },
                },
              },
              404: { $ref: "Error#" },
            },
          },
        },
        venueScoped<SlotsRoute>({ venue: "params" }, async (request, reply, { venueId }) => {
          const { date, partySize, duration } = request.query;
    
          // Validate venue exists
          const venue = await venueService.getById(venueId);
          if (!venue) {
            return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", "Venue not found"));
          }
    
          const dateResult = validateDateString(date);
          if (!dateResult.valid) {
            return reply.code(400).send(createProblemDetails(400, "Bad Request", dateResult.error));
          }
    
          const partySizeResult = validatePartySize(partySize);
          if (!partySizeResult.valid) {
            return reply
              .code(400)
              .send(createProblemDetails(400, "Bad Request", partySizeResult.error));
          }
    
          const durationNum = duration ? parseInt(duration, 10) : undefined;
          if (duration && (isNaN(durationNum!) || durationNum! < 15)) {
            return reply
              .code(400)
              .send(
                createProblemDetails(
                  400,
                  "Bad Request",
                  "Invalid duration. Must be at least 15 minutes."
                )
              );
          }
    
          const slots = await availabilityService.generateTimeSlots(
            venueId,
            date,
            partySizeResult.value,
            durationNum
          );
    
          return { data: slots };
        })
      );
    
      // GET /:venueId/dates - Get dates with availability in a range
      fastify.get<DatesRoute>(
        "/:venueId/dates",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Get dates with availability",
            operationId: "getAvailableDates",
            description:
              "Get a list of dates with availability in a date range. Useful for calendar displays.",
            tags: ["Availability"],
            params: {
              type: "object",
              required: ["venueId"],
              properties: {
                venueId: {
                  type: "string",
                  description: "The venue ID",
                },
              },
            },
            querystring: availabilityDatesQueryJsonSchema,
            response: {
              200: {
                type: "object",
                properties: {
                  data: {
                    type: "array",
                    items: { $ref: "DateAvailability#" },
                  },
                },
              },
              404: { $ref: "Error#" },
            },
          },
        },
        venueScoped<DatesRoute>({ venue: "params" }, async (request, reply, { venueId }) => {
          const { startDate, endDate, partySize } = request.query;
    
          // Validate venue exists
          const venue = await venueService.getById(venueId);
          if (!venue) {
            return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", "Venue not found"));
          }
    
          const rangeResult = validateDateRange(startDate, endDate);
          if (!rangeResult.valid) {
            return reply.code(400).send(createProblemDetails(400, "Bad Request", rangeResult.error!));
          }
    
          const partySizeResult = validatePartySize(partySize);
          if (!partySizeResult.valid) {
            return reply
              .code(400)
              .send(createProblemDetails(400, "Bad Request", partySizeResult.error));
          }
    
          const dates = await availabilityService.getAvailableDates(
            venueId,
            startDate,
            endDate,
            partySizeResult.value
          );
    
          return { data: dates };
        })
      );
    };

    export const cancelReservationRoutes: FastifyPluginAsync = async (fastify) => {
      fastify.delete<{
        Body?: { cancellationReason?: string; cancellationNote?: string };
      }>(
        "/public/v1/reservations/manage",
        {
          schema: {
            body: cancelReservationBodyJsonSchema,
          },
          config: {
            rateLimit: { max: 10, timeWindow: "1 minute" },
          },
          // The body is optional: Ajv rejects an undefined body against an object
          // schema, so default an omitted one to {} before validation runs.
          preValidation: async (request) => {
            if (request.body === undefined) {
              request.body = {};
            }
          },
        },
        // ADR-026 §3.3 item 4: the scope verifies the token, resolves the venue
        // and loads the reservation once; the whole cancel flow runs inside that
        // venue's RLS context.
        manageTokenScoped(
          { missing: (reply) => reply.status(404).send(reservationNotFoundProblem()) },
          async (request, reply, { reservation, token }) => {
            const preamble = guardManageState(reservation);
            if (!preamble.ok) {
              return reply.status(preamble.status).send(manageProblemDetails(preamble, "cancel"));
            }
    
            const result = await fastify.transitions.cancel(preamble.reservation, {
              door: "guest-manage",
              initiator: "guest",
              manageToken: token,
              reason: request.body?.cancellationReason,
              note: request.body?.cancellationNote,
              actor: guestActor(preamble.reservation.guestId),
              log: request.log,
            });
    
            if (!result.success) {
              return reply
                .status(result.status)
                .send(createProblemDetails(result.status, result.title, result.detail));
            }
    
            return reply.status(200).send({
              data: { status: result.reservation.status },
            });
          }
        )
      );
    };

    export async function closureCaller(
      request: FastifyRequest,
      venueId: string,
      isAdmin: boolean
    ): Promise<ClosureCaller> {
      const sub = request.user?.raw.sub ?? "";
      const role = isAdmin ? null : await request.server.venueRoleLookup(sub, venueId);
      return {
        isManager: isAdmin || hasVenueRole(role, "manager"),
        actorId: request.user?.id ?? "unknown",
      };
    }

    export async function enqueueNotices(
      enqueue: FastifyInstance["services"]["closureNoticeService"]["enqueueForClosure"],
      input: { venueId: string; ruleId: string },
      log: FastifyBaseLogger
    ): Promise<void> {
      try {
        await enqueue({ ...input, now: new Date() });
      } catch (error) {
        log.error({ err: error, ...input }, "closure notices were not enqueued");
      }
    }
    export async function enqueueClosureJobs(
      fastify: FastifyInstance,
      log: FastifyBaseLogger,
      saved: { venueId: string; ruleId: string; cancelled: number }
    ): Promise<void> {
      const { venueId, ruleId, cancelled } = saved;
      if (cancelled > 0) {
        try {
          await fastify.closureRefunds.enqueue(venueId, ruleId);
        } catch (err) {
          log.error({ err, venueId, ruleId }, "Failed to enqueue closure refund jobs");
        }
      }
      await enqueueNotices(
        fastify.services.closureNoticeService.enqueueForClosure,
        { venueId, ruleId },
        log
      );
    }

    type Refusal = Exclude<CreateClosureOutcome, { kind: "saved" }>;
    function problem(
      status: 409 | 422,
      detail: string,
      extension: Omit<AvailabilityConfigProblem, "type" | "title" | "status" | "detail">
    ): AvailabilityConfigProblem {
      return {
        type: "about:blank",
        title: status === 409 ? "Conflict" : "Unprocessable Entity",
        status,
        detail,
        ...extension,
      };
    }
    export function sendRefusal(reply: FastifyReply, outcome: Refusal) {
      switch (outcome.kind) {
        case "not_found":
          return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", VENUE_NOT_FOUND));
        case "forbidden":
          return reply.code(403).send(createProblemDetails(403, "Forbidden", CLOSURE_FORBIDDEN));
        case "too_long":
          return reply
            .code(400)
            .send(
              createProblemDetails(
                400,
                "Bad Request",
                `A closure's dates can span at most ${SCOPE_CONFLICT_HORIZON_DAYS} days; use "until I reopen" for an open end.`
              )
            );
        case "version_conflict":
          return reply.code(409).send(
            problem(409, "Availability changed since you loaded it.", {
              code: "version-conflict",
              winningChange: outcome.winningChange,
            })
          );
        case "closure_exists":
          return reply.code(409).send(
            problem(409, "This closure was already saved; reopen it or use a new rule id.", {
              code: "closure-exists",
            })
          );
        case "key_reused":
          return reply.code(409).send(
            problem(409, "This Idempotency-Key was already used for a different closure.", {
              code: "idempotency-key-reused",
            })
          );
        case "invalid":
          return reply.code(422).send(
            problem(422, "The closure is not valid.", {
              code: "invalid-config",
              issues: outcome.issues,
            })
          );
        case "decision_required":
          return reply.code(422).send(
            problem(
              422,
              "Every affected group needs a choice (and keeping silently needs a confirmation).",
              {
                code: "decision-required",
                groupKeys: outcome.groupKeys,
              }
            )
          );
        case "invalid_decision":
          return reply.code(422).send(
            problem(422, "A decision names an unknown or repeated group, or moves a closed day.", {
              code: "invalid-decision",
              groupKeys: outcome.groupKeys,
            })
          );
        case "move_unavailable":
          return reply.code(422).send(
            problem(422, "Some bookings have no open time to move to; choose another outcome.", {
              code: "move-unavailable",
              reservationIds: outcome.reservationIds,
            })
          );
      }
    }
    export const closureRoutes: FastifyPluginAsync = async (fastify) => {
      const { closureCommandService, closureNoticeService } = fastify.services;
    
      registerEndpoint(fastify, availabilityConfigEndpoints.createClosure, {
        docs: {
          summary: "Save a closure with a decision for every affected group",
          operationId: "createClosure",
          description:
            "Writes the date rule (kind `closure` or `special_hours`), one outcome per affected reservation, the cancels and moves with their reservation events, and the audit row in one transaction, so no active booking overlaps a saved closure unless its outcome is keep. A cancelled booking's deposit stays held with the outcome's refund pending for the refund job; no Stripe call is made here. After the commit, one CLOSURE_NOTICE job is enqueued per notified outcome; an enqueue failure is logged, not returned. Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header; a replay returns the stored result and changes nothing. Manager, or a Host for the emergency whole-venue close of the current service day when the venue grants it.",
          tags: ["Availability"],
          security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        },
        preHandler: requireAuth,
        handler: venueScoped(VENUE_FROM_ID, async (request, reply, { venueId, isAdmin }) => {
          const key = request.headers["idempotency-key"];
          if (typeof key !== "string" || key.trim() === "") {
            return reply
              .code(400)
              .send(createProblemDetails(400, "Bad Request", "Idempotency-Key header is required"));
          }
          const caller = await closureCaller(request, venueId, isAdmin);
          const outcome = await closureCommandService.create({
            venueId,
            caller,
            body: request.body,
            idempotencyKey: key,
            now: new Date(),
          });
          if (outcome.kind !== "saved") return sendRefusal(reply, outcome);
          // After the commit; failures are logged, never returned.
          await enqueueClosureJobs(fastify, request.log, {
            venueId,
            ruleId: outcome.result.ruleId,
            cancelled: outcome.result.outcomes.cancel,
          });
          return { data: outcome.result };
        }),
      });
    
      registerEndpoint(fastify, availabilityConfigEndpoints.createClosures, {
        docs: {
          summary: "Save several closures in one transaction",
          operationId: "createClosures",
          description:
            "Each item is a `POST …/closures` body; the items commit in order inside one transaction, so a refusal (a missing decision, a move with no open time, a stale version) saves none of them and cancels no booking. Every item keeps its own rule, outcomes, audit row, refund job and notices. Requires an `Idempotency-Key` header; a replay returns the stored results. Manager only.",
          tags: ["Availability"],
          security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        },
        preHandler: requireAuth,
        handler: venueScoped(VENUE_FROM_ID, async (request, reply, { venueId, isAdmin }) => {
          const key = request.headers["idempotency-key"];
          if (typeof key !== "string" || key.trim() === "") {
            return reply
              .code(400)
              .send(createProblemDetails(400, "Bad Request", "Idempotency-Key header is required"));
          }
          const caller = await closureCaller(request, venueId, isAdmin);
          const outcome = await closureCommandService.createMany({
            venueId,
            caller,
            body: request.body,
            idempotencyKey: key,
            now: new Date(),
          });
          if (outcome.kind !== "saved") return sendRefusal(reply, outcome);
          // After the commit; failures are logged, never returned.
          for (const saved of outcome.result.results) {
            await enqueueClosureJobs(fastify, request.log, {
              venueId,
              ruleId: saved.ruleId,
              cancelled: saved.outcomes.cancel,
            });
          }
          return { data: outcome.result };
        }),
      });
    
      registerEndpoint(fastify, availabilityConfigEndpoints.listClosures, {
        docs: {
          summary: "Outcome counts for every closure",
          operationId: "listClosures",
          description:
            "Sent / Rebooked / Unreachable and refund counts per date rule that produced closure outcomes, for the Special dates tab. Includes reopened closures and ended Tonight close-early rules. Any venue member.",
          tags: ["Availability"],
          security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        },
        preHandler: requireAuth,
        handler: venueScoped(VENUE_FROM_ID, async (_request, _reply, { venueId }) => ({
          data: await closureNoticeService.summaries(venueId),
        })),
      });
    
      registerEndpoint(fastify, availabilityConfigEndpoints.closureCallList, {
        docs: {
          summary: "Call list for one closure",
          operationId: "closureCallList",
          description:
            "Guests the closure told but without a confirmed delivery or a rebooking: name, party, time and phone. Any venue member (a Host who made the emergency close needs it).",
          tags: ["Availability"],
          security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        },
        preHandler: requireAuth,
        handler: venueScoped(VENUE_FROM_ID, async (request, _reply, { venueId }) => {
          const entries = await closureNoticeService.callList(venueId, request.params.ruleId);
          return { data: entries.map((e) => ({ ...e, startTime: e.startTime.toISOString() })) };
        }),
      });
    
      registerEndpoint(fastify, availabilityConfigEndpoints.retryClosureRefunds, {
        docs: {
          summary: "Retry a closure's refunds",
          operationId: "retryClosureRefunds",
          description:
            "Re-enqueues the refund job for outcomes still `pending` or `failed` through `closureRefunds.retry`; settled outcomes are never touched and the Stripe idempotency keys are unchanged, so a guest is never refunded twice. Covers Tonight close-early rules too (keyed by date rule id, even after the rule ended). Manager only.",
          tags: ["Availability"],
          security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        },
        preHandler: requireAuth,
        handler: venueScoped(VENUE_FROM_ID, async (request, reply, { venueId, isAdmin }) => {
          const caller = await closureCaller(request, venueId, isAdmin);
          if (!caller.isManager) {
            return reply.code(403).send(createProblemDetails(403, "Forbidden", CLOSURE_FORBIDDEN));
          }
          try {
            const enqueued = await fastify.closureRefunds.retry(venueId, request.params.ruleId);
            return { data: { enqueued } };
          } catch (err) {
            request.log.error({ err, venueId, ruleId: request.params.ruleId }, "refund retry failed");
            const queued = err instanceof ClosureRefundEnqueueError ? err.enqueued : 0;
            return reply
              .code(503)
              .send(
                createProblemDetails(
                  503,
                  "Service Unavailable",
                  `Couldn't queue every refund (${queued} queued before the failure). Retry to finish the rest.`
                )
              );
          }
        }),
      });
    
      registerEndpoint(fastify, availabilityConfigEndpoints.reopenClosure, {
        docs: {
          summary: "Reopen a closure",
          operationId: "reopenClosure",
          description:
            "Removes a closure (or special hours) saved through `POST …/closures` so its slots return. Guests it cancelled stay cancelled. Manager, or a Host for the emergency close they made themselves on the current service day when the venue grants it.",
          tags: ["Availability"],
          security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        },
        preHandler: requireAuth,
        handler: venueScoped(VENUE_FROM_ID, async (request, reply, { venueId, isAdmin }) => {
          const caller = await closureCaller(request, venueId, isAdmin);
          const outcome = await closureCommandService.reopen({
            venueId,
            ruleId: request.params.ruleId,
            caller,
            tellCancelledGuests: request.body.tellCancelledGuests,
            now: new Date(),
          });
          if (outcome.kind === "reopened") {
            if (request.body.tellCancelledGuests) {
              await enqueueNotices(
                closureNoticeService.enqueueForReopen,
                { venueId, ruleId: request.params.ruleId },
                request.log
              );
            }
            return { data: outcome.result };
          }
          return sendRefusal(reply, outcome);
        }),
      });
    };

    export interface DepositTransitionRoute {
      Params: { id: string };
      Reply: { data: Deposit } | ReturnType<typeof createProblemDetails>;
    }
    export function depositTransitionHandler(
      deposits: DepositService,
      transition: (id: string) => Promise<Deposit>
    ) {
      return venueScoped<DepositTransitionRoute, Deposit>(
        {
          venue: {
            entity: "deposit",
            key: (request) => request.params.id,
            load: (id) => deposits.getById(id),
            notFound: "Deposit not found",
          },
        },
        async (request, reply) => {
          try {
            return { data: await transition(request.params.id) };
          } catch (err) {
            if (err instanceof DepositTransitionError) {
              return reply
                .code(422)
                .send(createProblemDetails(422, "Unprocessable Entity", err.message));
            }
            if (err instanceof DepositConcurrentUpdateError) {
              return reply.code(409).send(createProblemDetails(409, "Conflict", err.message));
            }
            throw err;
          }
        }
      );
    }

  <file path="services/reservations/src/routes/deposits.ts">
    interface ApiResponse<T> {
      data: T;
    }
    type DepositsQuery = { reservationId?: string; venueId?: string; date?: string };
    async function requireDepositSelector(
      request: FastifyRequest<{ Querystring: DepositsQuery }>,
      reply: FastifyReply
    ): Promise<void> {
      const { reservationId, venueId, date } = request.query;
      if (reservationId || (venueId && date)) return;
      reply
        .code(400)
        .send(
          createProblemDetails(400, "Bad Request", "reservationId, or venueId and date, is required")
        );
    }
    export const depositRoutes: FastifyPluginAsync = async (fastify) => {
      const { depositService, venueService } = fastify.services;
    
      // POST /api/v1/deposits — create a deposit
      fastify.post<{
        Body: { reservationId: string; amountCents: number; currency?: string };
        Reply: ApiResponse<Deposit> | ReturnType<typeof createProblemDetails>;
      }>(
        "/",
        {
          preHandler: [requireAuth, requireAdmin],
          schema: {
            summary: "Create a deposit",
            operationId: "createDeposit",
            description: "Create a new deposit in pending state for a reservation.",
            tags: ["Deposits"],
            body: createDepositBodyJsonSchema,
            response: {
              201: {
                description: "Deposit created",
                type: "object",
                properties: {
                  data: { type: "object", properties: depositProperties },
                },
              },
              400: { description: "Bad request", type: "object" },
              404: { description: "Reservation not found, or not in any venue", type: "object" },
            },
          },
        },
        venueScoped(
          {
            venue: {
              entity: "reservation",
              key: (request: { body: { reservationId: string } }) => request.body.reservationId,
              notFound: "Reservation not found",
            },
          },
          async (request, reply, { venueId }) => {
            // The venue owns the currency (same rule as public-deposits.ts): a client
            // may echo it but never choose it, since `amountCents` is only meaningful
            // in the venue's minor unit.
            const venueCurrency = await venueService.getCurrencyCode(venueId);
            if (venueCurrency === null) {
              return reply
                .code(404)
                .send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", "Reservation not found"));
            }
            const currency = venueCurrency.toLowerCase();
            if (
              request.body.currency !== undefined &&
              request.body.currency.toLowerCase() !== currency
            ) {
              return reply
                .code(400)
                .send(
                  createProblemDetails(
                    400,
                    "Bad Request",
                    `Deposit currency must match the venue currency (${currency}).`
                  )
                );
            }
            const deposit = await depositService.create({
              reservationId: request.body.reservationId,
              amountCents: request.body.amountCents,
              currency,
            });
            return reply.code(201).send({ data: deposit });
          }
        )
      );
    
      // GET /api/v1/deposits?reservationId= — operator visibility: look up a
      // reservation's deposit (or null if none exists yet), venue-scoped. Same
      // venue-resolution shape as POST / above: the query carries an opaque
      // reservation id, not a venueId, so the app-wide preHandler resolves
      // nothing and this route resolves it itself (module comment, ADR-026).
      //
      // GET /api/v1/deposits?venueId=&date= — deposit-exposure dashboard batch
      // read (#5832): every deposit for a venue's reservations on a given date.
      // Here the venue is the query's own `venueId`. Either way the route
      // declares its scope with `venueScoped`, so it is never implicit.
      fastify.get<{
        Querystring: DepositsQuery;
        Reply: ApiResponse<Deposit | Deposit[] | null> | ReturnType<typeof createProblemDetails>;
      }>(
        "/",
        {
          preHandler: [requireAuth, requireAdmin, requireDepositSelector],
          schema: {
            summary: "Get a reservation's deposit, or list a venue's deposits for a date",
            operationId: "getDeposits",
            description:
              "Look up a reservation's deposit by reservationId (or null if none exists yet), " +
              "or list every deposit for a venue's reservations on a given date (venueId + date).",
            tags: ["Deposits"],
            querystring: {
              type: "object",
              properties: {
                reservationId: { type: "string" },
                venueId: { type: "string" },
                date: { type: "string" },
              },
            },
            response: {
              200: {
                description: "Deposit found (or null), or the venue's deposits for the date",
                type: "object",
                properties: {
                  data: {
                    anyOf: [
                      { type: "object", properties: depositProperties },
                      { type: "array", items: { type: "object", properties: depositProperties } },
                      { type: "null" },
                    ],
                  },
                },
              },
              400: {
                description: "Missing reservationId, or missing venueId/date",
                type: "object",
              },
              404: { description: "Reservation not found, or not in any venue", type: "object" },
            },
          },
        },
        venueScoped(
          {
            venue: {
              // requireDepositSelector guarantees `venueId` when there is no
              // `reservationId`; only an unresolvable reservation yields null.
              resolve: async ({ query }) =>
                query.reservationId
                  ? resolveVenueId("reservation", query.reservationId)
                  : query.venueId!,
              label: "reservationId|venueId",
              notFound: "Reservation not found",
            },
          },
          async (request, _reply, { venueId }) => {
            const { reservationId, date } = request.query;
            if (reservationId) {
              return { data: await depositService.getByReservationId(reservationId) };
            }
            return { data: await depositService.listByVenueAndDate(venueId, new Date(date!)) };
          }
        )
      );
    
      // GET /api/v1/deposits/:id — get deposit by ID
      fastify.get<{
        Params: { id: string };
        Reply: ApiResponse<Deposit> | ReturnType<typeof createProblemDetails>;
      }>(
        "/:id",
        {
          preHandler: [requireAuth, requireAdmin],
          schema: {
            summary: "Get deposit by ID",
            operationId: "getDepositById",
            description: "Retrieve a deposit by its unique identifier.",
            tags: ["Deposits"],
            params: {
              type: "object",
              required: ["id"],
              properties: { id: { type: "string" } },
            },
            response: {
              200: {
                description: "Deposit found",
                type: "object",
                properties: {
                  data: { type: "object", properties: depositProperties },
                },
              },
              404: { description: "Not found", type: "object" },
            },
          },
        },
        // ADR-026 §3.3 item 6 / #5369 PR 7: the venue resolves straight through
        // the `SECURITY DEFINER` `app_resolve_venue_id('deposit', id)` — a join to
        // the deposit's own reservation done INSIDE the resolver, not via a prior
        // unscoped `depositService.getById` — so the load already runs inside the
        // resolved venue context.
        venueScoped(
          {
            venue: {
              entity: "deposit",
              key: (request: { params: { id: string } }) => request.params.id,
              load: (id: string) => depositService.getById(id),
              notFound: "Deposit not found",
            },
          },
          async (_request, _reply, { entity: deposit }) => ({ data: deposit })
        )
      );
    
      // POST /api/v1/deposits/:id/capture — apply (capture) a held deposit
      fastify.post<{
        Params: { id: string };
        Reply: ApiResponse<Deposit> | ReturnType<typeof createProblemDetails>;
      }>(
        "/:id/capture",
        {
          preHandler: [requireAuth, requireAdmin],
          schema: {
            summary: "Capture (apply) a deposit",
            operationId: "captureDeposit",
            description:
              "Capture a held deposit — transitions state from held → applied and charges the card.",
            tags: ["Deposits"],
            params: {
              type: "object",
              required: ["id"],
              properties: { id: { type: "string" } },
            },
            response: {
              200: {
                description: "Deposit applied",
                type: "object",
                properties: {
                  data: { type: "object", properties: depositProperties },
                },
              },
              404: { description: "Not found", type: "object" },
              422: { description: "Invalid state transition", type: "object" },
            },
          },
        },
        depositTransitionHandler(depositService, (id) => depositService.apply(id))
      );
    
      // POST /api/v1/deposits/:id/refund — refund a held deposit
      fastify.post<{
        Params: { id: string };
        Reply: ApiResponse<Deposit> | ReturnType<typeof createProblemDetails>;
      }>(
        "/:id/refund",
        {
          preHandler: [requireAuth, requireAdmin],
          schema: {
            summary: "Refund a deposit",
            operationId: "refundDeposit",
            description:
              "Refund a held deposit — transitions state from held → refunded and releases the authorization.",
            tags: ["Deposits"],
            params: {
              type: "object",
              required: ["id"],
              properties: { id: { type: "string" } },
            },
            response: {
              200: {
                description: "Deposit refunded",
                type: "object",
                properties: {
                  data: { type: "object", properties: depositProperties },
                },
              },
              404: { description: "Not found", type: "object" },
              422: { description: "Invalid state transition", type: "object" },
            },
          },
        },
        depositTransitionHandler(depositService, (id) => depositService.refund(id))
      );
    
      // POST /api/v1/deposits/:id/forfeit — forfeit a held deposit
      fastify.post<{
        Params: { id: string };
        Reply: ApiResponse<Deposit> | ReturnType<typeof createProblemDetails>;
      }>(
        "/:id/forfeit",
        {
          preHandler: [requireAuth, requireAdmin],
          schema: {
            summary: "Forfeit a deposit",
            operationId: "forfeitDeposit",
            description:
              "Forfeit a held deposit (no-show) — transitions state from held → forfeited and charges the card.",
            tags: ["Deposits"],
            params: {
              type: "object",
              required: ["id"],
              properties: { id: { type: "string" } },
            },
            response: {
              200: {
                description: "Deposit forfeited",
                type: "object",
                properties: {
                  data: { type: "object", properties: depositProperties },
                },
              },
              404: { description: "Not found", type: "object" },
              422: { description: "Invalid state transition", type: "object" },
            },
          },
        },
        depositTransitionHandler(depositService, (id) => depositService.forfeit(id, "staff"))
      );

  <file path="services/reservations/src/routes/events.ts">
    function deriveTableStatusDelta(event: ReservationEvent): TableStatusDelta[] {
      if (!RESERVATION_TRANSITION_EVENT_TYPES.has(event.type)) {
        return [];
      }
    
      const reservation = event.data as Reservation;
      const status = deriveTableDisplayStatus({
        reservation,
        hasActiveHold: false,
        now: new Date(),
      });
    
      return [{ tableId: reservation.tableId, status }];
    }
    export async function eventRoutes(fastify: FastifyInstance): Promise<void> {
      // Re-derive per-table display-status deltas from reservation/hold
      // transitions and re-emit as `table-status:changed` — changed tables
      // only, never a full floor-plan resync (payload-growth risk, proposal
      // #3803). Registered once per app boot via the raw EventEmitter `on`
      // (not the connection-counted `onChange` wrapper) so every connected
      // client's own `handleEvent` below forwards a single, consistent
      // derived event instead of each connection re-deriving independently.
      fastify.reservationEvents.on("change", (event: ReservationEvent) => {
        const changes = deriveTableStatusDelta(event);
        fastify.reservationEvents.emitTableStatusChanged(event.venueId, changes);
      });
    
      // GET /events/stream - Server-Sent Events stream
      fastify.get<{
        Querystring: { venueId?: string };
      }>(
        "/stream",
        {
          preHandler: [requireAuth, requireVenueAccess(fastify.venueMembershipLookup, queryVenueId)],
          schema: {
            summary: "Subscribe to real-time reservation events",
            operationId: "streamEvents",
            description:
              "Server-Sent Events (SSE) endpoint for real-time updates. " +
              "Requires venueId — the caller must be a member of that venue (or platform admin). " +
              "Connect to receive live notifications of reservation changes, holds, and table updates.",
            tags: ["Events"],
            querystring: eventsStreamQueryJsonSchema,
            response: {
              200: {
                description: "SSE stream established",
                type: "string",
              },
            },
          },
        },
        async (
          request: FastifyRequest<{ Querystring: { venueId?: string; testClose?: string } }>,
          reply: FastifyReply
        ) => {
          const { venueId, testClose } = request.query;
          const clientIp = request.ip;
    
          // --- Guard: max connections per IP ---
          const result = connectionManager.accept(request, reply);
          if (!result.ok) {
            request.log.warn(
              { ip: clientIp, reason: result.reason },
              "SSE connection rejected: per-IP limit reached"
            );
            return reply
              .code(429)
              .send(createProblemDetails(429, "Too Many Connections", result.reason));
          }
    
          const { connection } = result;
    
          // Domain event handler — filter by venueId, write to connection
          const handleEvent = (event: ReservationEvent) => {
            if (venueId && event.venueId !== venueId) return;
            connection.write(event);
          };
    
          // Subscribe to domain events
          fastify.reservationEvents.onChange(handleEvent);
          fastify.log.info(
            {
              connectionId: connection.id,
              ip: clientIp,
              connections: fastify.reservationEvents.getConnectionCount(),
            },
            "SSE client connected"
          );
    
          // Unsubscribe and log on disconnect
          request.raw.on("close", () => {
            fastify.reservationEvents.offChange(handleEvent);
            fastify.log.info(
              {
                connectionId: connection.id,
                ip: clientIp,
                connections: fastify.reservationEvents.getConnectionCount(),
              },
              "SSE client disconnected"
            );
          });
    
          // TEST-ONLY: automatically close after a fixed delay to allow app.inject to complete.
          // The testClose param is a boolean flag — its value is ignored to prevent
          // user-controlled data from flowing into setTimeout (CodeQL js/resource-exhaustion).
          if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "test" && testClose) {
            const TEST_CLOSE_TIMEOUT_MS = 50;
            setTimeout(() => {
              if (!reply.raw.writableEnded) {
                reply.raw.end();
              }
            }, TEST_CLOSE_TIMEOUT_MS);
          }
        }
      );
    }

    export const floorPlanSectionRoutes: FastifyPluginAsync = async (fastify) => {
      const { floorPlanSectionService } = fastify.services;

        Querystring: VenueQuery;

        Reply: ApiResponse<FloorPlanSection> | ProblemDetails;
      }>(
        "/",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Create a floor-plan section",
            querystring: floorPlanSectionVenueQueryJsonSchema,
            body: createFloorPlanSectionBodyJsonSchema,
          },
        },

          if (!section) {
            return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", FLOOR_PLAN_NOT_FOUND));
          }

        })
      );

        Querystring: VenueQuery;

        Reply: { data: FloorPlanSection[] } | ProblemDetails;
      }>(
        "/order",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Reorder a floor plan's sections",
            description: "`ids` lists every section to place; its index becomes `displayOrder`.",
            querystring: floorPlanSectionVenueQueryJsonSchema,
            body: reorderFloorPlanSectionsBodyJsonSchema,
          },
        },
        venueScoped({ venue: "query" }, async (request, reply, { venueId }) => {
          const { floorPlanId, ids } = request.body;
          const sections = await floorPlanSectionService.reorder(venueId, floorPlanId, ids);
          if (!sections) {
            return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", SECTION_NOT_FOUND));
          }
          return { data: sections };
        })
      );
    
      fastify.patch<{
        Params: { sectionId: string };
        Querystring: VenueQuery;
        Body: UpdateFloorPlanSectionRequest;
        Reply: ApiResponse<FloorPlanSection> | ProblemDetails;
      }>(
        "/:sectionId",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Rename or recolour a floor-plan section",
            params: sectionIdParams,
            querystring: floorPlanSectionVenueQueryJsonSchema,
            body: updateFloorPlanSectionBodyJsonSchema,
          },
        },
        venueScoped({ venue: "query" }, async (request, reply, { venueId }) => {
          const section = await floorPlanSectionService.update(
            venueId,
            request.params.sectionId,
            request.body
          );
          if (!section) {
            return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", SECTION_NOT_FOUND));
          }
          return { data: section };
        })
      );
    
      fastify.delete<{
        Params: { sectionId: string };
        Querystring: VenueQuery;
        Reply: void | ProblemDetails;
      }>(
        "/:sectionId",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Delete a floor-plan section (its tables are kept, unassigned)",
            params: sectionIdParams,
            querystring: floorPlanSectionVenueQueryJsonSchema,
          },
        },
        venueScoped({ venue: "query" }, async (request, reply, { venueId }) => {
          if (!(await floorPlanSectionService.delete(venueId, request.params.sectionId))) {
            return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", SECTION_NOT_FOUND));
          }
          return reply.code(204).send();
        })
      );
    
      fastify.put<{
        Params: { sectionId: string };
        Querystring: VenueQuery;
        Body: AssignSectionTablesRequest;
        Reply: { data: Table[] } | ProblemDetails;
      }>(
        "/:sectionId/tables",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Set the tables that belong to a section",
            description:
              "`tableIds` becomes the section's exact membership; other tables leave it. " +
              "Every table must belong to the section's floor plan.",
            params: sectionIdParams,
            querystring: floorPlanSectionVenueQueryJsonSchema,
            body: assignSectionTablesBodyJsonSchema,
          },
        },
        venueScoped({ venue: "query" }, async (request, reply, { venueId }) => {
          const tables = await floorPlanSectionService.assignTables(
            venueId,
            request.params.sectionId,
            request.body.tableIds
          );
          if (!tables) {
            return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", TABLES_NOT_FOUND));
          }
          return { data: tables };
        })
      );
    };

    export const floorPlanRoutes: FastifyPluginAsync = async (fastify) => {
      // Domain services come from the buildApp seam (issue #3357); tests inject fakes
      // via buildApp({ services }).
      const { floorPlanService, tableService } = fastify.services;
    
      fastify.get<{
        Querystring: { venueId?: string; page?: string; limit?: string };
        Reply: PaginatedResponse<FloorPlan> | ProblemDetails;
      }>(
        "/",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "List floor plans visible to the caller",
            description:
              "Returns a paginated list of floor plans. Platform admins see floor plans " +
              "for every venue; other callers are scoped to venues they are a member of. " +
              "Optionally filter by venueId.",
            querystring: listFloorPlansQueryJsonSchema,
          },
        },
        async (request, reply) => {
          const { page, limit } = parsePaginationQuery(request.query);
          const user = request.user;
    
          // requireAuth guarantees an identity; this satisfies the type narrower
          // and fails closed if the guard is ever removed.
          if (!user) {
            return reply
              .code(401)
              .send(createProblemDetails(401, "Unauthorized", "Authentication required"));
          }
    
          // Platform admins are scoped to every venue (matches requireVenueAccess,
          // ADR-020); everyone else sees only floor plans for venues they belong to.
          // No guard here: a named venue only scopes the RLS context, and
          // `listForMember` filters a non-admin to their own venues.
          return inNamedVenueContext(request.query.venueId, () =>
            hasPermission(user, "admin")
              ? floorPlanService.list(page, limit, request.query.venueId)
              : floorPlanService.listForMember(user.raw.sub, page, limit, request.query.venueId)
          );
        }
      );
    
      fastify.get<{ Params: { venueId: string }; Reply: ApiResponse<FloorPlan> | ProblemDetails }>(
        "/venue/:venueId/active",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Get active floor plan for venue",
            params: {
              type: "object",
              properties: {
                venueId: { type: "string" },
              },
            },
          },
        },
        venueScoped({ venue: "params" }, async (_request, reply, { venueId }) => {
          const floorPlan = await floorPlanService.getActiveByVenueId(venueId);
          if (!floorPlan) {
            return reply
              .code(404)
              .send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", "No active floor plan found for venue"));
          }
          return { data: floorPlan };
        })
      );
    
      fastify.get<{ Params: { id: string }; Reply: ApiResponse<FloorPlan> | ProblemDetails }>(
        "/:id",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Get floor plan by ID",
            params: {
              type: "object",
              properties: {
                id: { type: "string" },
              },
            },
          },
        },
        venueScoped(
          { venue: { ...floorPlanVenue, load: (id) => floorPlanService.getById(id) } },
          async (_request, _reply, { entity: floorPlan }) => ({ data: floorPlan })
        )
      );
    
      fastify.post<{ Body: CreateFloorPlanRequest; Reply: ApiResponse<FloorPlan> | ProblemDetails }>(
        "/",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Create floor plan",
            body: createFloorPlanBodyJsonSchema,
          },
        },
        venueScoped({ venue: "body" }, async (request, reply) => {
          const floorPlan = await floorPlanService.create(request.body);
          return reply.code(201).send({ data: floorPlan });
        })
      );
    
      fastify.post<{ Params: { id: string }; Reply: ApiResponse<FloorPlan> | ProblemDetails }>(
        "/:id/clone",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Clone floor plan",
            description: "Creates a copy of the floor plan and all its tables.",
            params: {
              type: "object",
              properties: {
                id: { type: "string" },
              },
            },
          },
        },
        venueScoped({ venue: floorPlanVenue }, async (request, reply) => {
          const cloned = await floorPlanService.clone(request.params.id);
          if (!cloned) {
            return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", FLOOR_PLAN_NOT_FOUND));
          }
          fastify.reservationEvents.emitFloorPlanCreated(cloned);
          return reply.code(201).send({ data: cloned });
        })
      );
    
      fastify.patch<{
        Params: { id: string };
        Body: UpdateFloorPlanRequest;
        Reply: ApiResponse<FloorPlan> | ProblemDetails;
      }>(
        "/:id",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Update floor plan",
            params: {
              type: "object",
              properties: {
                id: { type: "string" },
              },
            },
            body: updateFloorPlanBodyJsonSchema,
          },
        },
        venueScoped({ venue: floorPlanVenue }, async (request, reply) => {
          const floorPlan = await floorPlanService.update(request.params.id, request.body);
          if (!floorPlan) {
            return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", FLOOR_PLAN_NOT_FOUND));
          }
          return { data: floorPlan };
        })
      );
    
      fastify.post<{ Params: { id: string }; Reply: ApiResponse<FloorPlan> | ProblemDetails }>(
        "/:id/activate",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Set floor plan as active",
            description: "Activates this floor plan and deactivates all others for the same venue.",
            params: {
              type: "object",
              properties: {
                id: { type: "string" },
              },
            },
          },
        },
        venueScoped(
          { venue: { ...floorPlanVenue, load: (id) => floorPlanService.getById(id) } },
          async (_request, reply, { entity: floorPlan }) => {
            const updated = await floorPlanService.setActive(floorPlan.id, floorPlan.venueId);
            if (!updated) {
              return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", FLOOR_PLAN_NOT_FOUND));
            }
            return { data: updated };
          }
        )
      );
    
      fastify.post<{
        Body: { floorPlanId: string; positions: UpdateTablePositionRequest[] };
        Reply: { data: Table[] } | ProblemDetails;
      }>(
        "/tables/positions",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Bulk update table positions",
            description: "Updates the position and metadata for multiple tables in a floor plan.",
            body: updateTablePositionsBodyJsonSchema,
          },
        },
        venueScoped(
          {
            venue: {
              entity: "floor_plan",
              key: (request) => request.body.floorPlanId,
              load: (id) => floorPlanService.getById(id),
              notFound: FLOOR_PLAN_NOT_FOUND,
            },
          },
          async (request, reply, { entity: floorPlan }) => {
            const { floorPlanId, positions } = request.body;
    
            // The floor plan load above, this cross-venue table scan, and the bulk
            // update itself (which does its own internal floor-plan read, see
            // floor-plan.ts's bulkUpdateTablePositions) all run inside the floor
            // plan's venue context (ADR-026 §3.3 item 2 / #5369 PR 5), so all three
            // succeed under FORCE. Note: once scoped, a genuinely cross-venue
            // `positions[].tableId` becomes invisible here rather than "found,
            // wrong venue" — the 403 below no longer fires for that case, but the
            // attempt still fails (404 "One or more tables not found") because
            // `bulkUpdateTablePositions`'s own UPDATE carries an explicit
            // `t.venue_id = …` predicate independent of RLS.
            const foundTables = await tableService.listVenueIdsByIds(
              positions.map((pos) => pos.tableId)
            );
            // Ids that don't resolve are absent from `foundTables`, so a
            // missing/deleted table is never treated as cross-venue.
            const crossVenueTable = foundTables.find((table) => table.venueId !== floorPlan.venueId);
            if (crossVenueTable) {
              return reply
                .code(403)
                .send(
                  createProblemDetails(
                    403,
                    titleForStatus(403),
                    "One or more tables do not belong to the floor plan's venue"
                  )
                );
            }
    
            const updatedTables = await floorPlanService.bulkUpdateTablePositions(
              floorPlanId,
              positions
            );
            return { data: updatedTables };
          }
        )
      );
    
      fastify.post<{
        Params: { tableId: string };
        // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
        Body: { floorPlanId: string; shapeMetadata?: any };
        Reply: { data: Table } | ProblemDetails;
      }>(
        "/tables/:tableId/assign",
        {
          // Scoped to the *table* being mutated (:tableId), not the floor plan
          // named in the body — see issue #5008. The body's floorPlanId can
          // legitimately belong to the caller's own venue while :tableId belongs
          // to someone else's; authorizing on the body let a caller re-point
          // another venue's table onto their own floor plan.
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Assign table to floor plan",
            params: {
              type: "object",
              properties: {
                tableId: { type: "string" },
              },
            },
            body: assignTableBodyJsonSchema,
          },
        },
        venueScoped({ venue: tableParamVenue }, async (request, reply) => {
          const table = await floorPlanService.assignTableToFloorPlan(
            request.params.tableId,
            request.body.floorPlanId,
            request.body.shapeMetadata
          );
          if (!table) {
            return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", TABLE_NOT_FOUND));
          }
          return { data: table };
        })
      );
    
      fastify.post<{ Params: { tableId: string }; Reply: { data: Table } | ProblemDetails }>(
        "/tables/:tableId/remove",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Remove table from floor plan",
            params: {
              type: "object",
              properties: {
                tableId: { type: "string" },
              },
            },
          },
        },
        venueScoped({ venue: tableParamVenue }, async (request, reply) => {
          const table = await floorPlanService.removeTableFromFloorPlan(request.params.tableId);
          if (!table) {
            return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", TABLE_NOT_FOUND));
          }
          return { data: table };
        })
      );
    
      fastify.delete<{ Params: { id: string }; Reply: void | ProblemDetails }>(
        "/:id",
        {
          preHandler: requireAuth,
          schema: {
            summary: "Delete floor plan",
            params: {
              type: "object",
              properties: {
                id: { type: "string" },
              },
            },
          },
        },
        venueScoped({ venue: floorPlanVenue }, async (request, reply) => {
          const success = await floorPlanService.delete(request.params.id);
          if (!success) {
            return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", FLOOR_PLAN_NOT_FOUND));
          }
          return reply.code(204).send();
        })
      );

    export const guestRoutes: FastifyPluginAsync = async (fastify) => {
      const { guestService, venueService } = fastify.services;

          operationId: "createGuest",
          description: "Create a new guest. Requires authentication.",
          tags: ["Guests"],
          security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        },
        preHandler: requireAuth,
        handler: venueScoped({ venue: "body" }, async (request, reply) => {

        docs: {
          summary: "Find or create guest",
          operationId: "findOrCreateGuest",
          description:
            "Find existing guest by email/phone or create new one. Used for identity resolution when booking.",
          tags: ["Guests"],
          security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        },

            phone,
            name,
            notes,
            dietaryRestrictions,
          });
          return { data: guest };
        }),
      });

      registerEndpoint(fastify, guestsEndpoints.update, {

          summary: "Update a guest",
          operationId: "updateGuest",
          description: "Update guest information. Requires authentication.",
          tags: ["Guests"],
          security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }],
        },
        preHandler: requireAuth,
        handler: venueScoped(
          {

          },

            const guest = await guestService.update(request.params.id, request.body);
            if (!guest) {

            }

          tags: ["Guests"],

        },
