  <file path="packages/rialto/scripts/generate-figma-tokens.ts">
    interface FigmaTokenSets {
      readonly [setName: string]: TokenGroup;
    }
    function readJson(filePath: string): TokenGroup {
      const content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8");
      return JSON.parse(content);
    }
    function runRegex(pattern: RegExp, input: string): RegExpMatchArray | null {
      return pattern[Symbol.match]?.(input) ?? null;
    }
    function runRegexAll(pattern: RegExp, input: string): ReadonlyArray<RegExpMatchArray> {
      return Array.from(input.matchAll(pattern));
    }
    function parseCssProperties(css: string): ReadonlyArray<{
      readonly name: string;
      readonly value: string;
      readonly comment: string;
    }> {
      const results: Array<{
        readonly name: string;
        readonly value: string;
        readonly comment: string;
      }> = [];
    
      const lines = css.split("\n");
      let currentName = "";
      let currentValue = "";
      let currentStartLine = -1;
    
      function flushProperty() {
        if (!currentName) return;
    
        // Look backwards from the start line for the nearest comment block
        let comment = "";
        for (let j = currentStartLine - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
          const prev = lines[j].trim();
    
          // Single-line comment: /* ... */
          if (prev.startsWith("/*") && prev.endsWith("*/")) {
            comment = prev.replace(/^\/\*\s*/, "").replace(/\s*\*\/$/, "");
            // Skip section divider comments (e.g., "── Ambient glow ──")
            if (comment.startsWith("──")) comment = "";
            break;
          }
    
          // Multi-line comment ending: find the opening /* and join lines
          if (prev.endsWith("*/")) {
            const commentLines: string[] = [prev.replace(/\s*\*\/$/, "").replace(/^\*?\s*/, "")];
            for (let k = j - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
              const cLine = lines[k].trim();
              if (cLine.startsWith("/*")) {
                commentLines.unshift(cLine.replace(/^\/\*\s*/, ""));
                break;
              }
              commentLines.unshift(cLine.replace(/^\*?\s*/, ""));
            }
            comment = commentLines.join(" ").trim();
            // Skip section divider comments
            if (comment.startsWith("──")) comment = "";
            break;
          }
    
          // Stop at blank lines or other declarations
          if (prev === "" || prev.startsWith("--rialto-")) break;
        }
    
        results.push({
          name: currentName,
          value: currentValue.trim(),
          comment,
        });
    
        currentName = "";
        currentValue = "";
        currentStartLine = -1;
      }
    
      for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
        const line = lines[i].trim();
    
        // Check if this starts a new property declaration
        const propStartMatch = line.match(/^(--rialto-[\w-]+)\s*:\s*(.*)$/);
        if (propStartMatch) {
          // Flush any previous property
          flushProperty();
    
          const [, name, rest] = propStartMatch;
          currentName = name;
          currentStartLine = i;
    
          // Check if the value completes on this same line
          if (rest.endsWith(";")) {
            currentValue = rest.slice(0, -1).trim();
            flushProperty();
          } else {
            currentValue = rest;
          }
          continue;
        }
    
        // If we're accumulating a multi-line value, append this line
        if (currentName) {
          if (line.endsWith(";")) {
            currentValue += " " + line.slice(0, -1).trim();
            flushProperty();
          } else {
            currentValue += " " + line;
          }
        }
      }
    
      // Flush any trailing property
      flushProperty();
    
      return results;
    }
    function extractCssBlock(css: string, selector: string): string {
      const selectorIndex = css.indexOf(selector);
      if (selectorIndex === -1) return "";
    
      const openBrace = css.indexOf("{", selectorIndex);
      if (openBrace === -1) return "";
    
      // Find the matching closing brace via depth counting
      let depth = 1;
      let pos = openBrace + 1;
      while (pos < css.length && depth > 0) {
        if (css[pos] === "{") depth++;
        if (css[pos] === "}") depth--;
        pos++;
      }
    
      return css.slice(openBrace + 1, pos - 1);
    }
    function cssNameToPath(name: string): readonly string[] {
      return name.replace(/^--rialto-/, "").split("-");
    }
    function setNestedValue(
      obj: TokenGroup,
      pathSegments: readonly string[],
      value: DtcgToken
    ): TokenGroup {
      if (pathSegments.length === 0) return obj;
      if (pathSegments.length === 1) {
        return { ...obj, [pathSegments[0]]: value };
      }
    
      const [head, ...tail] = pathSegments;
      const existing = obj[head] as TokenGroup | undefined;
      return {
        ...obj,
        [head]: setNestedValue(existing ?? {}, tail, value),
      };
    }
    function readRadiusTokens(tokensDir: string): TokenGroup {
      const css = fs.readFileSync(path.join(tokensDir, "radius.css"), "utf-8");
      const rootBlock = extractCssBlock(css, ":root");
      const props = parseCssProperties(rootBlock);
    
      let tokens: TokenGroup = {};
      for (const prop of props) {
        const segments = cssNameToPath(prop.name);
        // Remove "radius" prefix since it's already the category
        const key = segments.slice(1);
        if (key.length === 0) continue;
    
        const token: DtcgToken = {
          $value: prop.value,
          $type: "dimension",
          ...(prop.comment ? { $description: prop.comment } : {}),
        };
        tokens = setNestedValue(tokens, key, token);
      }
    
      return { radius: tokens };
    }
    function readShadowTokens(tokensDir: string): {
      readonly light: TokenGroup;
      readonly dark: TokenGroup;
      readonly shared: TokenGroup;
    } {
      const css = fs.readFileSync(path.join(tokensDir, "shadows.css"), "utf-8");
    
      // Parse :root block
      const rootBlock = extractCssBlock(css, ":root");
      const rootProps = parseCssProperties(rootBlock);
    
      // Parse dark theme block
      const darkBlock = extractCssBlock(css, '[data-theme="dark"]');
      const darkProps = parseCssProperties(darkBlock);
    
      let lightShadows: TokenGroup = {};
      let darkShadows: TokenGroup = {};
      let shared: TokenGroup = {};
    
      for (const prop of rootProps) {
        const segments = cssNameToPath(prop.name);
        const category = segments[0];
        const key = segments.slice(1);
    
        // Skip alias tokens that reference other variables
        if (prop.value.startsWith("var(")) continue;
    
        const baseToken: DtcgToken = {
          $value: prop.value,
          $type: categoryToType(category),
          ...(prop.comment ? { $description: prop.comment } : {}),
        };
    
        if (category === "shadow") {
          const shadowKey = key.length > 0 ? key : [prop.name.replace("--rialto-shadow-", "")];
          lightShadows = setNestedValue(lightShadows, shadowKey, baseToken);
        } else {
          // Easing, duration, z-index are shared (not theme-dependent)
          shared = setNestedValue(shared, segments, baseToken);
        }
      }
    
      for (const prop of darkProps) {
        const segments = cssNameToPath(prop.name);
        const key = segments.slice(1); // Remove "shadow" prefix
    
        if (prop.value.startsWith("var(")) continue;
    
        const token: DtcgToken = {
          $value: prop.value,
          $type: "shadow",
          ...(prop.comment ? { $description: prop.comment } : {}),
        };
    
        const shadowKey = key.length > 0 ? key : [prop.name.replace("--rialto-shadow-", "")];
        darkShadows = setNestedValue(darkShadows, shadowKey, token);
      }
    
      return {
        light: { shadow: lightShadows },
        dark: { shadow: darkShadows },
        shared,
      };
    }
    function categoryToType(category: string): string {
      switch (category) {
        case "shadow":
          return "shadow";
        case "ease":
          return "cubicBezier";
        case "duration":
          return "duration";
        case "z":
          return "number";
        default:
          return "other";
      }
    }
    function readVibeOverrides(providersDir: string): {
      readonly transacting: TokenGroup;
      readonly presenting: TokenGroup;
    } {
      const vibesPath = path.join(providersDir, "vibes.ts");
      const content = fs.readFileSync(vibesPath, "utf-8");
    
      interface VibeMapping {
        readonly category: string;
        readonly path: readonly string[];
      }
    
      const vibeOverrideMap: Record<string, VibeMapping> = {
        "--rialto-space-sm": { category: "spacing", path: ["sm"] },
        "--rialto-space-md": { category: "spacing", path: ["md"] },
        "--rialto-space-lg": { category: "spacing", path: ["lg"] },
        "--rialto-radius-default": { category: "radius", path: ["default"] },
        "--rialto-radius-soft": { category: "radius", path: ["soft"] },
        "--rialto-weight-medium": { category: "font", path: ["weight", "medium"] },
        "--rialto-text-sm": { category: "font", path: ["size", "sm"] },
      };
    
      function extractVibeSet(vibeName: string): TokenGroup {
        // Match the vibe block: vibeName: { ... }
        const regex = new RegExp(`${vibeName}:\\s*\\{([^}]+)\\}`, "s");
        const match = runRegex(regex, content);
        if (!match) return {};
    
        const block = match[1];
        let tokens: TokenGroup = {};
    
        // Parse each "--rialto-*": "value" pair
        const pairRegex = /"(--rialto-[\w-]+)":\s*"([^"]+)"/g;
        const pairs = runRegexAll(pairRegex, block);
    
        for (const pairMatch of pairs) {
          const [, cssVar, value] = pairMatch;
          const mapping = vibeOverrideMap[cssVar];
          if (!mapping) continue;
    
          const tokenType = inferType(mapping.category, value);
          const token: DtcgToken = {
            $value: isNumericValue(value) ? Number(value) : value,
            $type: tokenType,
          };
    
          const fullPath = [mapping.category, ...mapping.path];
          tokens = setNestedValue(tokens, fullPath, token);
        }
    
        return tokens;
      }
    
      return {
        transacting: extractVibeSet("transacting"),
        presenting: extractVibeSet("presenting"),
      };
    }
    function inferType(category: string, value: string): string {
      switch (category) {
        case "spacing":
        case "radius":
          return "dimension";
        case "font":
          return isNumericValue(value) ? "fontWeight" : "dimension";
        default:
          return "other";
      }
    }
    function isNumericValue(value: string): boolean {
      return /^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(value);
    }
    function main() {
      const rootDir = process.cwd();
      const tokensDir = path.join(rootDir, "src/tokens");
      const providersDir = path.join(rootDir, "src/providers");
      const outPath = path.join(rootDir, "figma-tokens.json");
    
      // 1. Read DTCG JSON sources (already in correct format)
      const colorsLight = readJson(path.join(tokensDir, "colors.json"));
      const colorsDark = readJson(path.join(tokensDir, "colors.dark.json"));
      assertTokenParity(colorsLight, colorsDark);
      const typography = readJson(path.join(tokensDir, "typography.json"));
      const spacing = readJson(path.join(tokensDir, "spacing.json"));
    
      // 2. Parse CSS-only tokens
      const radius = readRadiusTokens(tokensDir);
      const shadows = readShadowTokens(tokensDir);
    
      // 3. Parse vibe overrides
      const vibes = readVibeOverrides(providersDir);
    
      // 4. Assemble token sets
      const tokenSets: FigmaTokenSets = {
        // Color modes (light/dark)
        "rialto/light": {
          ...colorsLight,
          ...shadows.light,
        },
        "rialto/dark": {
          ...colorsDark,
          ...shadows.dark,
        },
    
        // Base tokens (default vibe)
        "rialto/default": {
          ...typography,
          ...spacing,
          ...radius,
          ...shadows.shared,
        },
    
        // Vibe overrides (only include tokens that differ from default)
        "rialto/transacting": vibes.transacting,
        "rialto/presenting": vibes.presenting,
      };
    
      // 5. Write output
      const output = JSON.stringify(tokenSets, null, 2) + "\n";
      fs.writeFileSync(outPath, output);
    
      // Report stats
      const setNames = Object.keys(tokenSets);
      const totalTokens = setNames.reduce((sum, name) => sum + countTokens(tokenSets[name]), 0);
      console.info(`Generated figma-tokens.json: ${totalTokens} tokens across ${setNames.length} sets`);
      for (const name of setNames) {
        console.info(`  ${name}: ${countTokens(tokenSets[name])} tokens`);
      }
    }
    function countTokens(group: TokenGroup): number {
      let count = 0;
      for (const value of Object.values(group)) {
        if (value && typeof value === "object" && "$value" in value) {
          count++;
        } else if (value && typeof value === "object") {
          count += countTokens(value as TokenGroup);
        }
      }
      return count;
    }

    export interface LibEntry {
      /** Subpath segment after the package name, e.g. "Button" or "." for root. */
      subpath: string;
      /** Absolute path to the source entry. */
      source: string;
      /** Vite/Rollup chunk name (without extension). */
      chunkName: string;
    }
    function listComponentEntries(): LibEntry[] {
      const dirents = fs.readdirSync(componentsDir, { withFileTypes: true });
      const entries: LibEntry[] = [];
      for (const dirent of dirents) {
        if (!dirent.isDirectory()) continue;
        if (dirent.name.startsWith("_") || dirent.name.startsWith(".")) continue;
        const indexPath = path.join(componentsDir, dirent.name, "index.ts");
        if (!fs.existsSync(indexPath)) continue;
        entries.push({
          subpath: dirent.name,
          source: indexPath,
          // chunkName drives the emitted JS path. Putting it inside the
          // component's own folder (alongside the d.ts files emitted by
          // vite-plugin-dts) prevents TypeScript bundler resolution from
          // ever finding a sibling `.js` with no adjacent `.d.ts`.
          chunkName: `components/${dirent.name}/index`,
        });
      }
      entries.sort((a, b) => a.subpath.localeCompare(b.subpath));
      return entries;
    }
    export const RIALTO_LOCALE_TAGS = ["en-GB", "es-MX", "fr-CA"] as const;
    export const libEntries: LibEntry[] = [
      // Root barrel — preserved for back-compat with `import { x } from "@.../rialto"`.
      {
        subpath: ".",
        source: path.join(repoRoot, "src/lib-entry.ts"),
        chunkName: "rialto",
      },
      // Pre-existing motion subpath.
      {
        subpath: "motion",
        source: path.join(repoRoot, "src/tokens/motion.ts"),
        chunkName: "motion",
      },
      // Providers subpath — RialtoProvider, useDeviceContext, vibes, etc.
      // chunkName uses /index so the emitted JS lands inside the same folder
      // as vite-plugin-dts's d.ts output (dist/lib/providers/) and TypeScript
      // bundler resolution finds the d.ts via folder fallback.
      {
        subpath: "providers",
        source: path.join(repoRoot, "src/providers/index.ts"),
        chunkName: "providers/index",
      },
      // Hooks subpath. Same /index treatment as providers.
      {
        subpath: "hooks",
        source: path.join(repoRoot, "src/hooks/index.ts"),
        chunkName: "hooks/index",
      },
      ...localeEntries,
      ...componentEntries,
    ];
    export function viteEntryMap(): Record<string, string> {
      const out: Record<string, string> = {};
      for (const entry of libEntries) {
        out[entry.chunkName] = entry.source;
      }
      return out;
    }

    export interface BackfillSummary {
      apply: boolean;
      venues: number;
      counts: Record<string, number>;
      errors: { venueId: string; message: string }[];
      unrecognised: { venueId: string; reason: string }[];
    }
    type Log = (line: string) => void;
    export async function runBackfill(
      prisma: PrismaClient,
      options: { apply: boolean },
      log: Log
    ): Promise<BackfillSummary> {
      const venueIds = await getAllVenueIds(prisma);
      const counts: Record<string, number> = {};
      const errors: BackfillSummary["errors"] = [];
      const unrecognised: BackfillSummary["unrecognised"] = [];
    
      for (const venueId of venueIds) {
        try {
          const outcome: VenueMigrationOutcome = await migrateVenue(prisma, venueId, options);
          counts[outcome.outcome] = (counts[outcome.outcome] ?? 0) + 1;
          if (outcome.outcome === "unrecognised") {
            unrecognised.push({ venueId, reason: outcome.reason });
          }
          log(JSON.stringify(outcome));
        } catch (error) {
          const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
          errors.push({ venueId, message });
          log(JSON.stringify({ venueId, outcome: "error", message }));
        }
      }
      return { apply: options.apply, venues: venueIds.length, counts, errors, unrecognised };
    }
    async function main(): Promise<void> {
      const apply = process.argv.includes("--apply");
      const prisma = db.prisma as unknown as PrismaClient;
      try {
        const summary = await runBackfill(prisma, { apply }, (line) =>
          process.stdout.write(`${line}\n`)
        );
        process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ summary })}\n`);
        process.exitCode = summary.errors.length > 0 ? 1 : 0;
      } finally {
        await prisma.$disconnect();
      }
    }

    export const GEN_SPEC_CACHE_TTL_HOURS = 24;
    export interface GenSpecCacheKeyInput {
      readonly route: string;
      readonly messages: ReadonlyArray<{ readonly role: string; readonly content: string }>;
      readonly modelId: string;
      /**
       * The full system prompt. It embeds `catalog.prompt()`, so it changes whenever
       * the catalog does — derived from the catalog, never a hand-kept version.
       */
      readonly systemPrompt: string;
      readonly maxOutputTokens: number;
    }
    export function genSpecCacheKey(input: GenSpecCacheKeyInput): string {
      // JSON framing keeps field and message boundaries unambiguous.
      const payload = JSON.stringify([
        input.route,
        input.modelId,
        createHash("sha256").update(input.systemPrompt).digest("hex"),
        input.maxOutputTokens,
        input.messages.map((m) => [m.role, normalize(m.content)]),
      ]);
      return createHash("sha256").update(payload).digest("hex");
    }
    export async function getCachedSpec(key: string): Promise<unknown[] | null> {
      const rows = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ lines: unknown[] }>>`
        SELECT lines FROM gen_spec_cache
        WHERE key = ${key}
          AND created_at > now() - make_interval(hours => ${GEN_SPEC_CACHE_TTL_HOURS}::int)`;
      return rows[0]?.lines ?? null;
    }
    export async function putCachedSpec(key: string, lines: unknown[]): Promise<void> {
      await prisma.$executeRaw`
        INSERT INTO gen_spec_cache (key, lines, created_at)
        VALUES (${key}, ${JSON.stringify(lines)}::jsonb, now())
        ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET lines = EXCLUDED.lines, created_at = now()`;
      await prisma.$executeRaw`
        DELETE FROM gen_spec_cache
        WHERE created_at <= now() - make_interval(hours => ${GEN_SPEC_CACHE_TTL_HOURS}::int)`;
    }

    export const GEN_DAILY_CEILING_DEFAULT_USD = 0.5;
    export function resolveGenDailyCeilingUsd(raw: string | undefined): number {
      if (raw === undefined || raw.trim() === "") return GEN_DAILY_CEILING_DEFAULT_USD;
      const value = Number(raw);
      return Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 ? value : GEN_DAILY_CEILING_DEFAULT_USD;
    }
    export function getGenDailyCeilingUsd(): number {
      return resolveGenDailyCeilingUsd(process.env.GEN_DAILY_CEILING_USD);
    }
    export function genCostMicroUsd(
      usage: Parameters<typeof cacheTokens>[0],
      providerMetadata: unknown
    ): number {
      const { read, write } = cacheTokens(usage, providerMetadata);
      const fresh = Math.max(0, (usage.inputTokens ?? 0) - read - write);
      const usd =
        (fresh * GEN_PRICING.input +
          read * GEN_PRICING.cacheRead +
          write * GEN_PRICING.cacheWrite +
          (usage.outputTokens ?? 0) * GEN_PRICING.output) /
        1_000_000;
      return Math.round(usd * 1_000_000);
    }
    function windowDate(now: Date): string {
      return now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

    export function secondsUntilNextWindow(now: Date = new Date()): number {
      const next = Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), now.getUTCDate() + 1);
      return Math.max(1, Math.ceil((next - now.getTime()) / 1000));
    }

    export interface LivenessMonitorConfig {
      inactivityThresholdMs: number;
      checkIntervalMs: number;
      sessionService: {
        findStaleSessions(ms: number): Promise<string[]>;
        addEvent(id: string, type: string, payload: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<unknown>;
      };
      cancelSession: (id: string) => Promise<boolean>;
    }
    export interface LivenessMonitor {
      start(logger: FastifyBaseLogger): void;
      stop(): void;
    }
    export function createLivenessMonitor(config: LivenessMonitorConfig): LivenessMonitor {
      const { inactivityThresholdMs, checkIntervalMs, sessionService, cancelSession } = config;
    
      let intervalHandle: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
      let activeLogger: FastifyBaseLogger | null = null;
    
      async function checkStaleSessions(): Promise<void> {
        try {
          const staleSessionIds = await sessionService.findStaleSessions(inactivityThresholdMs);
    
          const results = await Promise.allSettled(
            staleSessionIds.map(async (sessionId) => {
              activeLogger?.warn(
                `[liveness] Session ${sessionId} exceeded inactivity threshold — auto-cancelling`
              );
    
              const cancelled = await cancelSession(sessionId);
              if (cancelled) {
                await sessionService.addEvent(sessionId, "session:error", {
                  message: `Auto-cancelled: exceeded inactivity threshold (${inactivityThresholdMs / 1000}s)`,
                  reason: "liveness_timeout",
                });
              }
            })
          );
    
          results.forEach((result, index) => {
            if (result.status === "rejected") {
              activeLogger?.error(
                { err: result.reason, sessionId: staleSessionIds[index] },
                `[liveness] Failed to process stale session ${staleSessionIds[index]}`
              );
            }
          });
        } catch (error) {
          activeLogger?.error({ err: error }, "[liveness] Error checking stale sessions");
        }
      }
    
      return {
        start(logger: FastifyBaseLogger): void {
          if (intervalHandle) return;
          activeLogger = logger;
          intervalHandle = setInterval(() => void checkStaleSessions(), checkIntervalMs);
          logger.info(
            `[liveness] Monitor started (check every ${checkIntervalMs / 1000}s, timeout ${inactivityThresholdMs / 1000}s)`
          );
        },
    
        stop(): void {
          if (intervalHandle) {
            clearInterval(intervalHandle);
            intervalHandle = null;
            activeLogger?.info("[liveness] Monitor stopped");
            activeLogger = null;
          }
        },
      };
    }

  <file path="services/agent/src/services/remediation-circuit-breaker.ts">
    interface CircuitState {
      consecutiveFailures: number;
      lastFailureAt: number | null;
      isOpen: boolean;
      openedAt: number | null;
    }
    export interface CircuitCheckResult {
      readonly allowed: boolean;
      readonly reason?: string;
    }
    export interface CircuitBreaker {
      check(): CircuitCheckResult;
      recordOutcome(succeeded: boolean): void;
    }
    export function createCircuitBreaker(opts?: {
      failureThreshold?: number;
      resetAfterMs?: number;
    }): CircuitBreaker {
      const failureThreshold = opts?.failureThreshold ?? DEFAULT_FAILURE_THRESHOLD;
      const resetAfterMs = opts?.resetAfterMs ?? DEFAULT_RESET_AFTER_MS;
    
      const state: CircuitState = {
        consecutiveFailures: 0,
        lastFailureAt: null,
        isOpen: false,
        openedAt: null,
      };
    
      return {
        check(): CircuitCheckResult {
          if (!state.isOpen) {
            return { allowed: true };
          }
    
          const elapsed = Date.now() - (state.openedAt ?? 0);
          if (elapsed > resetAfterMs) {
            // Half-open: allow one attempt to see if things recovered
            state.isOpen = false;
            state.consecutiveFailures = 0;
            return { allowed: true };
          }
    
          return {
            allowed: false,
            reason: `Circuit open — ${state.consecutiveFailures} consecutive remediation failures. Resets in ${Math.ceil((resetAfterMs - elapsed) / 60_000)} min.`,
          };
        },
    
        recordOutcome(succeeded: boolean): void {
          if (succeeded) {
            state.consecutiveFailures = 0;
            state.isOpen = false;
            state.openedAt = null;
          } else {
            state.consecutiveFailures++;
            state.lastFailureAt = Date.now();
            if (state.consecutiveFailures >= failureThreshold) {
              state.isOpen = true;
              state.openedAt = Date.now();
            }
          }
        },
      };
    }
    export function checkCircuitBreaker(): CircuitCheckResult {
      return defaultBreaker.check();
    }
    export function recordRemediationOutcome(succeeded: boolean): void {
      defaultBreaker.recordOutcome(succeeded);
    }

  <file path="services/agent/src/services/session-concurrency.ts">
    export interface SessionConcurrency {
      /** The configured maximum number of concurrent sessions. */
      readonly limit: number;
      /** True when a new session could be admitted right now (no reservation). */
      canStart(): boolean;
      /**
       * Atomically reserve a slot for `sessionId`. Returns true if the slot was
       * granted (or already held by this id), false if at capacity. Idempotent for
       * an id that already holds a slot — never consumes a second slot.
       */
      acquire(sessionId: string): boolean;
      /** Release the slot held by `sessionId`. No-op if it holds none. */
      release(sessionId: string): void;
      /** Number of currently reserved slots. */
      activeCount(): number;
    }
    export function createSessionConcurrency(limit: number): SessionConcurrency {
      const active = new Set<string>();
    
      return {
        limit,
        canStart() {
          return active.size < limit;
        },
        acquire(sessionId: string) {
          if (active.has(sessionId)) return true;
          if (active.size >= limit) return false;
          active.add(sessionId);
          return true;
        },
        release(sessionId: string) {
          active.delete(sessionId);
        },
        activeCount() {
          return active.size;
        },
      };
    }
    export function resolveConcurrencyLimit(): number {
      return parseInt(process.env.MAX_CONCURRENT_SESSIONS ?? "5", 10);
    }
    export const defaultConcurrency: SessionConcurrency =
      createSessionConcurrency(resolveConcurrencyLimit());
  </file>
  <file path="services/agent/src/services/session-event-emitter.ts">
    export type SessionEventListener = (event: AgentSessionEvent) => void;
    export interface SessionEventEmitter {
      /** Publish a persisted event to all subscribers of its session. */
      publish(event: AgentSessionEvent): void;
      /**
       * Subscribe to live events for a session.
       * @returns an unsubscribe function.
       */
      subscribe(sessionId: string, listener: SessionEventListener): () => void;
    }
    export class InProcessSessionEventEmitter implements SessionEventEmitter {
      private readonly emitter = new EventEmitter();
    
      constructor() {
        // SSE fan-out can exceed the default 10-listener warning threshold.
        this.emitter.setMaxListeners(0);
      }
    
      publish(event: AgentSessionEvent): void {
        this.emitter.emit(event.sessionId, event);
      }
    
      subscribe(sessionId: string, listener: SessionEventListener): () => void {
        this.emitter.on(sessionId, listener);
        return () => {
          this.emitter.off(sessionId, listener);
        };
      }
    }
    export function getSessionEventEmitter(): SessionEventEmitter {
      return sessionEventEmitter;
    }
    export function setSessionEventEmitter(emitter: SessionEventEmitter): void {
      sessionEventEmitter = emitter;
    }

    export interface SessionExecutorConfig {
      /** The single gate that owns the max-concurrent-sessions policy. */
      concurrency: SessionConcurrency;
      /** Persistence seam; the Prisma-backed store in production. */
      store: SessionLifecycleStore;
    }
    export interface SessionExecutor {
      executeSession(session: AgentSession): Promise<void>;
      cancelSession(sessionId: string): Promise<boolean>;
      getActiveSessionCount(): number;
    }
    export function createSessionExecutor(config: SessionExecutorConfig): SessionExecutor {
      const { concurrency, store } = config;
    
      const orchestrator = createSessionLifecycleOrchestrator({
        store,
        resolveRepoPath: () => resolve(process.env.REPO_PATH ?? process.cwd()),
        runSession,
        concurrency,
        projectEvent,
        // Live-bound so the real Fastify logger — wired in later at boot via
        // setServiceLogger — is used even though this orchestrator may be
        // constructed before that happens (the default executor is lazy).
        logger: { error: (meta, message) => getServiceLogger().error(meta, message) },
      });
    
      return {
        async executeSession(session: AgentSession): Promise<void> {
          await orchestrator.execute(session.id);
        },
        cancelSession(sessionId: string): Promise<boolean> {
          return orchestrator.cancel(sessionId);
        },
        getActiveSessionCount(): number {
          return orchestrator.getActiveSessionCount();
        },
      };
    }
    function defaultExecutor(): SessionExecutor {
      _defaultExecutor ??= createSessionExecutor({
        concurrency: defaultConcurrency,
        store: sessionLifecycleStore,
      });
      return _defaultExecutor;
    }
    export const getActiveSessionCount = (): number => defaultExecutor().getActiveSessionCount();
    export const executeSession = (session: AgentSession): Promise<void> =>
      defaultExecutor().executeSession(session);
    export const cancelSession = (sessionId: string): Promise<boolean> =>
      defaultExecutor().cancelSession(sessionId);

    function toPrismaStatus(status: LifecycleStatus): PrismaSessionStatus {
      return status.toUpperCase() as PrismaSessionStatus;
    }
    function toStoredSession(row: Session): StoredSession {
      return {
        id: row.id,
        status: row.status.toLowerCase() as LifecycleStatus,
        taskDescription: row.taskDescription,
        baseBranch: row.baseBranch,
        model: row.model,
        maxTurns: row.maxTurns,
        maxBudgetUsd: row.maxBudgetUsd,
        createPr: row.createPr,
        userId: row.userId,
        parentId: row.parentId,
        branchName: row.branchName,
        prUrl: row.prUrl,
        prNumber: row.prNumber,
        resultText: row.resultText,
        costUsd: row.costUsd ?? undefined,
        inputTokens: row.inputTokens ?? undefined,
        outputTokens: row.outputTokens ?? undefined,
        numTurns: row.numTurns ?? undefined,
        durationMs: row.durationMs ?? undefined,
        errors: (row.errors as string[]) ?? [],
        sdkSessionId: row.sdkSessionId,
      };

    export const sessionLifecycleStore: SessionLifecycleStore = {
      async create(input: CreateSessionInput): Promise<StoredSession> {
        const row = await prisma.session.create({
          data: {
            taskDescription: input.taskDescription,
            ...(input.baseBranch !== undefined && { baseBranch: input.baseBranch }),
            ...(input.model !== undefined && { model: input.model }),
            ...(input.maxTurns !== undefined && { maxTurns: input.maxTurns }),
            ...(input.maxBudgetUsd !== undefined && { maxBudgetUsd: input.maxBudgetUsd }),
            ...(input.createPr !== undefined && { createPr: input.createPr }),
            ...(input.userId != null && { userId: input.userId }),
            ...(input.parentId != null && { parentId: input.parentId }),
          },
        });
        return toStoredSession(row);
      },
    
      async getById(id: string): Promise<StoredSession | null> {
        const row = await prisma.session.findUnique({ where: { id } });
        return row ? toStoredSession(row) : null;
      },
    
      async updateStatus(
        id: string,
        status: LifecycleStatus,
        patch?: SessionResultPatch,
        opts?: { readonly fromStatus?: readonly LifecycleStatus[] }
      ): Promise<StoredSession | null> {
        const prismaStatus = toPrismaStatus(status);
        const now = new Date();
        const data = {
          status: prismaStatus,
          ...(prismaStatus === "RUNNING" && { startedAt: now }),
          ...(["SUCCEEDED", "FAILED", "CANCELLED"].includes(prismaStatus) && { completedAt: now }),
          ...(patch?.branchName !== undefined && { branchName: patch.branchName }),
          ...(patch?.prUrl !== undefined && { prUrl: patch.prUrl }),
          ...(patch?.prNumber !== undefined && { prNumber: patch.prNumber }),
          ...(patch?.resultText !== undefined && { resultText: patch.resultText }),
          ...(patch?.costUsd !== undefined && { costUsd: patch.costUsd }),
          ...(patch?.inputTokens !== undefined && { inputTokens: patch.inputTokens }),
          ...(patch?.outputTokens !== undefined && { outputTokens: patch.outputTokens }),
          ...(patch?.numTurns !== undefined && { numTurns: patch.numTurns }),
          ...(patch?.durationMs !== undefined && { durationMs: patch.durationMs }),
          ...(patch?.errors !== undefined && { errors: [...patch.errors] }),
          ...(patch?.sdkSessionId !== undefined && { sdkSessionId: patch.sdkSessionId }),
        };
    
        if (opts?.fromStatus) {
          // Compare-and-swap: scope the update to rows still in an expected prior
          // status so the DB enforces the transition. A 0-row update means the
          // CAS lost the race (e.g. the session already reached a terminal
          // state) — signal that with null instead of clobbering.
          const { count } = await prisma.session.updateMany({
            where: { id, status: { in: opts.fromStatus.map(toPrismaStatus) } },
            data,
          });
          if (count === 0) return null;
          const row = await prisma.session.findUnique({ where: { id } });
          return row ? toStoredSession(row) : null;
        }
    
        try {
          const row = await prisma.session.update({ where: { id }, data });
          return toStoredSession(row);
        } catch (err: unknown) {
          if (isPrismaNotFound(err)) return null;
          throw err;
        }
      },
    
      async addEvent(id: string, type: string, data: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<void> {
        const event = await prisma.sessionEvent.create({
          data: { sessionId: id, type, data: data as Prisma.InputJsonValue },
        });
        // Publish on the seam so SSE subscribers receive it live, without polling.
        getSessionEventEmitter().publish(mapPrismaEvent(event));
      },
    };

    export interface TriggerSessionOptions {
      taskDescription: string;
      baseBranch?: string;
      userId?: string;
      model?: string;
      maxTurns?: number;
      maxBudgetUsd?: number;
      createPr?: boolean;
      parentId?: string;
      onSettled?: (success: boolean) => void | Promise<void>;
    }
    export interface TriggerSessionResult {
      session: AgentSession | null;
      accepted: boolean;
    }
    export async function triggerSession(opts: TriggerSessionOptions): Promise<TriggerSessionResult> {
      // Early-reject through the single concurrency gate so we never create a DB
      // row for a session that can't start. The executor performs the atomic
      // acquire(); this check just avoids the wasted write on an obvious reject.
      if (!defaultConcurrency.canStart()) {
        return { session: null, accepted: false };
      }
    
      const wrappedTask = `<task>\n${opts.taskDescription}\n</task>`;
    
      const session = await sessionService.create({
        taskDescription: wrappedTask,
        baseBranch: opts.baseBranch,
        userId: opts.userId,
        model: opts.model,
        maxTurns: opts.maxTurns,
        maxBudgetUsd: opts.maxBudgetUsd,
        createPr: opts.createPr,
        parentId: opts.parentId,
      });
    
      executeSession(session)
        .then(() => opts.onSettled?.(true))
        .catch((err) => {
          void opts.onSettled?.(false);
          getServiceLogger().error({ sessionId: session.id, err }, "triggerSession execution failed");
        });
    
      return { session, accepted: true };
    }

      async findStaleSessions(thresholdMs: number): Promise<string[]> {
        const thresholdSeconds = Math.floor(thresholdMs / 1000);
        const rows = await prisma.$queryRaw<{ id: string }[]>`
          SELECT s.id
            FROM sessions s
           WHERE s.status = 'RUNNING'
             AND COALESCE(
                   (SELECT MAX(e.created_at) FROM session_events e WHERE e.session_id = s.id),
                   s.updated_at
                 ) < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 second' * ${thresholdSeconds}
           ORDER BY s.updated_at ASC
        `;
        return rows.map((r) => r.id);
      },

          where,
          orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
          take: EVENTS_PAGE_SIZE,
        });
    
        return events.map(mapPrismaEvent);
      },

    function truncate(text: string, maxLen: number): string {
      if (text.length <= maxLen) return text;
      return text.slice(0, maxLen - 1) + "…";
    }
    function summarizeToolInput(input: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
      const summary: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    
      if (typeof input.file_path === "string") {
        summary.file_path = input.file_path;
      }
    
      if (typeof input.command === "string") {
        summary.command = truncate(input.command, 200);
      }
    
      if (typeof input.pattern === "string") {
        summary.pattern = input.pattern;
      }
    
      if (typeof input.path === "string" && !("file_path" in summary)) {
        summary.path = input.path;
      }
    
      return summary;
    }
    export function mapForStorage(event: MappedEvent): { type: string; data: Record<string, unknown> } {
      if (event.type === "session:tool_use") {
        return {
          type: event.type,
          data: {
            toolName: event.toolName,
            toolInput: summarizeToolInput(event.toolInput),
          },
        };
      }
    
      if (event.type === "session:assistant") {
        // Per-event projection: agent-core emits one AssistantTextEvent per text block,
        // so each is stored separately (no coalescing of blocks within a message). This is
        // an intentional granularity change from the old SDK-message-level text join.
        return {
          type: event.type,
          data: {
            textPreview: truncate(event.text, 200),
          },
        };
      }
    
      if (event.type === "session:tool_result") {
        return {
          type: event.type,
          data: {
            toolUseId: event.toolUseId,
            isError: event.isError,
          },
        };
      }
    
      // session:turn_metrics — pass through all fields
      return {
        type: event.type,
        data: { ...event },
      };
    }
    export const projectEvent: EventProjector = (event: SessionEvent) => {
      const eventData = event.data as { message?: string };
      if (typeof eventData.message === "string") {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(eventData.message) as MappedEvent;
          if (parsed && typeof parsed.type === "string" && parsed.type.startsWith("session:")) {
            return mapForStorage(parsed);
          }
        } catch {
          // Not JSON — fall through to plain message storage.
        }
      }
      return { type: event.type, data: event.data };
    };

    async function _enforceCapForUser(userId: string): Promise<void> {
      const unfavoritedCount = await prisma.storedSpec.count({
        where: { userId, isFavorite: false },
      });
    
      if (unfavoritedCount >= CAP_UNFAVORITED) {
        const oldest = await prisma.storedSpec.findFirst({
          where: { userId, isFavorite: false },
          orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
          select: { id: true },
        });
    
        if (oldest) {
          await prisma.storedSpec.delete({ where: { id: oldest.id } });
        }
      }
    }
    export const storedSpecService = {
      async list(userId: string): Promise<StoredSpec[]> {
        return prisma.storedSpec.findMany({
          where: { userId },
          orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
          take: 100,
        });
      },
    
      async getById(id: string): Promise<StoredSpec | null> {
        return prisma.storedSpec.findUnique({ where: { id } });
      },
    
      async create(data: {
        userId: string;
        prompt: string;
        kind: string;
        spec: unknown;
        rawLines: unknown;
        refinement?: SpecRefinement;
      }): Promise<StoredSpec> {
        const parentId = data.refinement?.parentId;
        if (parentId) {
          const parent = await prisma.storedSpec.findUnique({ where: { id: parentId } });
          if (!parent || parent.userId !== data.userId) {
            throw new Error("Not found");
          }
        }
    
        await _enforceCapForUser(data.userId);
    
        return prisma.storedSpec.create({
          data: {
            userId: data.userId,
            prompt: data.prompt,
            kind: data.kind,
            spec: data.spec as Prisma.InputJsonValue,
            rawLines: data.rawLines as Prisma.InputJsonValue,
            ...(data.refinement && { refinement: data.refinement as unknown as Prisma.InputJsonValue }),
          },
        });
      },
    
      async toggleFavorite(id: string, userId: string): Promise<StoredSpec> {
        const existing = await prisma.storedSpec.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    
        if (!existing || existing.userId !== userId) {
          throw new Error("Not found");
        }
    
        return prisma.storedSpec.update({
          where: { id },
          data: { isFavorite: !existing.isFavorite },
        });
      },
    
      async delete(id: string, userId: string): Promise<void> {
        const existing = await prisma.storedSpec.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    
        if (!existing || existing.userId !== userId) {
          throw new Error("Not found");
        }
    
        await prisma.storedSpec.delete({ where: { id } });
      },
    
      _enforceCapForUser,
    };

    export interface DeliveryDedupStore {
      /**
       * Claims `id` for processing. Returns true the first time an id is seen
       * (caller should process the delivery) and false on any replay within the
       * retention window (caller must treat it as a no-op).
       */
      claim(id: string): boolean;
    }
    export function createDeliveryDedupStore(retentionMs = DEFAULT_RETENTION_MS): DeliveryDedupStore {
      const seenAt = new Map<string, number>();
    
      function prune(now: number): void {
        for (const [id, ts] of seenAt) {
          if (now - ts > retentionMs) seenAt.delete(id);
        }
      }
    
      return {
        claim(id: string): boolean {
          const now = Date.now();
          prune(now);
          if (seenAt.has(id)) return false;
          seenAt.set(id, now);
          return true;
        },
      };
    }
    export const defaultDeliveryDedupStore: DeliveryDedupStore = createDeliveryDedupStore();

  <file path="services/reservations/src/services/assert-bookable.ts">
    export type BookableError =
      | { code: "PARTY_DOES_NOT_FIT"; message: string }
      | { code: "CONFLICT"; message: string }
      | { code: "PACING_EXCEEDED"; message: string };
    export interface AssertBookableOptions {
      /** Table being checked for conflict. */
      tableId: string;
      /**
       * The table's party-fit fields. Pass it wherever the caller names the table
       * (the server-picked path already filters by fit): the party must satisfy
       * partyFitsTable. Omit only when fit was settled earlier (hold confirmation,
       * whose hold was fit-checked at creation).
       */
      table?: PartyFitTable;
      /** Window to check — [startTime, endTime). */
      window: { startTime: Date; endTime: Date };
      /** Party size to add when computing pacing. */
      partySize: number;
      /** Venue pacing settings. */
      settings: VenueSettings | null | undefined;
      /** Pre-fetched reservation slices for the date. */
      reservations: ReservationSlim[];
      /** Pre-fetched hold slices for the date. */
      holds: HoldSlim[];
      /** Exclude this hold ID from conflict checks (used during confirmation). */
      excludeHoldId?: string;
      /** Exclude this session ID's holds from conflict checks (used during hold create). */
      excludeSessionId?: string;
    }
    export function assertBookable(opts: AssertBookableOptions): BookableError | undefined {
      const {
        tableId,
        window: { startTime, endTime },
        partySize,
        settings,
        holds,
        excludeHoldId,
        excludeSessionId,
      } = opts;
    
      if (opts.table && !partyFitsTable(opts.table, partySize)) {
        return {
          code: "PARTY_DOES_NOT_FIT",
          message: `Party size ${partySize} does not fit this table`,
        };
      }
    
      // Filter out the excluded hold so self-conflict is not flagged during confirmation.
      const filteredHolds = holds.filter((h) => {
        if (excludeHoldId !== undefined && h.id === excludeHoldId) return false;
        if (excludeSessionId !== undefined) {
          // Holds don't carry sessionId in the slim shape; this filter is a no-op
          // for the slim type but satisfies the contract — callers that need
          // session exclusion pass pre-filtered slices.
        }
        return true;
      });
    
      const hasConflict = checkTableConflict(
        tableId,
        startTime,
        endTime,
        opts.reservations,
        filteredHolds
      );
      if (hasConflict) {
        return { code: "CONFLICT", message: "Table is not available for this time slot" };
      }
    
      const pacingOk = checkPacingForSlot(
        startTime,
        partySize,
        settings,
        opts.reservations,
        filteredHolds
      );
      if (!pacingOk) {
        const maxCovers = settings?.pacingRules?.[0]?.maxCoversPerSlot;
        return {
          code: "PACING_EXCEEDED",
          message: `Pacing limit reached. Maximum ${maxCovers} covers per time window.`,
        };
      }
    
      return undefined;
    }
    export type GateRejection =
      | { code: "outside-availability"; reason: HardReason; message?: string }
      | { code: "soft-limit"; limits: SoftLimit[] };
    export type GateOutcome =
      | { kind: "ok"; overrideLimits?: SoftLimit[] }
      | { kind: "conflict" }
      | { kind: "rejected"; rejection: GateRejection };
    export interface GateRequest {
      venueId: string;
      /** Omit to ask whether any table is free (the staff check endpoint). */
      tableId?: string;
      start: Date;
      /** The booking's real end. Without it the engine estimates one from the party size. */
      end?: Date;
      partySize: number;
      /** Guests book `online`; staff create and update are `phone`. Walk-ins are never gated. */
      channel: BookingChannel;
      /** A staff reason to pass a soft limit. Honoured on the phone channel only; closures never yield. */
      override?: { reason: string };
      /** The reservation being moved; it must not conflict or pace against itself. */
      excludeReservationId?: string;
      /** The hold being confirmed or moved onto. */
      excludeHoldId?: string;
      /** The caller's own session, whose holds a new hold replaces. */
      excludeSessionId?: string;
    }
    type GateDb = NonNullable<LoadSnapshotOptions["db"]>;
    async function excludedHoldIds(db: GateDb, request: GateRequest): Promise<Set<string>> {
      const ids = new Set(request.excludeHoldId ? [request.excludeHoldId] : []);
      if (request.excludeSessionId === undefined) return ids;
      const own = await db.reservationHold.findMany({
        where: { venueId: request.venueId, sessionId: request.excludeSessionId },
        select: { id: true },
      });
      return new Set([...ids, ...own.map((h) => h.id)]);
    }
    function withoutExcluded(
      snapshot: BookingSnapshot,
      reservationId: string | undefined,
      holdIds: Set<string>
    ): BookingSnapshot {
      return {
        ...snapshot,
        reservations: snapshot.reservations.filter((r) => r.id !== reservationId),
        holds: snapshot.holds.filter((h) => !holdIds.has(h.id)),
      };
    }
    export async function judgeBooking(
      db: GateDb,
      request: GateRequest,
      now: Date = new Date(),
      logger: SnapshotLogger = CONSOLE_LOGGER
    ): Promise<GateOutcome> {
      const venue = await db.venue.findUnique({
        where: { id: request.venueId },
        select: { ianaTimezone: true },
      });
      const day = localDateTimeOf(request.start, venue?.ianaTimezone ?? "UTC").date;
      const [loaded, holdIds] = await Promise.all([
        loadAvailabilitySnapshot(request.venueId, addDays(day, -1), day, now, { db }),
        excludedHoldIds(db, request),
      ]);
      const snapshot = withoutExcluded(loaded.snapshot, request.excludeReservationId, holdIds);
      const verdict = judge(
        snapshot,
        {
          start: request.start,
          end: request.end,
          partySize: request.partySize,
          channel: request.channel,
          tableId: request.tableId,
          override: request.override,
        },
        now
      );
      const staffOnUnsetHours =
        loaded.unconfigured &&
        request.channel === "phone" &&
        verdict.kind === "hard" &&
        verdict.reason === "outside_service";
      if (!staffOnUnsetHours) return outcomeOf(verdict);
      return unsetHoursStaffOutcome(snapshot, request, logger);
    }
    function outcomeOf(verdict: Verdict): GateOutcome {
      switch (verdict.kind) {
        case "ok":
          return { kind: "ok" };
        case "ok_with_override":
          return { kind: "ok", overrideLimits: verdict.limits };
        case "soft":
          return { kind: "rejected", rejection: { code: "soft-limit", limits: verdict.limits } };
        case "hard":
          if (verdict.reason === "conflict") return { kind: "conflict" };
          return outsideAvailability(verdict.reason, verdict.message);
      }
    }
    function outsideAvailability(reason: HardReason, message?: string): GateOutcome {
      return {
        kind: "rejected",
        rejection: { code: "outside-availability", reason, ...(message ? { message } : {}) },
      };
    }
    function blockingBand(
      snapshot: BookingSnapshot,
      serviceDate: string,
      minute: number,
      tableId: string | undefined
    ): { reason: HardReason; message?: string } | null {
      const day = resolveDay(snapshot, serviceDate);
      const band = day.closures.find(
        (b) =>
          b.from <= minute &&
          minute < b.to &&
          (b.targetKind === "venue" ||
            (b.targetKind === "booking" && (b.bookingTypes ?? []).includes("phone")) ||
            (b.targetKind === "tables" &&
              tableId !== undefined &&
              (b.tableIds ?? []).includes(tableId)))
      );
      if (!band) return null;
      const reason: HardReason =
        band.targetKind === "venue"
          ? "closed"
          : band.targetKind === "booking"
            ? "booking_closed"
            : "table_blocked";
      return { reason, ...(day.guestMessage ? { message: day.guestMessage } : {}) };
    }
    function unsetHoursStaffOutcome(
      snapshot: BookingSnapshot,
      request: GateRequest,
      logger: SnapshotLogger
    ): GateOutcome {
      const local = localDateTimeOf(request.start, snapshot.timezone);
      const block =
        blockingBand(snapshot, local.date, local.minute, request.tableId) ??
        blockingBand(
          snapshot,
          addDays(local.date, -1),
          local.minute + MINUTES_PER_DAY,
          request.tableId
        );
      if (block) return outsideAvailability(block.reason, block.message);
      logger.warn(
        { venueId: request.venueId, tableId: request.tableId, start: request.start.toISOString() },
        "booking_gate_no_hours_staff_allowed"
      );
      return { kind: "ok" };
    }
    export function rejectionDetail(rejection: GateRejection): string {
      if (rejection.code === "outside-availability") {
        return rejection.message ?? OUTSIDE_AVAILABILITY_DETAIL[rejection.reason];
      }
      return `This booking is ${rejection.limits.map((l) => SOFT_LIMIT_DETAIL[l]).join(" and ")}.`;
    }
    export function gateProblem(rejection: GateRejection): ProblemDetails {
      const detail = rejectionDetail(rejection);
      if (rejection.code === "outside-availability") {
        return createProblemDetails(422, "Outside Availability", detail, "about:blank", undefined, {
          code: rejection.code,
          reason: rejection.reason,
        });
      }
      return createProblemDetails(422, "Soft Limit", detail, "about:blank", undefined, {
        code: rejection.code,
        limits: rejection.limits,
      });
    }

    export const APP_RESERVATIONS_ROLE = "app_reservations";
    export interface AppRoleClient {

    }
    export function appRoleSetStatement(role: string = APP_RESERVATIONS_ROLE): string {
      if (!APP_ROLE_PATTERN.test(role)) {
        throw new Error(`refusing SET LOCAL ROLE for ${role}`);
      }
      return `SET LOCAL ROLE "${role}"`;
    }

    export const REVERT_KIND = "revert";
    function whereOf(
      venueId: string,
      query: AvailabilityChangesParsed
    ): Prisma.AvailabilityChangeWhereInput {
      return {
        venueId,
        ...(query.actorId ? { actorId: query.actorId } : {}),
        ...(query.kind ? { kind: query.kind } : {}),
        ...(query.from || query.to
          ? {
              at: {
                ...(query.from ? { gte: dayStart(query.from) } : {}),
                ...(query.to ? { lt: dayStart(addDays(query.to, 1)) } : {}),
              },
            }
          : {}),
      };
    }
    function newestInForce(db: Pick<StoreTx, "availabilityChange">, venueId: string) {
      return db.availabilityChange.findFirst({
        where: { venueId, revertedById: null, kind: { not: REVERT_KIND } },
        orderBy: [{ at: "desc" }, { id: "desc" }],
        select: { id: true },
      });
    }
    type StoreTx = Pick<PrismaClient, "venue" | "availabilityChange">;
    export async function listAvailabilityChanges(
      venueId: string,
      query: AvailabilityChangesParsed,
      client: StoreClient = prisma
    ): Promise<AvailabilityChangesPage | null> {
      return client.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        await setVenueContext(tx, venueId);
        const db = tx as unknown as StoreTx;
        const venue = await db.venue.findUnique({ where: { id: venueId }, select: { id: true } });
        if (!venue) return null;
        const where = whereOf(venueId, query);
        const [rows, total, newest] = await Promise.all([
          db.availabilityChange.findMany({
            where,
            orderBy: [{ at: "desc" }, { id: "desc" }],
            skip: query.offset,
            take: query.limit,
          }),
          db.availabilityChange.count({ where }),
          newestInForce(db, venueId),
        ]);
        const items: AvailabilityChangeEntry[] = rows.map((r) => ({
          id: r.id,
          actorId: r.actorId,
          at: r.at.toISOString(),
          kind: r.kind,
          summary: r.summary,
          affectedFrom: toDay(r.affectedFrom),
          affectedTo: toDay(r.affectedTo),
          notifiedGuests: r.notifiedGuests,
          revertedById: r.revertedById,
          revertible:
            r.id === newest?.id &&
            !r.notifiedGuests &&
            r.revertedById == null &&
            r.kind !== REVERT_KIND,
        }));
        return { total, offset: query.offset, items };
      });
    }
    export type RevertRefusalReason =
      "guests_notified" | "already_reverted" | "superseded" | "not_revertable";
    export type RevertOutcome =
      SaveOutcome | { kind: "change_not_found" } | { kind: "refused"; reason: RevertRefusalReason };
    function readInverse(value: unknown): ConfigInverse | null {
      if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null) return null;
      const v = value as Partial<ConfigInverse>;
      if (v.version !== 1 || typeof v.restore !== "object" || typeof v.remove !== "object") {
        return null;
      }
      const tables = CONFIG_TABLES.every(
        (t) => Array.isArray(v.restore?.[t]) && Array.isArray(v.remove?.[t])
      );
      return tables ? (v as ConfigInverse) : null;
    }
    export async function revertAvailabilityChange(
      input: {
        venueId: string;
        changeId: string;
        actorId: string;
        expectedVersion: number;
        now: Date;
      },
      client: StoreClient = prisma
    ): Promise<RevertOutcome> {
      const { venueId, changeId, actorId, expectedVersion, now } = input;
      return inSaveTransaction<SaveOutcome, RevertOutcome>(client, venueId, (tx) =>
        commitSave(tx, { venueId, actorId, expectedVersion, now }, async (state) => {
          const change = await tx.availabilityChange.findFirst({ where: { id: changeId, venueId } });
          if (!change) return refuseSave({ kind: "change_not_found" });
          if (change.revertedById) return refuseSave(refused("already_reverted"));
          if (change.kind === REVERT_KIND) return refuseSave(refused("not_revertable"));
          if (change.notifiedGuests) return refuseSave(refused("guests_notified"));
          const newest = await newestInForce(tx, venueId);
          if (newest?.id !== change.id) return refuseSave(refused("superseded"));
          const inverse = readInverse(change.inverse);
          if (!inverse) return refuseSave(refused("not_revertable"));
    
          const stored = new Set(state.stored.dateRules.map((r) => r.id));
          const restore = inverse.restore;
          return {
            changes: { upsert: restore, remove: inverse.remove },
            scopeConflicts: "keep",
            // The inverse is the exact prior state: no scope-conflict skips on top.
            exact: true,
            kind: REVERT_KIND,
            summary: `Reverted: ${change.summary}`,
            // The column exactly as it was (null included), so undoing a venue's first
            // save puts its hours back rather than projecting an empty week over them.
            operatingHours: inverse.operatingHours == null ? Prisma.DbNull : inverse.operatingHours,
            allowNoHours: true,
            revive: new Set(restore.dateRules.map((r) => r.id).filter((id) => !stored.has(id))),
            afterChange: async (db, revertId) => {
              await db.availabilityChange.update({
                where: { id: changeId },
                data: { revertedById: revertId },
              });
            },
          };
        })
      );
    }
    export const availabilityChangesService = {
      list: listAvailabilityChanges,
      revert: revertAvailabilityChange,
    };

    function resultOf(outcome: GateOutcome): AvailabilityCheckResult {
      switch (outcome.kind) {
        case "ok":
          return { kind: "ok" };
        case "conflict":
          return {
            kind: "hard",
            reason: "conflict",
            message: rejectionDetail({ code: "outside-availability", reason: "conflict" }),
          };
        case "rejected": {
          const { rejection } = outcome;
          const message = rejectionDetail(rejection);
          return rejection.code === "soft-limit"
            ? { kind: "soft", limits: rejection.limits, message }
            : { kind: "hard", reason: rejection.reason, message };
        }
      }
    }
    export async function checkAvailability(
      venueId: string,
      body: AvailabilityCheckBody,
      now: Date
    ): Promise<AvailabilityCheckResult> {
      const outcome = await judgeBooking(
        prisma,
        {
          venueId,
          tableId: body.tableId,
          start: new Date(body.start),
          end: body.end === undefined ? undefined : new Date(body.end),
          partySize: body.partySize,
          channel: body.channel,
        },
        now
      );
      return resultOf(outcome);
    }

    export interface BookedReservation {
      id: string;
      tableId: string | null;
      startTime: Date;
      partySize: number;
      /** The service date it belongs to; set where a scope needs it. */
      date?: Date;
    }
    type StrandReason = StrandedReservation["reason"];
    export function strandReason(
      snapshot: AvailabilitySnapshot,
      booking: BookedReservation
    ): StrandReason | null {
      // No inventory or other bookings: this asks only "is this time still served?",
      // so a conflict (no free table) is never mistaken for a stranding.
      const bare: BookingSnapshot = {
        ...snapshot,
        tables: [],
        reservations: [],
        holds: [],
        settings: null,
      };
      const verdict: Verdict = judge(
        bare,
        {
          start: booking.startTime,
          partySize: booking.partySize,
          channel: "phone",
          ...(booking.tableId ? { tableId: booking.tableId } : {}),
        },
        booking.startTime
      );
      return verdict.kind === "hard" && STRANDING.has(verdict.reason)
        ? (verdict.reason as StrandReason)
        : null;
    }
    export function findStrandedReservations(
      before: AvailabilitySnapshot,
      after: AvailabilitySnapshot,
      bookings: readonly BookedReservation[]
    ): StrandedReservation[] {
      return bookings.flatMap((booking) => {
        const reason = strandReason(after, booking);
        if (reason === null || strandReason(before, booking) !== null) return [];
        return [
          {
            id: booking.id,
            startTime: booking.startTime.toISOString(),
            partySize: booking.partySize,
            reason,
          },
        ];
      });
    }
    function dayLabel(config: AvailabilityConfig, day: ResolvedDay): string {
      const closedAllDay = day.closures.some(
        (c) => c.targetKind === "venue" && c.from <= 0 && c.to >= WHOLE_DAY_MINUTES
      );
      if (closedAllDay || day.services.length === 0) return "Closed";
      if (day.explanation.some((l) => l.kind === "special_hours")) return "Special hours";
      return config.schedules.find((s) => s.id === day.scheduleId)?.name ?? "Open";
    }
    export function summarizeDay(config: AvailabilityConfig, day: ResolvedDay): AvailabilityDaySummary {
      return {
        serviceDate: day.serviceDate,
        label: dayLabel(config, day),
        scheduleId: day.scheduleId,
        serviceCount: day.services.length,
        closures: day.closures.map(({ ruleId, targetKind, from, to }) => ({
          ruleId,
          targetKind,
          from,
          to,
        })),
        bookingOpen: day.bookingOpen,
        ...(day.guestMessage ? { guestMessage: day.guestMessage } : {}),
      };
    }

  <file path="services/reservations/src/services/availability-config-plan.ts">
    export type ConfigTable = keyof AvailabilityConfig;
    type Row<T extends ConfigTable> = AvailabilityConfig[T][number];
    type RowsByTable = { [T in ConfigTable]: AvailabilityConfig[T] };
    type IdsByTable = Record<ConfigTable, string[]>;
    export const CONFIG_TABLES: readonly ConfigTable[] = [
      "schedules",
      "venueServices",
      "scheduleServices",
      "assignments",
      "dateRules",
    ];
    export const SCOPE_CONFLICT_HORIZON_DAYS = 366;
    function canonical(value: unknown): string {
      if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(canonical).join(",")}]`;
      if (value !== null && typeof value === "object") {
        const entries = Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>)
          .filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== null)
          .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b));
        return `{${entries.map(([k, v]) => `${JSON.stringify(k)}:${canonical(v)}`).join(",")}}`;
      }
      return JSON.stringify(value);
    }
    function coversDate(rule: DateRule, date: string): boolean {
      return (
        rule.startsOn <= date &&
        (rule.endsOn == null || date <= rule.endsOn) &&
        (rule.repeat == null || rule.repeat.weekdays.includes(weekdayIndexOf(date)))
      );
    }
    function sharedDates(a: DateRule, b: DateRule): string[] {
      const from = a.startsOn > b.startsOn ? a.startsOn : b.startsOn;
      const ends = [a.endsOn, b.endsOn, addDays(from, SCOPE_CONFLICT_HORIZON_DAYS - 1)];
      const to = ends.filter((d): d is string => d != null).sort()[0]!;
      const dates: string[] = [];
      for (let d = from; d <= to; d = addDays(d, 1)) {
        if (coversDate(a, d) && coversDate(b, d)) dates.push(d);
      }
      return dates;
    }
    function newlyCoveredShared(rule: DateRule, prior: DateRule | undefined, theirs: DateRule) {
      const shared = sharedDates(rule, theirs);
      if (!prior || !sameRow(withoutRange(prior), withoutRange(rule))) return shared;
      return shared.filter((date) => !coversDate(prior, date));
    }
    type Skip = { seriesId: string; date: string };
    function editedSchedules(before: AvailabilityConfig, next: AvailabilityConfig): Set<string> {
      const touched = new Set<string>();
      for (const table of ["scheduleServices", "assignments"] as const) {
        const was = new Map(before[table].map((r) => [r.id, r]));
        const now = new Map(next[table].map((r) => [r.id, r]));
        for (const id of new Set([...was.keys(), ...now.keys()])) {
          const [a, b] = [was.get(id), now.get(id)];
          if (a && b && sameRow(a, b)) continue;
          if (a) touched.add(a.scheduleId);
          if (b) touched.add(b.scheduleId);
        }
      }
      return touched;
    }
    function scheduleEditSkips(
      before: AvailabilityConfig,
      next: AvailabilityConfig,
      stored: readonly DateRule[],
      today: string
    ): Skip[] {
      const edited = editedSchedules(before, next);
      if (edited.size === 0 || stored.length === 0) return [];
      // The week alone decides which schedule a date runs; date rules are set aside.
      // Resolved once per date of the window (2 x 366 calls whatever the rule
      // count): this runs inside the save transaction, with the venue row locked.
      const weeks = [before, next].map((config) => ({
        timezone: "UTC",
        config: { ...config, dateRules: [] },
      }));
      const last = addDays(today, SCOPE_CONFLICT_HORIZON_DAYS - 1);
      const inScope = new Set<string>();
      for (let d = today; d <= last; d = addDays(d, 1)) {
        const date = d;
        const ids = weeks.map((w) => resolveDay(w, date).scheduleId);
        if (ids.some((id) => id != null && edited.has(id))) inScope.add(date);
      }
      return stored.flatMap((rule) => {
        const from = rule.startsOn > today ? rule.startsOn : today;
        const to = rule.endsOn != null && rule.endsOn < last ? rule.endsOn : last;
        const skips: Skip[] = [];
        for (let d = from; d <= to; d = addDays(d, 1)) {
          if (inScope.has(d) && coversDate(rule, d)) skips.push({ seriesId: rule.id, date: d });
        }
        return skips;
      });
    }
    export function resolveScopeConflicts(
      before: AvailabilityConfig,
      next: AvailabilityConfig,
      mode: ScopeConflictMode,
      newId: () => string,
      today: string
    ): AvailabilityConfig {
      const stored = new Map(before.dateRules.map((r) => [r.id, r]));
      const hours = next.dateRules.filter(isHoursRule);
      const incoming = hours.filter((r) => !stored.has(r.id) || !sameRow(stored.get(r.id), r));
      const untouched = hours.filter((r) => stored.has(r.id) && sameRow(stored.get(r.id), r));
      const skipped = new Set(
        next.dateRules.filter((r) => r.kind === "skip").map((r) => `${r.seriesId}@${r.startsOn}`)
      );
    
      const skips: Skip[] = [
        ...incoming.flatMap((rule) =>
          untouched.flatMap((theirs) =>
            newlyCoveredShared(rule, stored.get(rule.id), theirs).map((date) => ({
              seriesId: mode === "keep" ? rule.id : theirs.id,
              date,
            }))
          )
        ),
        ...(mode === "replace" ? scheduleEditSkips(before, next, untouched, today) : []),
      ];
      const fresh = skips.filter(({ seriesId, date }) => {
        const key = `${seriesId}@${date}`;
        if (skipped.has(key)) return false;
        skipped.add(key);
        return true;
      });
      if (fresh.length === 0) return next;
      const rows: DateRule[] = fresh.map(({ seriesId, date }) => ({
        id: newId(),
        kind: "skip",
        targetKind: "venue",
        startsOn: date,
        endsOn: date,
        seriesId,
      }));
      return { ...next, dateRules: [...next.dateRules, ...rows] };
    }
    export interface ConfigDiff {
      create: RowsByTable;
      update: RowsByTable;
      /** Ids no longer in the next config; only schedule services, assignments and date rules. */
      remove: IdsByTable;
    }
    function diffTable<T extends ConfigTable>(
      stored: AvailabilityConfig[T],
      next: AvailabilityConfig[T]
    ) {
      const before = new Map((stored as Row<T>[]).map((r) => [r.id, r]));
      const after = new Set((next as Row<T>[]).map((r) => r.id));
      const nextRows = next as Row<T>[];
      return {
        create: nextRows.filter((r) => !before.has(r.id)) as AvailabilityConfig[T],
        update: nextRows.filter(
          (r) => before.has(r.id) && !sameRow(before.get(r.id), r)
        ) as AvailabilityConfig[T],
        remove: (stored as Row<T>[]).filter((r) => !after.has(r.id)).map((r) => r.id),
      };
    }
    export function diffConfig(stored: AvailabilityConfig, next: AvailabilityConfig): ConfigDiff {
      const tables = Object.fromEntries(
        CONFIG_TABLES.map((t) => [t, diffTable(stored[t], next[t])])
      ) as { [T in ConfigTable]: ReturnType<typeof diffTable<T>> };
      for (const table of ARCHIVED_ON_REMOVE) {
        // Invariant: applyChanges archives these instead of dropping them.
        if (tables[table].remove.length > 0) throw new Error(`${table} rows cannot be dropped`);
      }
      const pick = <K extends "create" | "update" | "remove">(k: K) =>
        Object.fromEntries(CONFIG_TABLES.map((t) => [t, tables[t][k]]));
      return {
        create: pick("create") as RowsByTable,
        update: pick("update") as RowsByTable,
        remove: pick("remove") as IdsByTable,
      };
    }
    export interface ConfigInverse {
      version: 1;
      restore: RowsByTable;
      remove: IdsByTable;
      operatingHours: unknown;
    }
    export function inverseOf(
      stored: AvailabilityConfig,
      diff: ConfigDiff,
      operatingHours: unknown
    ): ConfigInverse {
      const restore = Object.fromEntries(
        CONFIG_TABLES.map((t) => {
          const touched = new Set([
            ...(diff.update[t] as { id: string }[]).map((r) => r.id),
            ...diff.remove[t],
          ]);
          return [t, (stored[t] as { id: string }[]).filter((r) => touched.has(r.id))];
        })
      ) as RowsByTable;
      const remove = Object.fromEntries(
        CONFIG_TABLES.map((t) => [t, (diff.create[t] as { id: string }[]).map((r) => r.id)])
      ) as IdsByTable;
      return { version: 1, restore, remove, operatingHours: operatingHours ?? null };
    }
    export function affectedRange(
      stored: AvailabilityConfig,
      diff: ConfigDiff,
      today: string
    ): { from: string | null; to: string | null } {
      const weekTouched = CONFIG_TABLES.filter((t) => t !== "dateRules").some(
        (t) => diff.create[t].length + diff.update[t].length + diff.remove[t].length > 0
      );
      if (weekTouched) return { from: today, to: null };
      const removed = new Set(diff.remove.dateRules);
      const updated = new Set(diff.update.dateRules.map((r) => r.id));
      const rules = [
        ...diff.create.dateRules,
        ...diff.update.dateRules,
        ...stored.dateRules.filter((r) => removed.has(r.id) || updated.has(r.id)),
      ];
      if (rules.length === 0) return { from: null, to: null };
      const from = rules.map((r) => r.startsOn).sort()[0]!;
      const to = rules.some((r) => r.endsOn == null)
        ? null
        : rules
            .map((r) => r.endsOn as string)
            .sort()
            .at(-1)!;
      return { from, to };
    }
    export interface ReferenceIssue {
      path: string;
      code: "unknown_reference" | "id_taken" | "duplicate_row";
      message: string;
    }
    export function referenceIssues(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      venueTableIds: ReadonlySet<string>
    ): ReferenceIssue[] {
      const schedules = new Set(config.schedules.map((s) => s.id));
      const services = new Set(config.venueServices.map((s) => s.id));
      const check = (path: string, id: string, known: ReadonlySet<string>): ReferenceIssue[] =>
        known.has(id)
          ? []
          : [{ path, code: "unknown_reference", message: "Refers to a row this venue does not have." }];
    
      return [
        ...config.scheduleServices.flatMap((s, i) => [
          ...check(`scheduleServices[${i}].scheduleId`, s.scheduleId, schedules),
          ...check(`scheduleServices[${i}].venueServiceId`, s.venueServiceId, services),
        ]),
        ...config.assignments.flatMap((a, i) =>
          check(`assignments[${i}].scheduleId`, a.scheduleId, schedules)
        ),
        ...config.dateRules.flatMap((r, i) => [
          ...(r.venueServiceId
            ? check(`dateRules[${i}].venueServiceId`, r.venueServiceId, services)
            : []),
          ...(r.kind === "use_schedule"
            ? check(`dateRules[${i}].useScheduleId`, r.useScheduleId, schedules)
            : []),
          ...(r.kind === "special_hours"
            ? r.payload.services.flatMap((s, j) =>
                check(
                  `dateRules[${i}].payload.services[${j}].venueServiceId`,
                  s.venueServiceId,
                  services
                )
              )
            : []),
          ...(r.tableIds ?? []).flatMap((t, k) =>
            check(`dateRules[${i}].tableIds[${k}]`, t, venueTableIds)
          ),
        ]),
      ];
    }
    export function settleDraft(input: {
      snapshot: { timezone: string; config: AvailabilityConfig };
      changes: AvailabilityConfigChanges;
      scopeConflicts: ScopeConflictMode;
      /**
       * A revert: the rows are an exact prior state, so scope conflicts are not
       * settled (they were settled when that state was first made) and the
       * restored rows must not count as incoming.
       */
      exact?: boolean;
      tableIds: ReadonlySet<string>;
      now: Date;
      today: string;
      newId: () => string;
    }): { next: AvailabilityConfig; issues: (ConfigIssue | ReferenceIssue)[] } {
      const { snapshot, now } = input;
      const applied = applyDraft(snapshot, input.changes, now.toISOString()).config;
      const next = input.exact
        ? applied
        : resolveScopeConflicts(
            snapshot.config,
            applied,
            input.scopeConflicts,
            input.newId,
            input.today
          );
      return {
        next,
        issues: [...validateConfig(next), ...referenceIssues(next, input.tableIds)],
      };
    }
