    export type ConfigRowDb = Pick<
      PrismaClient,
      | "schedule"
      | "venueService"
      | "scheduleService"
      | "scheduleAssignment"
      | "dateRule"
      | "dateRuleTable"
    >;
    export async function readStoredConfig(
      db: ConfigRowDb,
      venueId: string
    ): Promise<{ config: AvailabilityConfig; warnings: SnapshotWarning[] }> {
      const [schedules, venueServices, scheduleServices, assignments, dateRules] = await Promise.all([
        db.schedule.findMany({ where: { venueId } }),
        db.venueService.findMany({ where: { venueId }, orderBy: { position: "asc" } }),
        db.scheduleService.findMany({ where: { venueId } }),
        db.scheduleAssignment.findMany({ where: { venueId } }),
        db.dateRule.findMany({
          where: { venueId, deletedAt: null },
          orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
          include: { tables: { select: { tableId: true } } },
        }),
      ]);
      const warnings: SnapshotWarning[] = [];
      const config = parseConfigRows(
        { schedules, venueServices, scheduleServices, assignments, dateRules },
        warnings
      );
      return { config, warnings };
    }
    async function writeRuleTables(db: ConfigRowDb, venueId: string, rule: DateRule): Promise<void> {
      const tableIds = rule.tableIds ?? [];
      if (tableIds.length === 0) return;
      await db.dateRuleTable.createMany({
        data: tableIds.map((tableId) => ({ dateRuleId: rule.id, tableId, venueId })),
      });
    }
    export class ConfigRowConflict extends Error {
      constructor(
        readonly table: ConfigTable,
        readonly id: string,
        /** The primary key collided, rather than another unique index. */
        readonly onId: boolean
      ) {
        super(`${table} ${id}: unique constraint`);
        this.name = "ConfigRowConflict";
      }
    }
    function uniqueViolation(error: unknown): { onId: boolean } | null {
      if (typeof error !== "object" || error === null) return null;
      if ((error as { code?: unknown }).code !== "P2002") return null;
      const meta = JSON.stringify((error as { meta?: unknown }).meta ?? {});
      return { onId: /"id"|_pkey/.test(meta) };
    }
    async function guarded(table: ConfigTable, id: string, write: () => Promise<unknown>) {
      try {
        await write();
      } catch (error) {
        const violation = uniqueViolation(error);
        if (violation) throw new ConfigRowConflict(table, id, violation.onId);
        throw error;
      }
    }
    async function writeCreates(
      db: ConfigRowDb,
      venueId: string,
      create: ConfigDiff["create"],
      actorId: string,
      revive: ReadonlySet<string>
    ): Promise<void> {
      for (const s of create.schedules) {
        await guarded("schedules", s.id, () =>
          db.schedule.create({ data: { id: s.id, venueId, ...scheduleData(s) } })
        );
      }
      for (const s of create.venueServices) {
        await guarded("venueServices", s.id, () =>
          db.venueService.create({ data: { id: s.id, venueId, ...venueServiceData(s) } })
        );
      }
      for (const s of create.scheduleServices) {
        await guarded("scheduleServices", s.id, () =>
          db.scheduleService.create({ data: { id: s.id, venueId, ...scheduleServiceData(s) } })
        );
      }
      for (const a of create.assignments) {
        await guarded("assignments", a.id, () =>
          db.scheduleAssignment.create({ data: { id: a.id, venueId, ...assignmentData(a) } })
        );
      }
      for (const r of create.dateRules) {
        if (revive.has(r.id)) {
          // Undoing a removal: the soft-deleted row comes back, whole.
          await db.dateRule.update({
            where: { id: r.id },
            data: { ...dateRuleData(r), deletedAt: null },
          });
          await db.dateRuleTable.deleteMany({ where: { venueId, dateRuleId: r.id } });
        } else {
          await guarded("dateRules", r.id, () =>
            db.dateRule.create({ data: { id: r.id, venueId, createdBy: actorId, ...dateRuleData(r) } })
          );
        }
        await writeRuleTables(db, venueId, r);
      }
    }
    export async function writeConfigDiff(
      db: ConfigRowDb,
      venueId: string,
      diff: ConfigDiff,
      context: { actorId: string; now: Date; revive?: ReadonlySet<string> }
    ): Promise<void> {
      const { create, update, remove } = diff;
      const demotionsFirst = [...update.schedules].sort(
        (a, b) => Number(a.isRegular) - Number(b.isRegular)
      );
      for (const s of demotionsFirst) {
        await guarded("schedules", s.id, () =>
          db.schedule.update({ where: { id: s.id }, data: scheduleData(s) })
        );
      }
      for (const s of update.venueServices) {
        await db.venueService.update({ where: { id: s.id }, data: venueServiceData(s) });
      }
    
      const inVenue = (ids: string[]) => ({ venueId, id: { in: ids } });
      if (remove.scheduleServices.length > 0) {
        await db.scheduleService.deleteMany({ where: inVenue(remove.scheduleServices) });
      }
      if (remove.assignments.length > 0) {
        await db.scheduleAssignment.deleteMany({ where: inVenue(remove.assignments) });
      }
      if (remove.dateRules.length > 0) {
        await db.dateRule.updateMany({
          where: inVenue(remove.dateRules),
          data: { deletedAt: context.now },
        });
      }
    
      await writeCreates(db, venueId, create, context.actorId, context.revive ?? new Set());
    
      for (const s of update.scheduleServices) {
        await guarded("scheduleServices", s.id, () =>
          db.scheduleService.update({ where: { id: s.id }, data: scheduleServiceData(s) })
        );
      }
      for (const a of update.assignments) {
        await db.scheduleAssignment.update({ where: { id: a.id }, data: assignmentData(a) });
      }
      for (const r of update.dateRules) {
        await db.dateRule.update({ where: { id: r.id }, data: dateRuleData(r) });
        await db.dateRuleTable.deleteMany({ where: { venueId, dateRuleId: r.id } });
        await writeRuleTables(db, venueId, r);
      }
    }

    export interface ConfigState {
      /** The rows as stored (empty for a venue with none). */
      stored: AvailabilityConfig;
      /** What the venue runs on: the rows, or the legacy-derived config. */
      effective: AvailabilityConfig;
      source: AvailabilityConfigSource;
      /** `legacy` only: days the lenient reader closed, and values it coerced. */
      legacyNotes?: LegacyNotes;
      /** `unreadable` only: why even the lenient reader could not read the hours. */
      legacyProblem?: { reason: string; detail: string };
      version: number;
      timezone: string;
      operatingHours: unknown;
    }
    export interface LegacyNotes {
      unreadableDays: string[];
      coercions: string[];
    }

    export type StoreDb = ConfigRowDb &
      Pick<PrismaClient, "venue" | "reservation" | "availabilityChange" | "table">;
    export type StoreClient = Pick<PrismaClient, "$transaction">;
    function withStored(legacy: AvailabilityConfig, stored: AvailabilityConfig): AvailabilityConfig {
      return {
        schedules: [...legacy.schedules, ...stored.schedules],
        venueServices: [...legacy.venueServices, ...stored.venueServices],
        scheduleServices: [...legacy.scheduleServices, ...stored.scheduleServices],
        assignments: [...legacy.assignments, ...stored.assignments],
        dateRules: [...legacy.dateRules, ...stored.dateRules],
      };
    }
    function legacyIds(venueId: string): () => string {
      let n = 0;
      return () => `${venueId}-legacy-${++n}`;
    }
    export async function loadConfigState(
      db: StoreDb,
      venueId: string,
      now: Date
    ): Promise<ConfigState | null> {
      const [venue, stored] = await Promise.all([
        db.venue.findUnique({
          where: { id: venueId },
          select: {
            ianaTimezone: true,
            settings: true,
            operatingHours: true,
            availabilityVersion: true,
          },
        }),
        readStoredConfig(db, venueId),
      ]);
      if (!venue) return null;
      const base = {
        stored: stored.config,
        version: venue.availabilityVersion,
        timezone: venue.ianaTimezone,
        operatingHours: venue.operatingHours,
      };
      // The same choice, and the same lenient read, as the live listing's
      // snapshot loader, so the editor and the stranded check both start from
      // what guests see.
      if (hasRegularSchedule(stored.config)) {
        return { ...base, effective: stored.config, source: "rows" };
      }
      const plan = planVenueMigration(venue, now, legacyIds(venueId), { lenient: true });
      if (plan.kind === "migrate") {
        const { unreadableDays = [], coercions = [] } = plan.notes;
        const notes = unreadableDays.length + coercions.length > 0;
        return {
          ...base,
          effective: withStored(plan.config, stored.config),
          source: "legacy",
          ...(notes ? { legacyNotes: { unreadableDays, coercions } } : {}),
        };
      }
      if (plan.reason === "no_hours") return { ...base, effective: stored.config, source: "empty" };
      // Not even the lenient reader can read it, and the listing serves it as
      // closed too: the editor starts from that, and says why.
      return {
        ...base,
        effective: stored.config,
        source: "unreadable",
        legacyProblem: { reason: plan.reason, detail: plan.detail },
      };
    }
    function readState(client: StoreClient, venueId: string, now: Date): Promise<ConfigState | null> {
      return client.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        await setVenueContext(tx, venueId);
        return loadConfigState(tx, venueId, now);
      });
    }
    export async function getAvailabilityConfig(
      venueId: string,
      now: Date,
      client: StoreClient = prisma
    ): Promise<{
      config: AvailabilityConfig;
      version: number;
      source: AvailabilityConfigSource;
      legacyNotes?: LegacyNotes;
      legacyProblem?: { reason: string; detail: string };
    } | null> {
      const state = await readState(client, venueId, now);
      if (!state) return null;
      const { effective: config, version, source, legacyNotes, legacyProblem } = state;
      return {
        config,
        version,
        source,
        ...(legacyNotes ? { legacyNotes } : {}),
        ...(legacyProblem ? { legacyProblem } : {}),
      };
    }
    export async function listAvailabilityDays(
      venueId: string,
      from: string,
      to: string,
      now: Date,
      client: StoreClient = prisma
    ): Promise<AvailabilityDaySummary[] | null> {
      const state = await readState(client, venueId, now);
      if (!state) return null;
      const snapshot = { timezone: state.timezone, config: state.effective };
      const days: AvailabilityDaySummary[] = [];
      for (let date = from; date <= to; date = addDays(date, 1)) {
        days.push(summarizeDay(state.effective, resolveDay(snapshot, date)));
      }
      return days;
    }
    export type SavePlan =
      | { kind: "invalid"; issues: (ConfigIssue | ReferenceIssue)[] }
      | { kind: "stranded"; reservations: StrandedReservation[] }
      | {
          kind: "write";
          next: AvailabilityConfig;
          diff: ConfigDiff;
          inverse: ConfigInverse;
          range: { from: string | null; to: string | null };
          summary: string;
        };
    function describeDiff(diff: ConfigDiff): string {
      const count = (part: Record<string, unknown[]>) =>
        Object.values(part).reduce((n, rows) => n + rows.length, 0);
      return `Availability updated: ${count(diff.create)} added, ${count(diff.update)} changed, ${count(diff.remove)} removed`;
    }
    export function planSave(input: {
      state: ConfigState;
      body: PutAvailabilityConfigBody;
      bookings: readonly BookedReservation[];
      /** Every table of the venue, active or not: a date rule may only block these. */
      tableIds: ReadonlySet<string>;
      now: Date;
      newId?: () => string;
      /** Undoing a venue's first save returns it to no hours at all, which is not an error. */
      allowNoHours?: boolean;
      /** A revert: apply the rows exactly, without settling scope conflicts. */
      exact?: boolean;
    }): SavePlan {
      const { state, body, bookings, now } = input;
      const { next, issues: allIssues } = settleDraft({
        snapshot: { timezone: state.timezone, config: state.effective },
        changes: body.changes,
        scopeConflicts: body.scopeConflicts,
        ...(input.exact ? { exact: true } : {}),
        tableIds: input.tableIds,
        now,
        today: civilDateIn(now, state.timezone),
        newId: input.newId ?? randomUUID,
      });
      const noHours = next.schedules.every((s) => s.archivedAt);
      const issues =
        input.allowNoHours && noHours
          ? allIssues.filter((i) => !("code" in i && i.code === "no_regular_schedule"))
          : allIssues;
      if (issues.length > 0) return { kind: "invalid", issues };
    
      const reservations = findStrandedReservations(
        { timezone: state.timezone, config: state.effective },
        { timezone: state.timezone, config: next },
        bookings
      );
      if (reservations.length > 0) return { kind: "stranded", reservations };
    
      const diff = diffConfig(state.stored, next);
      return {
        kind: "write",
        next,
        diff,
        inverse: inverseOf(state.stored, diff, state.operatingHours),
        range: affectedRange(state.stored, diff, civilDateIn(now, state.timezone)),
        summary: describeDiff(diff),
      };
    }
    export type SaveOutcome =
      | { kind: "saved"; version: number; changeId: string }
      | { kind: "version_conflict"; winningChange: AvailabilityChangeSummary | null }
      | { kind: "not_found" }
      | Exclude<SavePlan, { kind: "write" }>;
    class SaveRefused extends Error {
      constructor(readonly outcome: { kind: string }) {
        super(outcome.kind);
      }
    }
    export async function futureBookings(
      db: StoreDb,
      venueId: string,
      today: string,
      now: Date
    ): Promise<BookedReservation[]> {
      return db.reservation.findMany({
        where: {
          venueId,
          // From yesterday's service day: a service running past midnight is still
          // yesterday's (ADR-029), and `startTime >= now` keeps the scan to the future.
          date: { gte: new Date(`${addDays(today, -1)}T00:00:00.000Z`) },
          startTime: { gte: now },
          status: { notIn: [...NOT_BOOKED_STATUSES] },
        },
        select: { id: true, tableId: true, startTime: true, partySize: true, date: true },
      });
    }
    export async function refuseStale(db: StoreDb, venueId: string): Promise<SaveOutcome> {
      const exists = await db.venue.findUnique({ where: { id: venueId }, select: { id: true } });
      if (!exists) return { kind: "not_found" };
      const winner = await db.availabilityChange.findFirst({
        where: { venueId },
        orderBy: { at: "desc" },
        select: { id: true, actorId: true, at: true, kind: true, summary: true },
      });
      return {
        kind: "version_conflict",
        winningChange: winner && { ...winner, at: winner.at.toISOString() },
      };
    }
    export function conflictIssue(error: ConfigRowConflict, next: AvailabilityConfig): SaveOutcome {
      const index = (next[error.table] as { id: string }[]).findIndex((r) => r.id === error.id);
      return {
        kind: "invalid",
        issues: [
          error.onId
            ? {
                path: `${error.table}[${index}].id`,
                code: "id_taken",
                message: "This id is already used; choose another.",
              }
            : {
                path: `${error.table}[${index}]`,
                code: "duplicate_row",
                message: "Another row already has these values.",
              },
        ],
      };
    }
    export const toDbDate = (d: string | null): Date | null =>
      d ? new Date(`${d}T00:00:00.000Z`) : null;
    export interface SaveRequest {
      changes: PutAvailabilityConfigBody["changes"];
      scopeConflicts: PutAvailabilityConfigBody["scopeConflicts"];
      /** The audit row's `kind`. */
      kind: string;
      /** Replaces the generated summary. */
      summary?: string;
      /** Written to `Venue.operatingHours` in place of the projection of the next config. */
      operatingHours?: Prisma.InputJsonValue | typeof Prisma.DbNull;
      /** Permit the result to have no live schedule (an undone first save). */
      allowNoHours?: boolean;
      /** Apply the rows exactly, without settling scope conflicts (a revert). */
      exact?: boolean;
      /** Date rules to bring back from soft-deletion instead of creating. */
      revive?: ReadonlySet<string>;
      /** Runs in the save transaction once the audit row exists. */
      afterChange?: (tx: StoreDb, changeId: string) => Promise<void>;
    }
    export async function inSaveTransaction<T, R extends { kind: string } = never>(
      client: StoreClient,
      venueId: string,
      work: (tx: StoreDb) => Promise<T>
    ): Promise<T | SaveOutcome | R> {
      try {
        return await client.$transaction(async (tx) => {
          await setVenueContext(tx, venueId);
          return work(tx);
        });
      } catch (error) {
        // Invariant: only `refuseSave` and `commitSave` throw it, with a SaveOutcome or the caller's R.
        if (error instanceof SaveRefused) return error.outcome as SaveOutcome | R;
        throw error;
      }
    }
    export function refuseSave(outcome: { kind: string }): never {
      throw new SaveRefused(outcome);
    }
    export async function commitSave(
      tx: StoreDb,
      input: { venueId: string; actorId: string; expectedVersion: number; now: Date },
      resolve: (state: ConfigState) => Promise<SaveRequest>
    ): Promise<SaveOutcome> {
      const { venueId, actorId, expectedVersion, now } = input;
      const cas = await tx.venue.updateMany({
        where: { id: venueId, availabilityVersion: expectedVersion },
        data: { availabilityVersion: { increment: 1 } },
      });
      if (cas.count === 0) return refuseStale(tx, venueId);
    
      const state = await loadConfigState(tx, venueId, now);
      if (!state) throw new SaveRefused({ kind: "not_found" });
      const request = await resolve(state);
      const today = civilDateIn(now, state.timezone);
      const [bookings, tables] = await Promise.all([
        futureBookings(tx, venueId, today, now),
        tx.table.findMany({ where: { venueId }, select: { id: true } }),
      ]);
      const tableIds = new Set(tables.map((t) => t.id));
      const plan = planSave({
        state,
        body: { expectedVersion, changes: request.changes, scopeConflicts: request.scopeConflicts },
        bookings,
        tableIds,
        now,
        ...(request.allowNoHours ? { allowNoHours: true } : {}),
        ...(request.exact ? { exact: true } : {}),
      });
      if (plan.kind !== "write") throw new SaveRefused(plan);
    
      await writeConfigDiff(tx, venueId, plan.diff, {
        actorId,
        now,
        ...(request.revive ? { revive: request.revive } : {}),
      }).catch((error: unknown) => {
        throw error instanceof ConfigRowConflict
          ? new SaveRefused(conflictIssue(error, plan.next))
          : error;
      });
      const change = await tx.availabilityChange.create({
        data: {
          venueId,
          actorId,
          at: now,
          kind: request.kind,
          summary: request.summary ?? plan.summary,
          affectedFrom: toDbDate(plan.range.from),
          affectedTo: toDbDate(plan.range.to),
          inverse: plan.inverse as unknown as Prisma.InputJsonValue,
        },
        select: { id: true },
      });
      await request.afterChange?.(tx, change.id);
      await tx.venue.update({
        where: { id: venueId },
        data: { operatingHours: request.operatingHours ?? projectLegacyOperatingHours(plan.next) },
      });
      return { kind: "saved" as const, version: expectedVersion + 1, changeId: change.id };
    }
    export async function saveAvailabilityConfig(
      input: { venueId: string; actorId: string; body: PutAvailabilityConfigBody; now: Date },
      client: StoreClient = prisma
    ): Promise<SaveOutcome> {
      const { venueId, actorId, body, now } = input;
      return inSaveTransaction(client, venueId, (tx) =>
        commitSave(tx, { venueId, actorId, expectedVersion: body.expectedVersion, now }, async () => ({
          changes: body.changes,
          scopeConflicts: body.scopeConflicts,
          kind: "config",
        }))
      );
    }
    export const PREVIEW_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000;
    export type PreviewOutcome = { kind: "not_found" } | { kind: "timeout" } | PreviewPlan;
    export async function previewAvailabilityConfig(
      input: {
        venueId: string;
        body: PreviewAvailabilityParsed;
        now: Date;
        timeoutMs?: number;
      },
      client: StoreClient = prisma
    ): Promise<PreviewOutcome> {
      const { venueId, body, now } = input;
      const run = client.$transaction(async (tx): Promise<PreviewOutcome> => {
        await setVenueContext(tx, venueId);
        const state = await loadConfigState(tx, venueId, now);
        if (!state) return { kind: "not_found" };
        const [bookings, tables] = await Promise.all([
          futureBookings(tx, venueId, civilDateIn(now, state.timezone), now),
          tx.table.findMany({ where: { venueId }, select: { id: true } }),
        ]);
        return planPreview({
          state,
          body,
          bookings,
          tableIds: new Set(tables.map((t) => t.id)),
          now,
        });
      });
      let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
      const timeout = new Promise<PreviewOutcome>((resolve) => {
        timer = setTimeout(() => resolve({ kind: "timeout" }), input.timeoutMs ?? PREVIEW_TIMEOUT_MS);
      });
      try {
        return await Promise.race([run, timeout]);
      } finally {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        // A preview that lost the race still settles; its failure has no reader.
        run.catch(() => undefined);
      }
    }
    export const availabilityConfigService = {
      check: checkAvailability,
      get: getAvailabilityConfig,
      listDays: listAvailabilityDays,
      save: saveAvailabilityConfig,
      preview: previewAvailabilityConfig,
    };

    export const MIGRATION_ACTOR = "system:availability-legacy-migration";
    export interface VenueForMigration {
      operatingHours: unknown;
      settings: unknown;
      ianaTimezone: string;
    }
    export type VenueMigrationPlan =
      | {
          kind: "migrate";
          shape: LegacyShape;
          config: AvailabilityConfig;
          notes: LegacyMigrationNotes;
          /** The legacy column derived from the rows; the seed writes it, the backfill does not. */
          projection: LegacyOperatingHours;
        }
      | { kind: "unrecognised"; reason: string; detail: string };
    export function civilDateIn(now: Date, timeZone: string): string {
      return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
        timeZone,
        year: "numeric",
        month: "2-digit",
        day: "2-digit",
      }).format(now);
    }
    export function planVenueMigration(
      venue: VenueForMigration,
      now: Date,
      newId: () => string = randomUUID,
      options: { lenient?: boolean } = {}
    ): VenueMigrationPlan {
      const lenient = options.lenient ?? false;
      const normalised = normalizeLegacyHours(venue.operatingHours, { lenient });
      if (!normalised.ok) {
        const detail = "detail" in normalised ? normalised.detail : "";
        return { kind: "unrecognised", reason: normalised.reason, detail };
      }
      const settings = (venue.settings ?? {}) as VenueSettings;
      const built = buildLegacyConfig({
        hours: normalised.hours,
        slotIntervalMinutes: settings.slotIntervalMinutes,
        lastSeatingBuffer: settings.lastSeatingBuffer,
        today: civilDateIn(now, venue.ianaTimezone),
        newId,
        lenient,
      });
      if (!built.ok) return { kind: "unrecognised", reason: built.reason, detail: built.detail };
      const unreadableDays = [
        ...(normalised.unreadableDays ?? []),
        ...(built.notes.unreadableDays ?? []),
      ];
      const coercions = [...(normalised.coercions ?? []), ...(built.notes.coercions ?? [])];
      const notes = {
        ...built.notes,
        ...(unreadableDays.length > 0 ? { unreadableDays } : {}),
        ...(coercions.length > 0 ? { coercions } : {}),
      };
      return {
        kind: "migrate",
        shape: normalised.shape,
        config: built.config,
        notes,
        projection: projectLegacyOperatingHours(built.config),
      };
    }
    interface MigrationSummary {
      shape: LegacyShape;
      notes: LegacyMigrationNotes;
      rows: number;
    }
    export type VenueMigrationOutcome =
      | ({ venueId: string; outcome: "migrated"; operatingHours: unknown } & MigrationSummary)
      | ({ venueId: string; outcome: "would_migrate"; operatingHours: unknown } & MigrationSummary)
      | { venueId: string; outcome: "already_migrated"; operatingHours: unknown }
      | {
          venueId: string;
          outcome: "unrecognised";
          reason: string;
          detail: string;
          operatingHours: unknown;
        }
      | { venueId: string; outcome: "not_found" };

    export async function writeAvailabilityConfig(
      tx: AvailabilityRowWriter,
      venueId: string,
      config: AvailabilityConfig
    ): Promise<void> {
      await tx.schedule.createMany({
        data: config.schedules.map((s) => ({
          id: s.id,
          venueId,
          name: s.name,
          kind: s.kind,
          isRegular: s.isRegular,
        })),
      });
      await tx.venueService.createMany({
        data: config.venueServices.map((s) => ({
          id: s.id,
          venueId,
          name: s.name,
          position: s.position,
        })),
      });
      await tx.scheduleService.createMany({
        data: config.scheduleServices.map((s) => ({
          id: s.id,
          venueId,
          scheduleId: s.scheduleId,
          venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId,
          opensAt: s.opensAt,
          lastSeatingAt: s.lastSeatingAt,
          closesAt: s.closesAt,
          seating: s.seating,
          bookingTypes: s.bookingTypes,
        })),
      });
      await tx.scheduleAssignment.createMany({
        data: config.assignments.map((a) => ({
          id: a.id,
          venueId,
          scheduleId: a.scheduleId,
          weekdays: a.weekdays,
          precedence: a.precedence,
        })),
      });
      await tx.dateRule.createMany({
        data: config.dateRules.map((r) => ({
          id: r.id,
          venueId,
          kind: r.kind,
          targetKind: r.targetKind,
          startsOn: toDate(r.startsOn),
          endsOn: r.endsOn ? toDate(r.endsOn) : null,
          staffNote: r.staffNote ?? null,
          ...(r.kind === "special_hours" ? { payload: r.payload } : {}),
          createdBy: MIGRATION_ACTOR,
        })),
      });
    }
    export async function migrateVenue(
      prisma: PrismaClient,
      venueId: string,
      options: { apply: boolean; now?: Date }
    ): Promise<VenueMigrationOutcome> {
      const now = options.now ?? new Date();
      return prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        await setVenueContext(tx, venueId);
        const venue = await tx.venue.findUnique({
          where: { id: venueId },
          select: { operatingHours: true, settings: true, ianaTimezone: true },
        });
        if (!venue) return { venueId, outcome: "not_found" as const };
    
        const { operatingHours } = venue;
    
        const existing = await tx.schedule.count({
          where: { venueId, isRegular: true, archivedAt: null },
        });
        if (existing > 0) return { venueId, outcome: "already_migrated" as const, operatingHours };
    
        const plan = planVenueMigration(venue, now);
        if (plan.kind === "unrecognised") {
          return {
            venueId,
            outcome: "unrecognised" as const,
            reason: plan.reason,
            detail: plan.detail,
            operatingHours,
          };
        }
        const summary = {
          venueId,
          operatingHours,
          shape: plan.shape,
          notes: plan.notes,
          rows: countRows(plan.config),
        };
        if (!options.apply) return { ...summary, outcome: "would_migrate" as const };
    
        await writeAvailabilityConfig(tx, venueId, plan.config);
        return { ...summary, outcome: "migrated" as const };
      });
    }

    export const DEFAULT_CLOSURE_MESSAGE = "Closed on this date.";
    export const PAUSED_CALL_MESSAGE = "Online booking is paused right now.";
    export const PAUSED_MESSAGE = "Not taking reservations right now.";
    export interface DayNotices {
      closure?: AvailabilityClosure;
      bookingPaused?: BookingPaused;
    }
    function activePause(snapshot: BookingSnapshot, day: ReturnType<typeof resolveDay>) {
      const pausedRuleIds = new Set(
        day.closures
          .filter((band) => band.targetKind === "booking" && band.bookingTypes?.includes("online"))
          .map((band) => band.ruleId)
      );
      return snapshot.config.dateRules.find(
        (rule) =>
          pausedRuleIds.has(rule.id) && rule.kind === "closure" && rule.endsOn == null && !rule.window
      );
    }
    export function dayNotices(
      snapshot: BookingSnapshot,
      serviceDate: ServiceDate,
      phone: string | null,
      /** Online seatings `listSlots` found for the date, booked or not. */
      seatingCount: number
    ): DayNotices {
      const day = resolveDay(snapshot, serviceDate);
      const pause = activePause(snapshot, day);
      if (pause) {
        const phoneOpen =
          day.bookingOpen.phone && day.services.some((s) => s.bookingTypes.includes("phone"));
        const callable = phoneOpen && phone ? phone : undefined;
        const fallback = callable ? PAUSED_CALL_MESSAGE : PAUSED_MESSAGE;
        return {
          bookingPaused: {
            message: pause.guestMessage ?? fallback,
            ...(callable ? { phone: callable } : {}),
          },
        };
      }
      const closedByRule = day.closures.some((band) => band.targetKind !== "tables");
      if (!closedByRule) return {};
      // Any seating left on the online channel means the date is open, if shorter.
      if (seatingCount > 0) return {};
      return { closure: { message: day.guestMessage ?? DEFAULT_CLOSURE_MESSAGE } };
    }

    export interface PreviewInput {
      state: ConfigState;
      body: PreviewAvailabilityParsed;
      /** Future, still-booked reservations, each with its service date. */
      bookings: readonly BookedReservation[];
      tableIds: ReadonlySet<string>;
      now: Date;
      newId?: () => string;
    }
    export type PreviewPlan =
      | { kind: "invalid"; issues: (ConfigIssue | ReferenceIssue)[] }
      | { kind: "ok"; result: PreviewResult };
    export function scopeIncludes(scope: PreviewScope, date: string): boolean {
      if (Array.isArray(scope)) return scope.includes(date);
      return scope.from <= date && (scope.to === undefined || date <= scope.to);
    }
    export function planPreview(input: PreviewInput): PreviewPlan {
      const { state, body, now } = input;
      const { draft, scope, focusDate, strandedOffset } = body;
      const { next, issues } = settleDraft({
        snapshot: { timezone: state.timezone, config: state.effective },
        changes: draft.changes,
        scopeConflicts: draft.scopeConflicts,
        tableIds: input.tableIds,
        now,
        today: civilDateIn(now, state.timezone),
        newId: input.newId ?? randomUUID,
      });
      if (issues.length > 0) return { kind: "invalid", issues };
    
      const before = structural(state.timezone, state.effective);
      const after = structural(state.timezone, next);
      const dates = Array.from({ length: PREVIEW_WINDOW_DAYS }, (_, i) => addDays(focusDate, i));
      const days = diffDays(before, after, dates, {
        partySize: PREVIEW_PARTY_SIZE,
        channel: "online",
        now,
      });
    
      const focus = resolveDay(after, focusDate);
      const stranded = findStrandedReservations(
        before,
        after,
        input.bookings.filter((b) => b.date && scopeIncludes(scope, toServiceDate(b.date)))
      ).sort((a, b) => a.startTime.localeCompare(b.startTime) || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
    
      const names = new Map(next.venueServices.map((s) => [s.id, s.name]));
      return {
        kind: "ok",
        result: {
          version: state.version,
          days,
          focusDay: {
            ...summarizeDay(next, focus),
            services: focus.services.map((s) => ({
              venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId,
              name: names.get(s.venueServiceId) ?? s.name,
              opensAt: s.opensAt,
              lastSeatingAt: s.lastSeatingAt,
              closesAt: s.closesAt,
            })),
          },
          stranded: {
            total: stranded.length,
            offset: strandedOffset,
            items: stranded.slice(strandedOffset, strandedOffset + PREVIEW_STRANDED_PAGE_SIZE),
          },
        },
      };
    }

    export interface SnapshotWarning {

      id: string;

    export interface SnapshotLogger {
      warn(obj: object, msg: string): void;
    }
    type SnapshotDb = Pick<
      PrismaClient,
      | "venue"
      | "schedule"

    export interface LoadSnapshotOptions {

    export type SnapshotSource = "rows" | "legacy" | "none";
    export interface LoadedSnapshot {
      snapshot: BookingSnapshot;
      /** `Venue.availabilityVersion` at read time. */
      version: number;
      warnings: SnapshotWarning[];
      source: SnapshotSource;
      /**
       * The venue never set hours: no regular schedule row and no legacy
       * `operatingHours`. Distinct from hours that exist but cannot be read, which

       */

    export class VenueNotFoundError extends Error {
      constructor(venueId: string) {
        super(`Venue ${venueId} not found`);
        this.name = "VenueNotFoundError";
      }
    }
    type RowSchema<T> = {
      safeParse(
        value: unknown
      ):
        | { success: true; data: T }
        | { success: false; error: { issues: readonly { path: PropertyKey[]; message: string }[] } };
    };
    function failureReason(issues: readonly { path: PropertyKey[]; message: string }[]): string {
      const first = issues[0];
      if (!first) return "invalid row";
      const path = first.path.map(String).join(".");
      return path ? `${path}: ${first.message}` : first.message;
    }
    function parseRows<T>(
      table: string,
      schema: RowSchema<T>,
      candidates: readonly { id: string; value: unknown }[],
      warnings: SnapshotWarning[],
      onInvalid?: (id: string, value: unknown) => T | null
    ): T[] {
      const parsed: T[] = [];
      for (const { id, value } of candidates) {
        const result = schema.safeParse(value);
        if (result.success) {
          parsed.push(result.data);
          continue;
        }
        warnings.push({ table, id, reason: failureReason(result.error.issues) });
        const replacement = onInvalid?.(id, value);
        if (replacement) parsed.push(replacement);
      }
      return parsed;
    }
    function failClosedRule(row: DateRuleRow): DateRule {
      return {
        kind: "closure",
        id: row.id,
        targetKind: "venue",
        startsOn: toServiceDate(row.startsOn),
        endsOn: row.endsOn ? toServiceDate(row.endsOn) : null,
        guestMessage: row.guestMessage,
      };
    }
    export interface DateRuleRow {
      id: string;
      kind: string;
      targetKind: string;
      venueServiceId: string | null;
      bookingTypes: string[];
      startsOn: Date;
      endsOn: Date | null;
      repeat: unknown;
      window: unknown;
      payload: unknown;
      useScheduleId: string | null;
      seriesId: string | null;
      guestMessage: string | null;
      staffNote: string | null;
      expiresAt: Date | null;
      tables: { tableId: string }[];
    }
    function dateRuleCandidate(row: DateRuleRow): unknown {
      // The DB stores "no channels listed" as []; for a booking-target rule that means
      // every channel, but the engine reads [] as "affects nothing" — so spell it out.
      // validateConfig rejects the empty form on write; this is the defensive read.
      const bookingTypes =
        row.targetKind === "booking" && row.bookingTypes.length === 0
          ? [...ALL_RULE_CHANNELS]
          : row.bookingTypes;
      return {
        id: row.id,
        kind: row.kind,
        targetKind: row.targetKind,
        venueServiceId: row.venueServiceId,
        bookingTypes,
        tableIds: row.tables.map((t) => t.tableId),
        startsOn: toServiceDate(row.startsOn),
        endsOn: row.endsOn ? toServiceDate(row.endsOn) : null,
        repeat: row.repeat,
        window: row.window,
        payload: row.payload,
        useScheduleId: row.useScheduleId,
        seriesId: row.seriesId,
        guestMessage: row.guestMessage,
        staffNote: row.staffNote,
        expiresAt: toIso(row.expiresAt),
      };
    }
    interface LegacyVenue {
      operatingHours: unknown;
      settings: unknown;
      ianaTimezone: string;
    }
    function effectiveConfig(
      venueId: string,
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      venue: LegacyVenue,
      now: Date,
      warnings: SnapshotWarning[]
    ): { config: AvailabilityConfig; source: SnapshotSource; unconfigured?: true } {
      if (hasRegularSchedule(config)) return { config, source: "rows" };
      const plan = planVenueMigration(venue, now, undefined, { lenient: true });
      if (plan.kind === "migrate") {
        for (const day of plan.notes.unreadableDays ?? []) {
          warnings.push({
            table: "venues",
            id: venueId,
            reason: `legacy operatingHours, day closed: ${day}`,
          });
        }
        for (const coercion of plan.notes.coercions ?? []) {
          warnings.push({ table: "venues", id: venueId, reason: `legacy hours coerced: ${coercion}` });
        }
        return {
          config: { ...plan.config, dateRules: [...plan.config.dateRules, ...config.dateRules] },
          source: "legacy",
        };
      }
      // "no_hours" is a venue with nothing configured, not a bad row.
      if (plan.reason === "no_hours") return { config, source: "none", unconfigured: true };
      const reason = `legacy operatingHours ${plan.reason}${plan.detail ? `: ${plan.detail}` : ""}`;
      warnings.push({ table: "venues", id: venueId, reason });
      return { config, source: "none" };
    }
    function pickEngineSettings(settings: VenueSettings | null): EngineSettings | null {
      if (!settings) return null;
      const {
        durationRules,
        defaultReservationDuration,
        pacingRules,
        slotIntervalMinutes,
        maxPartySize,
      } = settings;
      return {
        durationRules,
        defaultReservationDuration,
        pacingRules,
        slotIntervalMinutes,
        maxPartySize,
      };
    }
    export interface ConfigRows {
      schedules: ScheduleRow[];
      venueServices: VenueServiceRow[];
      scheduleServices: ScheduleServiceRow[];
      assignments: ScheduleAssignmentRow[];
      dateRules: DateRuleRow[];
    }
    export function parseConfigRows(rows: ConfigRows, warnings: SnapshotWarning[]): AvailabilityConfig {
      const { schedules, venueServices, scheduleServices, assignments, dateRules } = rows;
      return {
        schedules: parseRows<Schedule>(
          "schedules",
          ScheduleSchema,
          schedules.map((r) => ({
            id: r.id,
            value: { ...r, archivedAt: toIso(r.archivedAt) },
          })),
          warnings
        ),
        venueServices: parseRows<VenueService>(
          "venue_services",
          VenueServiceSchema,
          venueServices.map((r) => ({
            id: r.id,
            value: { ...r, archivedAt: toIso(r.archivedAt) },
          })),
          warnings
        ),
        scheduleServices: parseRows<ScheduleService>(
          "schedule_services",
          ScheduleServiceSchema,
          scheduleServices.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, value: r })),
          warnings
        ),
        assignments: parseRows<ScheduleAssignment>(
          "schedule_assignments",
          ScheduleAssignmentSchema,
          assignments.map((r) => ({
            id: r.id,
            value: {
              ...r,
              startsOn: r.startsOn ? toServiceDate(r.startsOn) : null,
              endsOn: r.endsOn ? toServiceDate(r.endsOn) : null,
            },
          })),
          warnings
        ),
        dateRules: parseRows<DateRule>(
          "date_rules",
          DateRuleSchema,
          dateRules.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, value: dateRuleCandidate(r) })),
          warnings,
          (id) => {
            const row = dateRules.find((r) => r.id === id);
            return row ? failClosedRule(row) : null;
          }
        ),
      };
    }
    export async function loadAvailabilitySnapshot(
      venueId: string,
      fromDate: ServiceDate,
      toDate: ServiceDate,
      now: Date,
      options: LoadSnapshotOptions = {}
    ): Promise<LoadedSnapshot> {
      const db = options.db ?? prisma;
      // ±1 day: a service that runs past midnight belongs to the day it opens on.
      const windowStart = new Date(addDays(fromDate, -1));
      const windowEnd = new Date(addDays(toDate, 1));
      const dayWindow = { gte: windowStart, lte: windowEnd };
    
      const [
        venue,
        schedules,
        venueServices,
        scheduleServices,
        assignments,
        dateRules,
        tables,
        reservations,
        holds,
      ] = await Promise.all([
        db.venue.findUnique({
          where: { id: venueId },
          select: {
            ianaTimezone: true,
            settings: true,
            availabilityVersion: true,
            operatingHours: true,
          },
        }),
        db.schedule.findMany({ where: { venueId } }),
        db.venueService.findMany({ where: { venueId }, orderBy: { position: "asc" } }),
        db.scheduleService.findMany({ where: { venueId } }),
        db.scheduleAssignment.findMany({ where: { venueId } }),
        db.dateRule.findMany({
          where: {
            venueId,
            deletedAt: null,
            startsOn: { lte: windowEnd },
            OR: [{ endsOn: null }, { endsOn: { gte: windowStart } }],
          },
          include: { tables: { select: { tableId: true } } },
        }),
        db.table.findMany({
          where: { venueId, isActive: true },
          orderBy: [{ priority: "desc" }, { capacity: "asc" }],
          select: {
            id: true,
            name: true,
            capacity: true,
            minCovers: true,
            maxCovers: true,
            isActive: true,
            priority: true,
          },
        }),
        db.reservation.findMany({
          where: { venueId, date: dayWindow, status: { notIn: [...NOT_BOOKED_STATUSES] } },
          select: { id: true, tableId: true, startTime: true, endTime: true, partySize: true },
        }),
        db.reservationHold.findMany({
          where: { venueId, date: dayWindow, expiresAt: activeHoldWindow(now) },
          select: {
            id: true,
            tableId: true,
            startTime: true,
            endTime: true,
            partySize: true,
            expiresAt: true,
          },
        }),
      ]);
    
      if (!venue) throw new VenueNotFoundError(venueId);
    
      const warnings: SnapshotWarning[] = [];
    
      const rowConfig = parseConfigRows(
        { schedules, venueServices, scheduleServices, assignments, dateRules },
        warnings
      );
    
      const { config, source, unconfigured } = effectiveConfig(
        venueId,
        rowConfig,
        venue,
        now,
        warnings
      );
    
      if (options.logger) {
        for (const warning of warnings) {
          options.logger.warn({ venueId, ...warning }, "availability_snapshot_row_invalid");
        }
      }
    
      const venueSettings = venue.settings as VenueSettings | null;
      return {
        snapshot: {
          timezone: venue.ianaTimezone,
          config,
          tables,
          reservations,
          holds,
          settings: pickEngineSettings(venueSettings),
        },
        version: venue.availabilityVersion,
        warnings,
        source,
        unconfigured: unconfigured ?? false,
        venueSettings,
      };
    }

    export interface ListingOptions {
      /** Receives one warning per configuration row (or legacy column) that could not be read. */

    async function loadOrNull(
      venueId: string,
      fromDate: string,
      toDate: string,
      now: Date,
      options: ListingOptions
    ): Promise<LoadedSnapshot | null> {
      try {
        return await loadAvailabilitySnapshot(venueId, fromDate, toDate, now, {
          logger: options.logger,

    }
    function withDuration(
      snapshot: BookingSnapshot,
      partySize: number,
      durationMinutes: number | undefined
    ): BookingSnapshot {
      if (durationMinutes === undefined) return snapshot;
      const rule = { minPartySize: partySize, maxPartySize: partySize, durationMinutes };
      return { ...snapshot, settings: { ...snapshot.settings, durationRules: [rule] } };
    }
    function toTimeSlot(slot: Slot): TimeSlot {
      const tables: AvailableTable[] = slot.tables.map((t) => ({
        id: t.id,
        name: t.name,
        capacity: t.capacity,
        minCovers: t.minCovers,
        maxCovers: t.maxCovers,
      }));
      return {
        time: slot.start.toISOString(),
        available: slot.available,
        tables: tables.length > 0 ? tables : undefined,
      };
    }
    function dayView(snapshot: BookingSnapshot, date: string): BookingSnapshot {
      const from = serviceDayInstant(addDays(date, -1), 0, snapshot.timezone);
      const to = serviceDayInstant(addDays(date, 2), 0, snapshot.timezone);
      // A zone whose clocks skip midnight has no such instant; keep everything.
      if (!from || !to) return snapshot;
      const nearby = (b: { startTime: Date }) => b.startTime >= from && b.startTime < to;
      return {
        ...snapshot,
        reservations: snapshot.reservations.filter(nearby),
        holds: snapshot.holds.filter(nearby),
      };
    }
    function listDay(loaded: LoadedSnapshot, date: string, partySize: number, now: Date) {
      const { venueSettings } = loaded;
      const snapshot = dayView(loaded.snapshot, date);
      const seatings = listSlots(snapshot, date, partySize, "online", now);
      // No table could ever seat the party: offer no times at all, as before the engine.
      if (filterSuitableTables(snapshot.tables, partySize).length === 0) {
        return { seatings, offered: [] };
      }
      const window = bookingWindow(venueSettings, now, snapshot.timezone);
      return { seatings, offered: seatings.filter((s) => isSlotInBookingWindow(s.start, window)) };
    }
    function noticesFor(loaded: LoadedSnapshot, date: string, seatingCount: number) {
      return dayNotices(loaded.snapshot, date, loaded.venueSettings?.phone ?? null, seatingCount);
    }
    export async function getDayAvailability(
      venueId: string,
      date: string,
      partySize: number,
      durationOverride?: number,
      options: ListingOptions = {}
    ): Promise<DayAvailability> {
      const now = new Date();
      const loaded = await loadOrNull(venueId, date, date, now, options);
      if (!loaded) return { slots: [] };
      const timed = { ...loaded, snapshot: withDuration(loaded.snapshot, partySize, durationOverride) };
      const { seatings, offered } = listDay(timed, date, partySize, now);
      return { slots: offered.map(toTimeSlot), ...noticesFor(loaded, date, seatings.length) };
    }
    export async function generateTimeSlots(
      venueId: string,
      date: string,
      partySize: number,
      durationOverride?: number,
      options: ListingOptions = {}
    ): Promise<TimeSlot[]> {
      return (await getDayAvailability(venueId, date, partySize, durationOverride, options)).slots;
    }
    function rangeDates(startDate: string, endDate: string): string[] {
      const span = Math.ceil((Date.parse(endDate) - Date.parse(startDate)) / MS_PER_DAY);
      const days = Math.min(span, MAX_RANGE_DAYS);
      return days >= 0 ? Array.from({ length: days + 1 }, (_, i) => addDays(startDate, i)) : [];
    }
    export async function getAvailableDates(
      venueId: string,
      startDate: string,
      endDate: string,
      partySize: number,
      options: ListingOptions = {}
    ): Promise<DateAvailability[]> {
      const dates = rangeDates(startDate, endDate);
      const lastDate = dates.at(-1);
      const now = new Date();
      const loaded = lastDate ? await loadOrNull(venueId, startDate, lastDate, now, options) : null;
      if (!loaded) return dates.map((date) => ({ date, hasAvailability: false, slotCount: 0 }));
    
      return dates.map((date) => {
        const { seatings, offered } = listDay(loaded, date, partySize, now);
        const slotCount = offered.filter((s) => s.available).length;
        const { closure } = noticesFor(loaded, date, seatings.length);
        return { date, hasAvailability: slotCount > 0, slotCount, ...(closure ? { closure } : {}) };
      });
    }
    export async function findBestTable(
      venueId: string,
      date: string,
      startTime: Date,
      endTime: Date,
      partySize: number
    ): Promise<Table | null> {
      const tables = await findSuitableTables(venueId, partySize);
    
      const { reservations, holds } = await fetchConflictData(venueId, date);
    
      return selectBestTable(tables, startTime, endTime, reservations, holds) as Table | null;
    }
    async function findSuitableTables(venueId: string, partySize: number): Promise<Table[]> {
      // The party-fits rule (maxCovers ?? capacity as the ceiling) lives in one
      // place - @mbe/types' partyFitsTable - so it is applied here rather than
      // re-expressed as a Prisma `where`, where null maxCovers meant "unlimited".
      const tables = await prisma.table.findMany({
        where: { venueId, isActive: true },
        orderBy: [{ priority: "desc" }, { capacity: "asc" }],
      });
      return filterSuitableTables(tables, partySize);
    }
    export async function fetchConflictData(
      venueId: string,
      date: string
    ): Promise<{ reservations: ReservationSlim[]; holds: HoldSlim[] }> {
      const [reservations, holds] = await Promise.all([
        prisma.reservation.findMany({
          where: {
            venueId,
            date: serviceDayConflictWindow(new Date(date)),
            status: { notIn: [...NOT_BOOKED_STATUSES] },
          },
          select: {
            id: true,
            tableId: true,
            startTime: true,
            endTime: true,
            partySize: true,
          },
        }),
        prisma.reservationHold.findMany({
          where: {
            venueId,
            date: serviceDayConflictWindow(new Date(date)),
            expiresAt: activeHoldWindow(new Date()),
          },
          select: {
            id: true,
            tableId: true,
            startTime: true,
            endTime: true,
            partySize: true,
            expiresAt: true,
          },
        }),
      ]);
    
      return { reservations, holds };
    }
    export const availabilityService = {
      generateTimeSlots,
      getDayAvailability,
      getAvailableDates,
      findBestTable,
      fetchConflictData,
    };

    export function tableAdvisoryLockSql(tableId: string): Prisma.Sql {
      return Prisma.sql`SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(${tableId})::bigint)`;
    }
    export type SlotConflictCode = "CONFLICT" | "PACING_EXCEEDED" | "EXPIRED" | "NOT_BOOKABLE";
    export type SlotConflict =
      | { code: Exclude<SlotConflictCode, "NOT_BOOKABLE">; message: string }
      | { code: "NOT_BOOKABLE"; message: string; rejection: GateRejection };
    export type SlotWriteResult<T> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; conflict: SlotConflict };
    export interface BookSlotIntent<T> {
      /** Table whose slot is written; keys the advisory lock and conflict re-check. */
      tableId: string;
      /** Venue for the pacing re-check; null/undefined skips pacing. */
      venueId?: string | null;
      /** Date-only used by the in-transaction conflict/pacing queries. */
      date: Date;
      /** Slot window — [startTime, endTime). */
      window: { startTime: Date; endTime: Date };
      /** Party size added when computing the pacing re-check. */
      partySize: number;
      /** Reservation excluded from the conflict re-check (moving an existing reservation). */
      excludeReservationId?: string;
      /** Hold excluded from the conflict/pacing re-check (confirming that hold). */
      excludeHoldId?: string;
      /** Session whose holds are excluded from the re-check (own session's holds during hold-create). */
      excludeSessionId?: string;
      /** Also re-check conflicting holds (not just reservations). */
      checkHoldConflict?: boolean;
      /** Re-check pacing under the lock. Requires venueId. */
      checkPacing?: boolean;
      /**
       * Judge the slot against the venue's resolved availability under the lock,
       * reading the committed configuration through this transaction
       * ({@link judgeBooking}). Requires venueId. Walk-ins never set it.
       */
      gate?: { channel: BookingChannel; override?: { reason: string } };
      /**
       * Runs immediately after the lock, before the conflict re-check. Returning a
       * {@link SlotConflict} short-circuits the write (e.g. a hold that expired
       * between lookup and acquiring the lock).
       */
      guard?: (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient) => Promise<SlotConflict | undefined>;
      /**
       * Runs inside the transaction whenever the slot is unbookable (guard,
       * conflict, or pacing), before {@link bookSlot} returns — e.g. deleting the
       * hold that could not be confirmed.
       */
      onUnbookable?: (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, conflict: SlotConflict) => Promise<void>;
      /**
       * Performs the actual mutation once the slot is confirmed bookable.
       * `gated.overrideLimits` lists the soft limits a staff override passed, so
       * the write can store them with the booking.
       */
      write: (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, gated: { overrideLimits?: SoftLimit[] }) => Promise<T>;
    }
    export async function bookSlot<T>(intent: BookSlotIntent<T>): Promise<SlotWriteResult<T>> {
      const {
        tableId,
        venueId,
        date,
        window: { startTime, endTime },
        partySize,
        excludeReservationId,
        excludeHoldId,
        excludeSessionId,
        checkHoldConflict = false,
        checkPacing = false,
        gate,
        guard,
        onUnbookable,
        write,
      } = intent;
      const serviceDays = serviceDayConflictWindow(date);
    
      return prisma.$transaction(async (tx): Promise<SlotWriteResult<T>> => {
        // This `prisma.$transaction` call bypasses the per-call auto-wrap
        // `services/venue-scoped-prisma.ts` gives the `prisma` export — set
        // app.venue_id on THIS transaction's own `tx` explicitly (ADR-026 part
        // 6), using the intent's own (already-resolved) venueId.
        await setVenueContext(tx, venueId);
    
        // Serialize conflict-checked writes per table BEFORE any conflict check so
        // concurrent slot writes cannot both pass and double-book. Released
        // automatically when the transaction ends.
        await tx.$executeRaw(tableAdvisoryLockSql(tableId));
    
        const fail = async (conflict: SlotConflict): Promise<SlotWriteResult<T>> => {
          if (onUnbookable) await onUnbookable(tx, conflict);
          return { ok: false, conflict };
        };
    
        if (guard) {
          const guardConflict = await guard(tx);
          if (guardConflict) return fail(guardConflict);
        }
    
        const conflictingReservation = await tx.reservation.findFirst({
          where: {
            tableId,
            date: serviceDays,
            status: { notIn: [...NOT_BOOKED_STATUSES] },
            ...overlapWindow(startTime, endTime),
            ...(excludeReservationId ? { id: { not: excludeReservationId } } : {}),
          },
          select: { id: true },
        });
        if (conflictingReservation) {
          return fail({ code: "CONFLICT", message: "Table is not available for this time slot" });
        }
    
        if (checkHoldConflict) {
          const conflictingHold = await tx.reservationHold.findFirst({
            where: {
              tableId,
              date: serviceDays,
              expiresAt: activeHoldWindow(new Date()),
              ...overlapWindow(startTime, endTime),
              ...(excludeHoldId ? { id: { not: excludeHoldId } } : {}),
              ...(excludeSessionId ? { sessionId: { not: excludeSessionId } } : {}),
            },
            select: { id: true },
          });
          if (conflictingHold) {
            return fail({ code: "CONFLICT", message: "Table is not available for this time slot" });
          }
        }
    
        if (checkPacing && venueId) {
          const now = new Date();
          const reservations = await tx.reservation.findMany({
            where: { venueId, date: serviceDays, status: { notIn: [...NOT_BOOKED_STATUSES] } },
            select: { id: true, tableId: true, startTime: true, endTime: true, partySize: true },
          });
          const holds = await tx.reservationHold.findMany({
            where: {
              venueId,
              date: serviceDays,
              expiresAt: activeHoldWindow(now),
              ...(excludeHoldId ? { id: { not: excludeHoldId } } : {}),
              ...(excludeSessionId ? { sessionId: { not: excludeSessionId } } : {}),
            },
            select: {
              id: true,
              tableId: true,
              startTime: true,
              endTime: true,
              partySize: true,
              expiresAt: true,
            },
          });
          const settings = (
            await tx.venue.findUnique({ where: { id: venueId }, select: { settings: true } })
          )?.settings as VenueSettings | null | undefined;
    
          const pacingOk = checkPacingForSlot(startTime, partySize, settings, reservations, holds);
          if (!pacingOk) {
            return fail({
              code: "PACING_EXCEEDED",
              message: "Pacing limit reached for this time slot",
            });
          }
        }
    
        let gated: { overrideLimits?: SoftLimit[] } = {};
        if (gate && venueId) {
          const verdict = await availabilityVerdict(tx, { ...intent, venueId }, gate);
          if (verdict.conflict) return fail(verdict.conflict);
          gated = { overrideLimits: verdict.overrideLimits };
        }
    
        const value = await write(tx, gated);
        return { ok: true, value };
      });
    }
    async function availabilityVerdict(
      tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
      intent: BookSlotIntent<unknown> & { venueId: string },
      gate: NonNullable<BookSlotIntent<unknown>["gate"]>
    ): Promise<{ conflict?: SlotConflict; overrideLimits?: SoftLimit[] }> {
      const outcome = await judgeBooking(tx, {
        venueId: intent.venueId,
        tableId: intent.tableId,
        start: intent.window.startTime,
        end: intent.window.endTime,
        partySize: intent.partySize,
        channel: gate.channel,
        override: gate.override,
        excludeReservationId: intent.excludeReservationId,
        excludeHoldId: intent.excludeHoldId,
        excludeSessionId: intent.excludeSessionId,
      });
      if (outcome.kind === "conflict") {
        return { conflict: { code: "CONFLICT", message: "Table is not available for this time slot" } };
      }
      if (outcome.kind === "rejected") {
        return {
          conflict: { code: "NOT_BOOKABLE", message: GATE_MESSAGE, rejection: outcome.rejection },
        };
      }
      return { overrideLimits: outcome.overrideLimits };
    }

    export interface ReservationStatusCounts {
      pending: number;
      confirmed: number;
      cancelled: number;
      completed: number;
      noShow: number;
    }
    export interface DepositTransitionCounts {
      held: number;
      applied: number;
      refunded: number;
      forfeited: number;
    }
    export interface ReservationEventCounts {
      byKind: Record<ReservationEventKind, number>;
      rejectedTransitions: number;
    }
    export interface DailyBookingMetrics {
      date: string;
      venueId: string;
      reservations: ReservationStatusCounts;
      deposits: DepositTransitionCounts;
      events: ReservationEventCounts;
    }
    export interface GetDailyBookingMetricsParams {
      /** YYYY-MM-DD */
      date: string;
      venueId: string;
    }
    async function getDailyBookingMetrics(
      params: GetDailyBookingMetricsParams
    ): Promise<DailyBookingMetrics> {
      const { date, venueId } = params;
      // `Reservation.date` is a @db.Date column (no time component), so exact
      // equality on UTC midnight scopes to the whole day. Deposit transition
      // columns are full DateTime, so those need a [dayStart, dayEnd) range.
      const dayStart = new Date(`${date}T00:00:00.000Z`);
      const dayEnd = new Date(dayStart.getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    
      const [reservationGroups, held, applied, refunded, forfeited, eventGroups] = await Promise.all([
        prisma.reservation.groupBy({
          by: ["status"],
          where: { venueId, date: dayStart },
          _count: true,
        }),
        prisma.deposit.count({
          where: { reservation: { venueId }, heldAt: { gte: dayStart, lt: dayEnd } },
        }),
        prisma.deposit.count({
          where: { reservation: { venueId }, appliedAt: { gte: dayStart, lt: dayEnd } },
        }),
        prisma.deposit.count({
          where: { reservation: { venueId }, refundedAt: { gte: dayStart, lt: dayEnd } },
        }),
        prisma.deposit.count({
          where: { reservation: { venueId }, forfeitedAt: { gte: dayStart, lt: dayEnd } },
        }),
        prisma.reservationEvent.groupBy({
          by: ["kind"],
          where: { venueId, createdAt: { gte: dayStart, lt: dayEnd } },
          _count: true,
        }),
      ]);
    
      const reservations: ReservationStatusCounts = {
        pending: 0,
        confirmed: 0,
        cancelled: 0,
        completed: 0,
        noShow: 0,
      };
      for (const group of reservationGroups) {
        const key = RESERVATION_STATUS_KEYS[group.status];
        reservations[key] = group._count;
      }
    
      const byKind = Object.fromEntries(RESERVATION_EVENT_KINDS.map((kind) => [kind, 0])) as Record<
        ReservationEventKind,
        number
      >;
      for (const group of eventGroups) {
        if (group.kind in byKind) byKind[group.kind as ReservationEventKind] = group._count;
      }
    
      return {
        date,
        venueId,
        reservations,
        deposits: { held, applied, refunded, forfeited },
        events: { byKind, rejectedTransitions: byKind.transition_rejected },
      };
    }
    export const bookingMetricsService = { getDailyBookingMetrics };

    export interface AlongsideIssue {
      path: string;
      code: string;
      message: string;
    }
    function canonical(value: unknown): unknown {
      if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(canonical);
      if (value === null || typeof value !== "object") return value;
      return Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(value)
          .filter(([, v]) => v != null && !(Array.isArray(v) && v.length === 0))
          .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
          .map(([k, v]) => [k, canonical(v)])
      );
    }
    function onlyShortened(edited: DateRule, stored: DateRule): boolean {
      return (
        edited.endsOn != null &&
        (stored.endsOn == null || edited.endsOn < stored.endsOn) &&
        same({ ...edited, endsOn: stored.endsOn }, stored)
      );
    }
    function onlyMoved(edited: DateRule, stored: DateRule, seriesId: string, draftId: string) {
      return (
        stored.seriesId === seriesId &&
        (edited.seriesId === seriesId || edited.seriesId === draftId) &&
        same({ ...edited, seriesId: stored.seriesId }, stored)
      );
    }
    export function checkAlongside(
      stored: readonly DateRule[],
      draft: DateRule,
      alongside: ClosureAlongside
    ): AlongsideIssue | null {
      const byId = new Map(stored.map((r) => [r.id, r]));
      const touched = new Set([
        ...alongside.remove,
        ...alongside.upsert
          .filter((u) => byId.has(u.id) && isSeriesRow(byId.get(u.id)!))
          .map((u) => u.id),
      ]);
      const [seriesId] = [...touched];
      const series = seriesId ? byId.get(seriesId) : undefined;
      if (touched.size !== 1 || !series || !isSeriesRow(series) || series.id === draft.id) {
        return refuse("alongside", "A series edit replaces exactly one stored repeating closure.");
      }
      if (alongside.remove.some((id) => id !== series.id)) {
        return refuse("alongside.remove", "Only the replaced series can be removed.");
      }
      for (const edited of alongside.upsert) {
        const row = byId.get(edited.id);
        const path = `alongside.upsert.${edited.id}`;
        if (!row) return refuse(path, "A series edit adds no rows beside the new series.");
        if (edited.id === series.id) {
          if (alongside.remove.length > 0 || !onlyShortened(edited, row)) {
            return refuse(path, "The replaced series can only end earlier.");
          }
        } else if (!onlyMoved(edited, row, series.id, draft.id)) {
          return refuse(path, "Only the series' own skips and edited dates move, unchanged.");
        }
      }
      return null;
    }

    type Tx = Pick<
      PrismaClient,
      "reservation" | "reservationEvent" | "reservationHold" | "$executeRaw"
    >;
    export interface PlannedTransition {
      reservationId: string;
      action: ClosureAction;
      movedTo: Date | null;
    }
    export type ApplyResult =
      | { kind: "ok" }
      | { kind: "move_conflict"; reservationIds: string[] }
      | { kind: "cannot_cancel"; reservationId: string; detail: string };
    interface Existing {
      id: string;
      status: string;
      tableId: string | null;
      date: Date;
      startTime: Date;
      endTime: Date;
      partySize: number;
    }
    async function cancelInTx(
      tx: Tx,
      venueId: string,
      actorId: string,
      r: Existing
    ): Promise<ApplyResult> {
      try {
        transitionReservation(r.status as never, "CANCELLED");
      } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof ReservationTransitionError) {
          return { kind: "cannot_cancel", reservationId: r.id, detail: error.message };
        }
        throw error;
      }
      const { count } = await tx.reservation.updateMany({
        where: { id: r.id, venueId, status: r.status as never },
        data: {
          status: "CANCELLED",
          cancellationReason: "venue_closure",
          cancellationNote: "Cancelled by the venue: closure",
        },
      });
      if (count === 0) {
        return { kind: "cannot_cancel", reservationId: r.id, detail: "Reservation changed meanwhile" };
      }
      await recordReservationEvent(tx as never, {
        reservationId: r.id,
        venueId,
        kind: "cancelled",
        actor: staffActor(actorId),
        from: stateOf(r),
        to: stateOf(r, { status: "CANCELLED" }),
      });
      return { kind: "ok" };
    }
    async function targetTaken(
      tx: Tx,
      venueId: string,
      r: Existing,
      startTime: Date,
      endTime: Date
    ): Promise<boolean> {
      const tableId = r.tableId as string;
      await tx.$executeRaw(tableAdvisoryLockSql(tableId));
      const clash = await tx.reservation.findFirst({
        where: {
          venueId,
          tableId,
          id: { not: r.id },
          status: { notIn: [...NOT_BOOKED_STATUSES] },
          ...overlapWindow(startTime, endTime),
        },
        select: { id: true },
      });
      if (clash) return true;
      const hold = await tx.reservationHold.findFirst({
        where: {
          tableId,
          date: serviceDayConflictWindow(r.date),
          expiresAt: activeHoldWindow(new Date()),
          ...overlapWindow(startTime, endTime),
        },
        select: { id: true },
      });
      return hold !== null;
    }
    async function moveInTx(
      tx: Tx,
      venueId: string,
      actorId: string,
      r: Existing,
      startTime: Date
    ): Promise<boolean> {
      const endTime = new Date(startTime.getTime() + (r.endTime.getTime() - r.startTime.getTime()));
      if (r.tableId && (await targetTaken(tx, venueId, r, startTime, endTime))) return false;
      const { count } = await tx.reservation.updateMany({
        where: { id: r.id, venueId, status: r.status as never },
        data: { startTime, endTime },
      });
      if (count === 0) return false;
      await recordReservationEvent(tx as never, {
        reservationId: r.id,
        venueId,
        kind: "moved",
        actor: staffActor(actorId),
        from: stateOf(r),
        to: stateOf(r, { startTime, endTime }),
      });
      return true;
    }
    export async function applyTransitions(
      tx: Tx,
      venueId: string,
      actorId: string,
      planned: readonly PlannedTransition[]
    ): Promise<ApplyResult> {
      const work = planned.filter((p) => p.action === "cancel" || p.action === "move");
      if (work.length === 0) return { kind: "ok" };
      const rows = await tx.reservation.findMany({
        where: { venueId, id: { in: work.map((p) => p.reservationId) } },
        select: {
          id: true,
          status: true,
          tableId: true,
          date: true,
          startTime: true,
          endTime: true,
          partySize: true,
        },
      });
      const byId = new Map<string, Existing>(rows.map((r) => [r.id, r as Existing]));
      const ordered = [...work].sort(
        (a, b) => Number(a.action === "move") - Number(b.action === "move")
      );
      const conflicts: string[] = [];
      for (const p of ordered) {
        const r = byId.get(p.reservationId);
        if (!r) continue;
        if (p.action === "cancel") {
          const result = await cancelInTx(tx, venueId, actorId, r);
          if (result.kind !== "ok") return result;
        } else if (!(await moveInTx(tx, venueId, actorId, r, p.movedTo as Date))) {
          conflicts.push(r.id);
        }
      }
      return conflicts.length > 0
        ? { kind: "move_conflict", reservationIds: conflicts }
        : { kind: "ok" };
    }

    export type DecisionCheck =
      | { kind: "ok"; actions: ReadonlyMap<string, ClosureDecision> }
      | { kind: "decision-required"; groupKeys: string[] }
      | { kind: "invalid-decision"; groupKeys: string[] };
    export function checkDecisions(
      impact: ClosureImpact,
      decisions: readonly ClosureDecision[]
    ): DecisionCheck {
      const groups = new Map(impact.groups.map((g) => [g.groupKey, g]));
      const seen = new Set<string>();
      const invalid: string[] = [];
      for (const d of decisions) {
        const group = groups.get(d.groupKey);
        const bad =
          !group || seen.has(d.groupKey) || (d.action === "move" && group.kind !== "shortened");
        if (bad) invalid.push(d.groupKey);
        seen.add(d.groupKey);
      }
      if (invalid.length > 0) return { kind: "invalid-decision", groupKeys: invalid };
    
      const answered = new Map(decisions.map((d) => [d.groupKey, d]));
      const missing = impact.groups
        .map((g) => g.groupKey)
        .filter((key) => {
          const d = answered.get(key);
          return !d || (d.action === "keep_silent" && d.acknowledged !== true);
        });
      return missing.length > 0
        ? { kind: "decision-required", groupKeys: missing }
        : { kind: "ok", actions: answered };
    }
    export function countActions(actions: readonly ClosureAction[]): Record<ClosureAction, number> {
      const counts = { cancel: 0, move: 0, keep_notify: 0, keep_silent: 0 };
      for (const a of actions) counts[a] += 1;
      return counts;
    }
    function wallMinutes(instant: Date, serviceDate: string, tz: string): number {
      const local = localDateTimeOf(instant, tz);
      return (
        ((Date.parse(local.date) - Date.parse(serviceDate)) / MS_PER_DAY) * MINUTES_PER_DAY +
        local.minute
      );
    }
    export function moveTarget(
      after: AvailabilitySnapshot,
      serviceDate: string,
      booking: Pick<ClosureImpactReservation, "startTime" | "endTime">
    ): { startTime: Date; endTime: Date } | null {
      const start = new Date(booking.startTime);
      const durationMin = (Date.parse(booking.endTime) - start.getTime()) / MS_PER_MINUTE;
      const startMin = wallMinutes(start, serviceDate, after.timezone);
      const candidates = resolveDay(after, serviceDate).services.flatMap((s) => {
        const latest = Math.min(s.lastSeatingAt, s.closesAt - durationMin);
        if (latest < s.opensAt) return [];
        return [Math.min(Math.max(startMin, s.opensAt), latest)];
      });
      const best = candidates.sort((a, b) => Math.abs(a - startMin) - Math.abs(b - startMin))[0];
      if (best === undefined || best === startMin) return null;
      const startTime = serviceDayInstant(serviceDate, best, after.timezone);
      return startTime
        ? { startTime, endTime: new Date(startTime.getTime() + durationMin * MS_PER_MINUTE) }
        : null;
    }
    export function currentServiceDate(snapshot: AvailabilitySnapshot, now: Date): string {
      const today = localDateTimeOf(now, snapshot.timezone).date;
      const isOpen = (date: string): boolean => {
        const minute = wallMinutes(now, date, snapshot.timezone);
        return resolveDay(snapshot, date).services.some(
          (s) => s.opensAt <= minute && minute < s.closesAt
        );
      };
      if (isOpen(today)) return today;
      const yesterday = addDays(today, -1);
      return isOpen(yesterday) ? yesterday : today;
    }
    export function closesAllOfTonight(snapshot: AvailabilitySnapshot, rule: DateRule): boolean {
      if (rule.kind !== "tonight" || !("closeAt" in rule.payload)) return false;
      const { closeAt } = rule.payload;
      const planned = {
        ...snapshot,
        config: {
          ...snapshot.config,
          dateRules: snapshot.config.dateRules.filter((r) => r.kind !== "tonight"),
        },
      };
      const targeted = resolveDay(planned, rule.startsOn).services.filter(
        (s) => rule.targetKind === "venue" || s.venueServiceId === rule.venueServiceId
      );
      return targeted.length > 0 && targeted.every((s) => s.opensAt >= closeAt);
    }
    export function isHostEmergencyClose(rule: DateRule, serviceDate: string): boolean {
      return (
        rule.kind === "closure" &&
        rule.targetKind === "venue" &&
        !rule.window &&
        !rule.repeat &&
        rule.startsOn === serviceDate &&
        rule.endsOn === serviceDate
      );
    }
