    type StoreClient = Pick<PrismaClient, "$transaction">;
    type Db = StoreDb &
      Pick<PrismaClient, "closureOutcome" | "reservationEvent" | "reservationHold" | "$executeRaw">;
    export const TONIGHT_RULE_KINDS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(["tonight"]);
    export interface ClosureCaller {
      /** Owner, manager or platform admin. Anyone else is a Host. */
      isManager: boolean;
      actorId: string;
    }
    export type CreateClosureOutcome =
      | { kind: "saved"; result: ClosureResult }
      | { kind: "not_found" }
      | { kind: "forbidden" }
      | { kind: "too_long" }
      | { kind: "version_conflict"; winningChange: AvailabilityChangeSummary | null }
      | { kind: "key_reused" }
      | { kind: "closure_exists" }
      | { kind: "invalid"; issues: { path: string; code: string; message: string }[] }
      | { kind: "decision_required"; groupKeys: string[] }
      | { kind: "invalid_decision"; groupKeys: string[] }
      | { kind: "move_unavailable"; reservationIds: string[] };
    type Refusal = Exclude<CreateClosureOutcome, { kind: "saved" }>;
    class Refused extends Error {
      constructor(readonly outcome: Refusal) {
        super(outcome.kind);
      }
    }
    interface ClosureMeta {
      ruleId: string;
      idempotencyKey: string;
      version: number;
      /** Set on every item of a batch save: what the whole batch was, so a reused key can be told apart. */
      batch?: BatchShape;
    }
    interface BatchShape {
      count: number;
      ruleIds: string[];
    }
    function sameBatch(stored: BatchShape | undefined, now: BatchShape): boolean {
      return (
        stored !== undefined &&
        stored.count === now.count &&
        Array.isArray(stored.ruleIds) &&
        stored.ruleIds.length === now.ruleIds.length &&
        stored.ruleIds.every((id, i) => id === now.ruleIds[i])
      );
    }
    export async function mayCloseFor(
      db: StoreDb,
      venueId: string,
      caller: Pick<ClosureCaller, "isManager">,
      rule: DateRule,
      now: Date
    ): Promise<boolean | null> {
      const venue = await db.venue.findUnique({
        where: { id: venueId },
        select: { hostEmergencyClose: true },
      });
      if (!venue) return null;
      if (caller.isManager) return true;
      // Tonight changes are a Host's own job, so only the emergency close needs the grant.
      if (rule.kind !== "tonight" && !venue.hostEmergencyClose) return false;
      const state = await loadConfigState(db, venueId, now);
      if (!state) return null;
      const snapshot = { timezone: state.timezone, config: state.effective };
      const serviceDate = currentServiceDate(snapshot, now);
      if (rule.kind !== "tonight") return isHostEmergencyClose(rule, serviceDate);
      if (rule.startsOn !== serviceDate) return false;
      // A close-early that leaves no targeted service tonight is the emergency close in effect.
      return venue.hostEmergencyClose || !closesAllOfTonight(snapshot, rule);
    }
    export function mayClose(
      venueId: string,
      isManager: boolean,
      rule: DateRule,
      now: Date,
      client: StoreClient = prisma
    ): Promise<boolean | null> {
      return client.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        await setVenueContext(tx, venueId);
        return mayCloseFor(tx, venueId, { isManager }, rule, now);
      });
    }
    async function findReplay(
      db: Pick<PrismaClient, "availabilityChange">,
      venueId: string,
      key: string
    ): Promise<{ id: string; actorId: string; closure: ClosureMeta } | null> {
      const change = await db.availabilityChange.findFirst({
        where: {
          venueId,
          kind: "closure",
          inverse: { path: ["closure", "idempotencyKey"], equals: key },
        },
        select: { id: true, actorId: true, inverse: true },
      });
      const closure = (change?.inverse as { closure?: ClosureMeta } | null | undefined)?.closure;
      return change && closure ? { id: change.id, actorId: change.actorId, closure } : null;
    }
    async function storedResult(
      tx: Pick<PrismaClient, "closureOutcome">,
      venueId: string,
      replay: { id: string; closure: ClosureMeta }
    ): Promise<ClosureResult> {
      const rows = await tx.closureOutcome.findMany({
        where: { venueId, dateRuleId: replay.closure.ruleId },
        select: { action: true },
      });
      return {
        ruleId: replay.closure.ruleId,
        version: replay.closure.version,
        changeId: replay.id,
        outcomes: countActions(rows.map((r) => r.action)),
      };
    }
    interface Plan {
      rows: Prisma.ClosureOutcomeCreateManyInput[];
      counts: Record<ClosureAction, number>;
      notifiedGuests: boolean;
    }
    function planOutcomes(
      venueId: string,
      actorId: string,
      state: ConfigState,
      rule: DateRule,
      alongside: ClosureAlongside | undefined,
      impact: ClosureImpact,
      actions: ReadonlyMap<string, { action: ClosureAction }>
    ): Plan | Refusal {
      const after = { timezone: state.timezone, config: withClosure(state.effective, rule, alongside) };
      const rows: Prisma.ClosureOutcomeCreateManyInput[] = [];
      const stuck: string[] = [];
      for (const group of impact.groups) {
        const action = actions.get(group.groupKey)!.action; // checkDecisions answered every group
        for (const r of group.reservations) {
          const target = action === "move" ? moveTarget(after, group.date, r) : null;
          if (action === "move" && !target) stuck.push(r.id);
          rows.push({
            venueId,
            dateRuleId: rule.id,
            reservationId: r.id,
            action,
            movedTo: target?.startTime ?? null,
            refund: action === "cancel" && r.deposit ? "pending" : "none",
            acknowledgedBy: action === "keep_silent" ? actorId : null,
          });
        }
      }
      if (stuck.length > 0) return { kind: "move_unavailable", reservationIds: stuck };
      const counts = { cancel: 0, move: 0, keep_notify: 0, keep_silent: 0 };
      for (const row of rows) counts[row.action] += 1;
      const notifiedGuests = [...actions.values()].some((d) => d.action !== "keep_silent");
      return { rows, counts, notifiedGuests };
    }
    function describe(rule: DateRule, counts: Record<ClosureAction, number>): string {
      const span =
        rule.endsOn && rule.endsOn !== rule.startsOn
          ? `${rule.startsOn} to ${rule.endsOn}`
          : rule.startsOn;
      const kept = counts.keep_notify + counts.keep_silent;
      const what = rule.kind === "tonight" ? "Closing early" : "Closure saved for";
      return `${what} ${span}: ${counts.cancel} cancelled, ${counts.move} moved, ${kept} kept`;
    }
    async function guard(
      tx: Db,
      input: { venueId: string; caller: ClosureCaller; rule: DateRule; now: Date }
    ): Promise<void> {
      const allowed = await mayCloseFor(tx, input.venueId, input.caller, input.rule, input.now);
      if (allowed === null) throw new Refused({ kind: "not_found" });
      if (!allowed) throw new Refused({ kind: "forbidden" });
    }
    type CommitInput = {
      venueId: string;
      caller: ClosureCaller;
      body: CreateClosureBody;
      key: string;
      now: Date;
      ruleKinds: ReadonlySet<string>;
      batch?: BatchShape;
    };
    async function replayOf(tx: Db, input: CommitInput): Promise<ClosureResult | null> {
      const { venueId, caller, body, key } = input;
      const replay = await findReplay(tx, venueId, key);
      if (!replay) return null;
      if (replay.closure.ruleId !== body.rule.id) throw new Refused({ kind: "key_reused" });
      if (!caller.isManager && replay.actorId !== caller.actorId) {
        throw new Refused({ kind: "forbidden" });
      }
      return storedResult(tx, venueId, replay);
    }
    async function refuseBadAlongside(tx: Db, input: CommitInput, state: ConfigState): Promise<void> {
      const { body, caller, venueId, now } = input;
      const { alongside, rule } = body;
      if (!alongside) return;
      if (!caller.isManager) throw new Refused({ kind: "forbidden" });
      const issue = checkAlongside(state.stored.dateRules, rule, alongside);
      if (issue) throw new Refused({ kind: "invalid", issues: [issue] });
      const today = civilDateIn(now, state.timezone);
      const stranded = findStrandedReservations(
        { timezone: state.timezone, config: state.effective },
        { timezone: state.timezone, config: withAlongside(state.effective, alongside) },
        await futureBookings(tx, venueId, today, now)
      );
      if (stranded.length > 0) {
        throw new Refused({
          kind: "invalid",
          issues: stranded.map((r) => ({
            path: `reservations.${r.id}`,
            code: "strands_booking",
            message: "The rows replaced beside the closure would leave this booking without service.",
          })),
        });
      }
    }
    async function preflight(tx: Db, input: CommitInput): Promise<void> {
      const { venueId, caller, body, now } = input;
      const { rule } = body;
      await guard(tx, { venueId, caller, rule, now });
      if (!input.ruleKinds.has(rule.kind)) {
        throw new Refused({
          kind: "invalid",
          issues: [
            {
              path: "rule.kind",
              code: "unsupported_kind",
              message: "A closure is saved as a closure or special hours.",
            },
          ],
        });
      }
      // The same rule id again, under a new key or version, is a second save of a
      // closure that already has its outcomes, not a new one.
      const existing = await tx.closureOutcome.count({ where: { venueId, dateRuleId: rule.id } });
      if (existing > 0) throw new Refused({ kind: "closure_exists" });
    }
    async function commit(tx: Db, input: CommitInput): Promise<ClosureResult> {
      const { venueId, caller, body, key, now } = input;
      const { rule } = body;
      const replayed = await replayOf(tx, input);
      if (replayed) return replayed;
      await preflight(tx, input);
      const cas = await tx.venue.updateMany({
        where: { id: venueId, availabilityVersion: body.expectedVersion },
        data: { availabilityVersion: { increment: 1 } },
      });
      if (cas.count === 0) throw new Refused((await refuseStale(tx, venueId)) as Refusal);
    
      const state = await loadConfigState(tx, venueId, now);
      if (!state) throw new Refused({ kind: "not_found" });
      // A day with no bookings leaves no outcome rows, so the stored rule is the
      // other witness that this id was already saved.
      if (state.stored.dateRules.some((r) => r.id === rule.id)) {
        throw new Refused({ kind: "closure_exists" });
      }
      await refuseBadAlongside(tx, input, state);
      const found = await impactInTransaction(tx, venueId, state, rule, now, body.alongside);
      if (found.kind !== "ok") throw new Refused(found);
      const checked = checkDecisions(found.impact, body.decisions);
      if (checked.kind === "decision-required") {
        throw new Refused({ kind: "decision_required", groupKeys: checked.groupKeys });
      }
      if (checked.kind === "invalid-decision") {
        throw new Refused({ kind: "invalid_decision", groupKeys: checked.groupKeys });
      }
      const plan = planOutcomes(
        venueId,
        caller.actorId,
        state,
        rule,
        body.alongside,
        found.impact,
        checked.actions
      );
      if (isRefusal(plan)) throw new Refused(plan);
    
      const next = withClosure(state.effective, rule, body.alongside);
      const diff = diffConfig(state.stored, next);
      await writeConfigDiff(tx, venueId, diff, { actorId: caller.actorId, now }).catch((e: unknown) => {
        throw e instanceof ConfigRowConflict ? new Refused(conflictIssue(e, next) as Refusal) : e;
      });
      const version = body.expectedVersion + 1;
      const range = affectedRange(state.stored, diff, civilDateIn(now, state.timezone));
      const meta: ClosureMeta = {
        ruleId: rule.id,
        idempotencyKey: key,
        version,
        ...(input.batch ? { batch: input.batch } : {}),
      };
      const inverse = { ...inverseOf(state.stored, diff, state.operatingHours), closure: meta };
      const change = await tx.availabilityChange.create({
        data: {
          venueId,
          actorId: caller.actorId,
          at: now,
          kind: "closure",
          summary: describe(rule, plan.counts),
          affectedFrom: toDbDate(range.from),
          affectedTo: toDbDate(range.to),
          inverse: inverse as unknown as Prisma.InputJsonValue,
          notifiedGuests: plan.notifiedGuests,
        },
        select: { id: true },
      });
      await tx.venue.update({
        where: { id: venueId },
        data: { operatingHours: projectLegacyOperatingHours(next) },
      });
      if (plan.rows.length > 0) await tx.closureOutcome.createMany({ data: plan.rows });
      const applied = await applyTransitions(
        tx,
        venueId,
        caller.actorId,
        plan.rows.map((r) => ({
          reservationId: r.reservationId,
          action: r.action,
          movedTo: r.movedTo as Date | null,
        }))
      );
      if (applied.kind === "move_conflict") {
        throw new Refused({ kind: "move_unavailable", reservationIds: applied.reservationIds });
      }
      if (applied.kind === "cannot_cancel") {
        throw new Refused({
          kind: "invalid",
          issues: [
            {
              path: `reservations.${applied.reservationId}`,
              code: "cannot_cancel",
              message: applied.detail,
            },
          ],
        });
      }
      return { ruleId: rule.id, version, changeId: change.id, outcomes: plan.counts };
    }
    export async function createClosure(
      input: {
        venueId: string;
        caller: ClosureCaller;
        body: CreateClosureBody;
        idempotencyKey: string;
        now: Date;
        /** Rule kinds this call may save; the Tonight API widens it to `tonight`. */
        ruleKinds?: ReadonlySet<string>;
      },
      client: StoreClient = prisma
    ): Promise<CreateClosureOutcome> {
      const { venueId, caller, body, idempotencyKey: key, now } = input;
      const ruleKinds = input.ruleKinds ?? CLOSURE_RULE_KINDS;
      try {
        const result = await client.$transaction(async (tx) => {
          await setVenueContext(tx, venueId);
          return commit(tx, { venueId, caller, body, key, now, ruleKinds });
        });
        return { kind: "saved", result };
      } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof Refused) return error.outcome;
        throw error;
      }
    }
    export type CreateClosuresOutcome =
      { kind: "saved"; result: ClosuresResult } | Exclude<CreateClosureOutcome, { kind: "saved" }>;
    export async function createClosures(
      input: {
        venueId: string;
        caller: ClosureCaller;
        body: CreateClosuresBody;
        idempotencyKey: string;
        now: Date;
      },
      client: StoreClient = prisma
    ): Promise<CreateClosuresOutcome> {
      const { venueId, caller, body, idempotencyKey: key, now } = input;
      if (!caller.isManager) return { kind: "forbidden" };
      try {
        const results = await client.$transaction(async (tx) => {
          await setVenueContext(tx, venueId);
          const saved: ClosureResult[] = [];
          const batch: BatchShape = {
            count: body.items.length,
            ruleIds: body.items.map((i) => i.rule.id),
          };
          // A key already used for a batch answers only to that same batch: never a subset of it,
          // and never a longer one whose appended items would commit beside the replayed ones.
          const first = await findReplay(tx, venueId, `${key}#0`);
          if (first && !sameBatch(first.closure.batch, batch)) {
            throw new Refused({ kind: "key_reused" });
          }
          let expectedVersion = body.expectedVersion;
          for (const [i, item] of body.items.entries()) {
            const result = await commit(tx, {
              venueId,
              caller,
              body: { expectedVersion, rule: item.rule, decisions: item.decisions },
              key: `${key}#${i}`,
              now,
              ruleKinds: CLOSURE_RULE_KINDS,
              batch,
            });
            saved.push(result);
            expectedVersion = result.version;
          }
          return saved;
        });
        return { kind: "saved", result: { version: results.at(-1)!.version, results } };
      } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof Refused) return error.outcome;
        throw error;
      }
    }
    async function requireAuthor(
      db: Pick<PrismaClient, "availabilityChange">,
      venueId: string,
      ruleId: string,
      actorId: string
    ): Promise<void> {
      const saved = await db.availabilityChange.findFirst({
        where: { venueId, kind: "closure", inverse: { path: ["closure", "ruleId"], equals: ruleId } },
        orderBy: { at: "desc" },
        select: { actorId: true },
      });
      if (saved?.actorId !== actorId) throw new Refused({ kind: "forbidden" });
    }
    export type ReopenOutcome =
      { kind: "reopened"; result: ReopenResult } | { kind: "not_found" } | { kind: "forbidden" };
    export async function reopenClosure(
      input: {
        venueId: string;
        ruleId: string;
        caller: ClosureCaller;
        tellCancelledGuests: boolean;
        now: Date;
      },
      client: StoreClient = prisma
    ): Promise<ReopenOutcome> {
      const { venueId, ruleId, caller, now } = input;
      try {
        return await client.$transaction(async (tx) => {
          await setVenueContext(tx, venueId);
          const db = tx as unknown as Db;
          const state = await loadConfigState(db, venueId, now);
          const rule = state?.stored.dateRules.find((r) => r.id === ruleId);
          if (!state || !rule || !CLOSURE_RULE_KINDS.has(rule.kind)) {
            throw new Refused({ kind: "not_found" });
          }
          await guard(db, { venueId, caller, rule, now });
          if (!caller.isManager) await requireAuthor(db, venueId, ruleId, caller.actorId);
    
          const next = {
            ...state.stored,
            dateRules: state.stored.dateRules.filter((r) => r.id !== ruleId),
          };
          const diff = diffConfig(state.stored, next);
          await writeConfigDiff(db, venueId, diff, { actorId: caller.actorId, now });
          const bumped = await db.venue.update({
            where: { id: venueId },
            data: {
              availabilityVersion: { increment: 1 },
              operatingHours: projectLegacyOperatingHours(next),
            },
            select: { availabilityVersion: true },
          });
          const range = affectedRange(state.stored, diff, civilDateIn(now, state.timezone));
          const change = await db.availabilityChange.create({
            data: {
              venueId,
              actorId: caller.actorId,
              at: now,
              kind: "reopen",
              summary: `Closure reopened (${rule.startsOn})`,
              affectedFrom: toDbDate(range.from),
              affectedTo: toDbDate(range.to),
              inverse: inverseOf(
                state.stored,
                diff,
                state.operatingHours
              ) as unknown as Prisma.InputJsonValue,
              notifiedGuests: input.tellCancelledGuests,
            },
            select: { id: true },
          });
          return {
            kind: "reopened" as const,
            result: { version: bumped.availabilityVersion, changeId: change.id },
          };
        });
      } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof Refused) return error.outcome as ReopenOutcome;
        throw error;
      }
    }
    export const closureCommandService = {
      create: createClosure,
      createMany: createClosures,
      reopen: reopenClosure,
      mayClose,
    };

    type StoreClient = Pick<PrismaClient, "$transaction">;
    type ImpactDb = Pick<PrismaClient, "table" | "reservation">;
    export type ClosureImpactOutcome =
      | { kind: "ok"; impact: ClosureImpact }
      | { kind: "not_found" }
      | { kind: "too_long" }
      | { kind: "invalid"; issues: { path: string; code: string; message: string }[] };
    function scanRange(rule: DateRule, today: string): { from: string; to: string } | null {
      const earliest = addDays(today, -1);
      const from = rule.startsOn > earliest ? rule.startsOn : earliest;
      // The year is counted from the first date that can hold a booking, so a series that began long
      // ago (an "All dates" edit keeps its start) is not "too long".
      if (rule.endsOn && rule.endsOn > addDays(from, SCOPE_CONFLICT_HORIZON_DAYS)) return null;
      return { from, to: rule.endsOn ?? addDays(from, SCOPE_CONFLICT_HORIZON_DAYS) };
    }
    export async function impactInTransaction(
      tx: ImpactDb,
      venueId: string,
      state: ConfigState,
      rule: DateRule,
      now: Date,
      alongside?: ClosureAlongside
    ): Promise<ClosureImpactOutcome> {
      const tables = await tx.table.findMany({ where: { venueId }, select: { id: true } });
      const next = withClosure(state.effective, rule, alongside);
      const issues = [
        ...validateConfig(next),
        ...referenceIssues(next, new Set(tables.map((t) => t.id))),
      ];
      if (issues.length > 0) return { kind: "invalid", issues };
    
      const range = scanRange(rule, civilDateIn(now, state.timezone));
      if (!range) return { kind: "too_long" };
    
      const rows = await tx.reservation.findMany({
        where: {
          venueId,
          date: { gte: toDbDate(range.from), lte: toDbDate(range.to) },
          startTime: { gte: now },
          status: { notIn: [...NOT_BOOKED_STATUSES] },
        },
        select: {
          id: true,
          tableId: true,
          date: true,
          startTime: true,
          endTime: true,
          partySize: true,
          guestName: true,
          deposit: { select: { amountCents: true, currency: true, status: true } },
        },
      });
      const bookings: ImpactBooking[] = rows.map(({ deposit, ...row }) => ({
        ...row,
        heldDeposit:
          deposit && LIVE_DEPOSIT_STATUSES.has(deposit.status)
            ? { amountCents: deposit.amountCents, currency: deposit.currency }
            : null,
      }));
      const impact = computeClosureImpact({
        timezone: state.timezone,
        config: state.effective,
        rule,
        alongside,
        bookings,
      });
      return { kind: "ok", impact };
    }
    export async function getClosureImpact(
      venueId: string,
      rule: DateRule,
      now: Date,
      client: StoreClient = prisma,
      alongside?: ClosureAlongside
    ): Promise<ClosureImpactOutcome> {
      return client.$transaction(async (tx) => {
        await setVenueContext(tx, venueId);
        const state = await loadConfigState(tx, venueId, now);
        if (!state) return { kind: "not_found" as const };
        return impactInTransaction(tx, venueId, state, rule, now, alongside);
      });
    }
    export const closureImpactService = { impact: getClosureImpact };

    export interface ImpactBooking {
      id: string;
      tableId: string | null;
      /** The service day (ADR-029). */
      date: Date;
      startTime: Date;
      endTime: Date;
      partySize: number;
      guestName: string | null;
      /** Set for a non-terminal deposit (`pending` or `held`). Named for the common case. */
      heldDeposit: { amountCents: number; currency: string } | null;
    }
    function kindOf(rule: DateRule): ClosureImpactKind {
      return rule.kind === "closure" && !rule.window ? "closed" : "shortened";
    }
    function withDraft(config: AvailabilityConfig, rule: DateRule): AvailabilityConfig {
      return { ...config, dateRules: [...config.dateRules.filter((r) => r.id !== rule.id), rule] };
    }
    export function withAlongside(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      alongside: ClosureAlongside | undefined
    ): AvailabilityConfig {
      if (!alongside) return config;
      const upserted = new Set(alongside.upsert.map((r) => r.id));
      const removed = new Set(alongside.remove);
      const kept = config.dateRules.filter((r) => !removed.has(r.id) && !upserted.has(r.id));
      return { ...config, dateRules: [...kept, ...alongside.upsert] };
    }
    export function withClosure(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      rule: DateRule,
      alongside?: ClosureAlongside
    ): AvailabilityConfig {
      return withDraft(withAlongside(config, alongside), rule);
    }
    function wallMinutes(instant: Date, serviceDate: string, tz: string): number {
      const local = localDateTimeOf(instant, tz);
      const days = (Date.parse(local.date) - Date.parse(serviceDate)) / MS_PER_DAY;
      return days * MINUTES_PER_DAY + local.minute;
    }
    function runsIntoBand(
      band: ResolvedClosure,
      startMin: number,
      endMin: number,
      servedServiceIds: ReadonlySet<string>
    ): boolean {
      const applies =
        band.targetKind === "venue" ||
        (band.targetKind === "service" &&
          band.venueServiceId !== undefined &&
          servedServiceIds.has(band.venueServiceId));
      return applies && band.from > startMin && band.from < endMin;
    }
    interface Verdicts {
      runsInto: boolean;
    }
    function assess(
      before: AvailabilitySnapshot,
      after: AvailabilitySnapshot,
      rule: DateRule,
      booking: ImpactBooking,
      replaced: ReadonlySet<string>
    ): Verdicts | null {
      if (strandReason(before, booking) !== null) return null; // already unserved: not this change's doing
      if (strandReason(after, booking) !== null) return { runsInto: false };
    
      const date = booking.date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const startMin = wallMinutes(booking.startTime, date, after.timezone);
      const endMin = wallMinutes(booking.endTime, date, after.timezone);
      const dayAfter = resolveDay(after, date);
      const dayBefore = resolveDay(before, date);
      const servedBefore = dayBefore.services.filter(
        (s) => s.opensAt <= startMin && startMin < s.closesAt
      );
    
      const servedIds = new Set(servedBefore.map((s) => s.venueServiceId));
      const draftBands = dayAfter.closures.filter(
        (band) => band.ruleId === rule.id && runsIntoBand(band, startMin, endMin, servedIds)
      );
      // Only the series being replaced counts as already decided: its band, no later than the
      // draft's, cut into this booking before and the Manager chose then. Any other closure is news.
      const bandRunsInto = draftBands.some(
        (draft) =>
          !dayBefore.closures.some(
            (band) =>
              replaced.has(band.ruleId) &&
              band.from <= draft.from &&
              runsIntoBand(band, startMin, endMin, servedIds)
          )
      );
      const hours = servedBefore.map((was) => ({
        was,
        now: dayAfter.services.find((s) => s.venueServiceId === was.venueServiceId),
      }));
      // The close moved earlier and the booking now runs past it — including one
      // that already ran past the old close (a late seating near last seating).
      const endsAfterClose = hours.some(
        ({ was, now }) =>
          now !== undefined &&
          now.closesAt < endMin &&
          (was.closesAt >= endMin || now.closesAt < was.closesAt)
      );
      const pastLastSeating = hours.some(
        ({ was, now }) =>
          now !== undefined && now.lastSeatingAt < startMin && was.lastSeatingAt >= startMin
      );
    
      if (bandRunsInto || endsAfterClose) return { runsInto: true };
      return pastLastSeating ? { runsInto: false } : null;
    }
    function toReservation(booking: ImpactBooking, runsInto: boolean): ClosureImpactReservation {
      return {
        id: booking.id,
        startTime: booking.startTime.toISOString(),
        endTime: booking.endTime.toISOString(),
        partySize: booking.partySize,
        guestName: booking.guestName,
        deposit: booking.heldDeposit,
        runsIntoClosure: runsInto,
      };
    }
    function toGroup(
      date: string,
      kind: ClosureImpactKind,
      reservations: ClosureImpactReservation[]
    ): ClosureImpactGroup {
      const sorted = [...reservations].sort((a, b) => a.startTime.localeCompare(b.startTime));
      return {
        groupKey: `${date}:${kind}`,
        date,
        kind,
        covers: sorted.reduce((n, r) => n + r.partySize, 0),
        depositsHeld: sorted.filter((r) => r.deposit !== null).length,
        reservations: sorted,
      };
    }
    export function computeClosureImpact(input: {
      timezone: string;
      config: AvailabilityConfig;
      rule: DateRule;
      alongside?: ClosureAlongside;
      bookings: readonly ImpactBooking[];
    }): ClosureImpact {
      const { timezone, config, rule, bookings, alongside } = input;
      const before = { timezone, config };
      const after = { timezone, config: withClosure(config, rule, alongside) };
      const kind = kindOf(rule);
      const replaced = new Set([
        ...(alongside?.remove ?? []),
        ...(alongside?.upsert.map((r) => r.id) ?? []),
      ]);
    
      const byDate = new Map<string, ClosureImpactReservation[]>();
      for (const booking of bookings) {
        const verdict = assess(before, after, rule, booking, replaced);
        if (!verdict) continue;
        const date = booking.date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        byDate.set(date, [...(byDate.get(date) ?? []), toReservation(booking, verdict.runsInto)]);
      }
    
      const groups = [...byDate.entries()]
        .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
        .map(([date, reservations]) => toGroup(date, kind, reservations));
      return {
        reservations: groups.reduce((n, g) => n + g.reservations.length, 0),
        covers: groups.reduce((n, g) => n + g.covers, 0),
        depositsHeld: groups.reduce((n, g) => n + g.depositsHeld, 0),
        groups,
      };
    }

    export function createClosureNoticeDeps(input: {

        sendSms: (m) => input.dispatcher.sendClosureSms(m),
        smsEnabled: input.dispatcher.smsEnabled,

      };

    export const URGENT_WINDOW_MS = 6 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
    type Store = Pick<
      typeof defaultStore,
      "listNotifiable" | "listCallList" | "listSummaries" | "loadClosureWindow"
    >;
    type Scheduler = Pick<JobsPort, "schedule">;
    interface EnqueueInput {
      venueId: string;
      ruleId: string;
      now: Date;
    }
    export function closureStartsAt(w: ClosureWindow): Date | null {
      return serviceDayInstant(w.startsOn, w.from ?? 0, w.timezone);
    }
    export function closureNoticeJobId(outcomeId: string, variant: NoticeVariant): string {
      return variant === "reopened"
        ? `closure-notice_${outcomeId}_reopened`
        : `closure-notice_${outcomeId}`;
    }
    async function isUrgent(store: Store, input: EnqueueInput): Promise<boolean> {
      const w = await store.loadClosureWindow(input.venueId, input.ruleId);
      const startsAt = w ? closureStartsAt(w) : null;
      return startsAt === null || startsAt.getTime() - input.now.getTime() <= URGENT_WINDOW_MS;
    }
    export function createClosureNoticeService(deps: { scheduler: Scheduler; store?: Store }) {
      const store = deps.store ?? defaultStore;
    
      async function enqueue(variant: NoticeVariant, input: EnqueueInput): Promise<number> {
        const outcomes = await store.listNotifiable(input.venueId, input.ruleId, variant);
        if (outcomes.length === 0) return 0;
        const urgent = await isUrgent(store, input);
        await Promise.all(
          outcomes.map((o) =>
            deps.scheduler.schedule(
              JOB_TYPES.CLOSURE_NOTICE,
              {
                outcomeId: o.outcomeId,
                venueId: input.venueId,
                variant,
                urgent,
              },
              0,
              closureNoticeJobId(o.outcomeId, variant)
            )
          )
        );
        return outcomes.length;
      }
    
      return {
        enqueueForClosure: (input: EnqueueInput) => enqueue("closure", input),
        enqueueForReopen: (input: EnqueueInput) => enqueue("reopened", input),
        callList: (venueId: string, ruleId: string) => store.listCallList(venueId, ruleId),
        summaries: (venueId: string) => store.listSummaries(venueId),
      };
    }
    export type ClosureNoticeService = ReturnType<typeof createClosureNoticeService>;

    export interface ClosureWindow {
      /** "YYYY-MM-DD", venue-local. */

    function windowFrom(window: unknown): number | null {
      const from = (window as { from?: unknown } | null)?.from;
      return typeof from === "number" ? from : null;
    }
    export async function loadClosureWindow(
      venueId: string,
      ruleId: string,
      db: RuleDb = prisma
    ): Promise<ClosureWindow | null> {

        where: { id: ruleId, venueId },

      });

      };

    export async function loadRebookSlots(o: NoticeOutcome, now: Date): Promise<Date[]> {
      const contact = { guestEmail: o.guestEmail, guestPhone: o.guestPhone };
      if (await rebookRequiresDeposit(o.venueId, contact)) return [];
      const today = civilDateIn(now, o.timezone);
      const { snapshot } = await loadAvailabilitySnapshot(o.venueId, today, addDays(today, 14), now);
      const result = rebookOffers(snapshot, { startTime: o.startTime, partySize: o.partySize }, now);
      return result.kind === "offers" ? result.slots.map((s) => s.start) : [];
    }

    export interface ClosureSummary {
      ruleId: string;
      total: number;
      cancelled: number;
      sent: number;
      rebooked: number;
      unreachable: number;
      refundFailed: number;
      /** The failed refunds by guest and amount; no contact details. */
      refundFailures: RefundFailure[];
      refundPending: number;
    }
    export interface RefundFailure {
      outcomeId: string;
      guestName: string | null;
      amountCents: number | null;
      currency: string | null;
    }
    interface SummaryRow {
      id: string;
      reservation: {
        guestName: string | null;
        deposit: {
          amountCents: number;
          currency: string;
          status: string;
          refundAmountCents: number | null;
          postCaptureRefundCents: number | null;
        } | null;
      };
      dateRuleId: string;
      action: NoticeOutcome["action"];
      deliveries: unknown;
      rebookedReservationId: string | null;
      refund: string;
    }
    function refundOwedCents(deposit: NonNullable<SummaryRow["reservation"]["deposit"]>): number {
      const ownLeg = deposit.status === "partial_refunded" ? (deposit.refundAmountCents ?? 0) : 0;
      return Math.max(0, deposit.amountCents - ownLeg - (deposit.postCaptureRefundCents ?? 0));
    }
    function refundFailureOf(row: SummaryRow): RefundFailure {
      const { guestName, deposit } = row.reservation;
      return {
        outcomeId: row.id,
        guestName,
        amountCents: deposit ? refundOwedCents(deposit) : null,
        currency: deposit?.currency ?? null,
      };
    }
    export function summarizeOutcomes(rows: readonly SummaryRow[]): ClosureSummary[] {
      const byRule = new Map<string, ClosureSummary>();
      for (const row of rows) {
        const deliveries = row.deliveries as Deliveries;
        const rebooked = row.rebookedReservationId !== null;
        const prev = byRule.get(row.dateRuleId) ?? { ruleId: row.dateRuleId, ...EMPTY_SUMMARY };
        const confirmed = deliveries.email === "sent" || deliveries.sms === "sent";
        byRule.set(row.dateRuleId, {
          ...prev,
          total: prev.total + 1,
          cancelled: prev.cancelled + (row.action === "cancel" ? 1 : 0),
          sent: prev.sent + (confirmed ? 1 : 0),
          rebooked: prev.rebooked + (rebooked ? 1 : 0),
          unreachable:
            prev.unreachable + (isOnCallList({ action: row.action, deliveries, rebooked }) ? 1 : 0),
          refundFailed: prev.refundFailed + (row.refund === "failed" ? 1 : 0),
          refundFailures:
            row.refund === "failed"
              ? [...prev.refundFailures, refundFailureOf(row)]
              : prev.refundFailures,
          refundPending: prev.refundPending + (row.refund === "pending" ? 1 : 0),
        });
      }
      return [...byRule.values()];
    }
    export async function listSummaries(venueId: string, db: Db = prisma): Promise<ClosureSummary[]> {
      const rows = await db.closureOutcome.findMany({
        where: { venueId },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" },
        select: {
          id: true,
          dateRuleId: true,
          action: true,
          deliveries: true,
          rebookedReservationId: true,
          refund: true,
          reservation: {
            select: {
              guestName: true,
              deposit: {
                select: {
                  amountCents: true,
                  currency: true,
                  status: true,
                  refundAmountCents: true,
                  postCaptureRefundCents: true,
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      });
      return summarizeOutcomes(rows);
    }

    export type DeliveryStatus = "sent" | "failed" | "skipped";
    export type ChannelStatuses = Partial<Record<NoticeChannel, DeliveryStatus>>;
    export type Deliveries = ChannelStatuses & { reopen?: ChannelStatuses };
    export interface NoticeOutcome {
      outcomeId: string;
      venueId: string;
      reservationId: string;
      action: "cancel" | "move" | "keep_notify" | "keep_silent";
      deliveries: Deliveries;
      /** The guest rebooked after the cancel. */
      rebooked: boolean;
      /** Venue-local service date the closure affects, "YYYY-MM-DD". */
      closureDate: string;
      message: string | null;
      /** The reservation's start as it stands now (the new time, for a move). */
      startTime: Date;
      partySize: number;
      guestName: string | null;
      guestEmail: string | null;
      guestPhone: string | null;
      preference: CommunicationPreference | null;
      refund: { amountCents: number; currency: string } | null;
      venueName: string;
      timezone: string;
    }
    export interface ClosureNoticeDeps {
      load(outcomeId: string): Promise<NoticeOutcome | null>;
      /** Open rebook times, computed now so they are still open when the message goes out. */
      offers(outcome: NoticeOutcome): Promise<Date[]>;
      /** The guest's manage link (a fresh token), with an optional one-tap rebook slot. */
      manageUrl(outcome: NoticeOutcome, rebook?: string): string;
      record(outcomeId: string, deliveries: Deliveries): Promise<void>;
      sendEmail(input: ClosureEmailInput): Promise<void>;
      sendSms(input: ClosureSmsInput): Promise<void>;
      smsEnabled: boolean;
      logger: { warn(details: object, msg: string): void };
    }
    export function isOnCallList(
      o: Pick<NoticeOutcome, "action" | "deliveries" | "rebooked">
    ): boolean {
      if (o.action === "keep_silent" || o.rebooked) return false;
      return o.deliveries.email !== "sent" && o.deliveries.sms !== "sent";
    }
    async function contentFor(
      o: NoticeOutcome,
      kind: ClosureNoticeKind,
      deps: ClosureNoticeDeps
    ): Promise<ClosureNoticeContent> {
      let slots: Date[] = [];
      if (kind === "cancelled") {
        try {
          slots = await deps.offers(o);
        } catch (error) {
          // The notice must still go out: link the full picker instead of offers.
          deps.logger.warn({ err: error, outcomeId: o.outcomeId }, "closure rebook offers failed");
        }
      }
      return {
        kind,
        venueName: o.venueName,
        guestName: o.guestName,
        closureDate: o.closureDate,
        startTime: o.startTime.toISOString(),
        timezone: o.timezone,
        partySize: o.partySize,
        message: o.message,
        refund: kind === "cancelled" ? o.refund : null,
        manageUrl: deps.manageUrl(o),
        offers: slots.map((s) => ({
          label: offerLabel(s, o.timezone),
          url: deps.manageUrl(o, rebookOfferId(s)),
        })),
      };
    }
    async function send(
      channel: NoticeChannel,
      o: NoticeOutcome,
      content: ClosureNoticeContent,
      deps: ClosureNoticeDeps
    ): Promise<void> {
      if (channel === "email") {
        const { subject, html } = buildClosureEmail(content);
        return deps.sendEmail({ to: o.guestEmail!, subject, html });
      }
      return deps.sendSms({ to: o.guestPhone!, body: buildClosureSms(content) });
    }
    export function createClosureNoticeHandler(deps: ClosureNoticeDeps) {
      async function deliver(payload: ClosureNoticePayload, ctx: JobContext): Promise<void> {
        const o = await deps.load(payload.outcomeId);
        if (!o) return;
        const reopened = payload.variant === "reopened";
        // A reopen notice goes only to guests the closure cancelled.
        const kind = reopened ? (o.action === "cancel" ? "reopened" : null) : KIND_OF_ACTION[o.action];
        if (!kind) return;
    
        const prior: ChannelStatuses = (reopened ? o.deliveries.reopen : o.deliveries) ?? {};
        const contacts = {
          hasEmail: Boolean(o.guestEmail?.trim()),
          hasSms: deps.smsEnabled && Boolean(o.guestPhone?.trim()),
        };
        const chosen = closureNoticeChannels(o.preference, contacts, payload.urgent ?? false);
        const todo = chosen.filter((c) => prior[c] !== "sent");
        const next: ChannelStatuses = { ...prior };
        for (const c of ["email", "sms"] as const) {
          if (!chosen.includes(c) && prior[c] !== "sent") next[c] = "skipped";
        }
    
        const content = todo.length > 0 ? await contentFor(o, kind, deps) : null;
        const results = await Promise.allSettled(todo.map((c) => send(c, o, content!, deps)));
        const failures: unknown[] = [];
        todo.forEach((channel, i) => {
          const result = results[i]!;
          if (result.status === "fulfilled") next[channel] = "sent";
          else {
            failures.push(result.reason);
            // Only the last attempt may call a channel failed; earlier ones retry.
            if (ctx.isFinalAttempt) next[channel] = "failed";
          }
        });
    
        await deps.record(
          o.outcomeId,
          reopened
            ? { ...o.deliveries, reopen: next }
            : { ...next, ...(o.deliveries.reopen ? { reopen: o.deliveries.reopen } : {}) }
        );
        if (failures.length > 0) throw failures[0];
      }
    
      return (payload: ClosureNoticePayload, ctx: JobContext): Promise<void> =>
        runWithVenueContext(payload.venueId, () => deliver(payload, ctx));
    }

    export function createPrismaClosureRefundStore(): ClosureRefundStore {
      return {
        load: (outcomeId) =>
          prisma.closureOutcome.findUnique({
            where: { id: outcomeId },
            select: {
              id: true,
              venueId: true,
              reservationId: true,
              dateRuleId: true,
              refund: true,
              reservation: { select: { status: true, cancellationReason: true } },
            },
          }),
        setRefund: async (outcomeId, refund) => {
          await prisma.closureOutcome.update({ where: { id: outcomeId }, data: { refund } });
        },
        resetToPending: async (outcomeId) => {
          await prisma.closureOutcome.updateMany({
            where: { id: outcomeId, refund: "failed" },
            data: { refund: "pending" },
          });
        },
        markFailed: async (outcomeId) => {
          await prisma.closureOutcome.updateMany({
            where: { id: outcomeId, refund: { notIn: ["done", "none"] } },
            data: { refund: "failed" },
          });
        },
        listByRule: (venueId, ruleId, statuses) =>
          prisma.closureOutcome.findMany({
            where: { venueId, dateRuleId: ruleId, refund: { in: [...statuses] } },
            select: { id: true, reservationId: true, refund: true },
          }),
      };
    }

    export interface ClosureRefundRow {
      id: string;
      venueId: string;
      reservationId: string;
      dateRuleId: string;
      refund: ClosureRefundStatus;
      reservation: { status: string; cancellationReason: string | null } | null;
    }
    export interface ClosureRefundStore {
      load(outcomeId: string): Promise<ClosureRefundRow | null>;
      setRefund(outcomeId: string, refund: ClosureRefundStatus): Promise<void>;
      /**
       * Returns a `failed` outcome to `pending` BEFORE its retry job is scheduled. Conditional on
       * `failed`: a row that settled (`done` / `none`) or is already `pending` is left alone.
       * Resetting first means a job that fails permanently always runs `markFailed` after the
       * reset, so the failure is never overwritten.
       */
      resetToPending(outcomeId: string): Promise<void>;
      /** Records `failed`, leaving an outcome a concurrent run already settled (`done` / `none`). */
      markFailed(outcomeId: string): Promise<void>;
      /** Outcomes of one closure whose refund is in one of `statuses`. */
      listByRule(
        venueId: string,
        ruleId: string,
        statuses: readonly ClosureRefundStatus[]
      ): Promise<{ id: string; reservationId: string; refund: ClosureRefundStatus }[]>;
    }
    export interface ClosureRefundDeps {
      deposits: Pick<DepositService, "getByReservationId" | "hold" | "refund" | "writeOffUncaptured">;
      payments: PaymentsPort;
      store: ClosureRefundStore;
    }
    export class ClosureRefundPermanentError extends Error {
      constructor(message: string) {
        super(message);
        this.name = "ClosureRefundPermanentError";
      }
    }
    export const closureRefundKey = (ruleId: string, reservationId: string): string =>
      `closure:${ruleId}:${reservationId}`;
    export const closureRefundJobId = (ruleId: string, reservationId: string): string =>
      closureRefundKey(ruleId, reservationId).replaceAll(":", "_");
    type Settled = ClosureRefundStatus;
    type CapturedStatus = "forfeited" | "applied" | "partial_refunded";
    async function writeOff(
      deps: ClosureRefundDeps,
      deposit: Deposit,
      settled: Settled
    ): Promise<Settled | null> {
      const count = await deps.deposits.writeOffUncaptured(
        deposit.id,
        deposit.status as CapturedStatus
      );
      return count > 0 ? settled : null;
    }
    async function refundCaptured(
      deps: ClosureRefundDeps,
      deposit: Deposit,
      row: ClosureRefundRow
    ): Promise<Settled | null> {
      if (row.reservation?.cancellationReason !== "venue_closure") return "none";
      const pi = deposit.stripePaymentIntentId;
      if (!pi) {
        throw new ClosureRefundPermanentError(
          `Deposit ${deposit.id} has no Stripe payment; refund it by hand`
        );
      }
      const intent = await deps.payments.retrievePaymentIntent(pi);
      if (intent.status === "canceled") return writeOff(deps, deposit, "none");
      if (intent.status === "requires_capture") {
        // The recorded capture never landed: release the hold, there is nothing to refund.
        await deps.payments.cancelPaymentIntent(pi, `${deposit.id}:refund`);
        return writeOff(deps, deposit, "done");
      }
      if (intent.status !== "succeeded") {
        throw new Error(`Payment ${pi} is ${intent.status}; cannot tell whether it was captured`);
      }
      if (await deps.payments.findDepositRefund(pi, deposit.id, "closureRefund")) return "done";
    
      const ownLeg =
        deposit.status === "partial_refunded"
          ? ((await deps.payments.findDepositRefund(pi, deposit.id, "refundPartial"))?.amount ?? 0)
          : 0;
      const owed = deposit.amountCents - ownLeg - (deposit.postCaptureRefundCents ?? 0);
      if (owed <= 0) return "done";
      await deps.payments.createPartialRefund(
        pi,
        owed,
        deposit.id,
        `${deposit.id}:closureRefund`,
        "closureRefund"
      );
      return "done";
    }
    async function resolvePending(deps: ClosureRefundDeps, deposit: Deposit): Promise<Settled | null> {
      const pi = deposit.stripePaymentIntentId;
      if (!pi) return "none"; // never reached Stripe; nothing was authorized
      const intent = await deps.payments.retrievePaymentIntent(pi);
      switch (intent.status) {
        case "canceled":
          return "none";
        case "requires_capture":
          await deps.deposits.hold(deposit.id, pi, REFUND_ACTOR);
          return null;
        case "requires_payment_method":
        case "requires_confirmation":
        case "requires_action":
          // Not authorized: cancel the intent so it can never be paid for a cancelled booking.
          await deps.payments.cancelPaymentIntent(pi, `${deposit.id}:refund`);
          return "none";
        case "succeeded":
          throw new ClosureRefundPermanentError(
            `Deposit ${deposit.id} was captured while still pending; reconcile it by hand`
          );
        default:
          throw new Error(`Payment ${pi} is ${intent.status}; try again`);
      }
    }
    async function settleOnce(deps: ClosureRefundDeps, row: ClosureRefundRow): Promise<Settled | null> {
      const deposit = await deps.deposits.getByReservationId(row.reservationId);
      if (!deposit) return "none";
      if (deposit.status === "refunded") return "done";
      if (deposit.status === "uncollectable") return "none";
      if (deposit.status === "held") {
        await deps.deposits.refund(deposit.id);
        return "done";
      }
      if (CAPTURED.has(deposit.status)) return refundCaptured(deps, deposit, row);
      if (deposit.status === "pending") return resolvePending(deps, deposit);
      return null;
    }
    async function settleDeposit(deps: ClosureRefundDeps, row: ClosureRefundRow): Promise<Settled> {
      for (let read = 0; read < MAX_REREADS; read += 1) {
        try {
          const settled = await settleOnce(deps, row);
          if (settled) return settled;
        } catch (error) {
          if (!isRace(error)) throw error;
        }
      }
      // Retriable on purpose: BullMQ's bounded attempts re-run the job, and the
      // final attempt records `failed`.
      throw new Error(`Deposit for ${row.reservationId} kept changing; try again`);
    }
    export async function settleClosureRefund(
      deps: ClosureRefundDeps,
      payload: ClosureRefundPayload
    ): Promise<void> {
      const row = await deps.store.load(payload.outcomeId);
      if (!row) throw new ClosureRefundPermanentError(`Closure outcome ${payload.outcomeId} not found`);
      if (row.refund === "done" || row.refund === "none") return;
      await deps.store.setRefund(row.id, await settleDeposit(deps, row));
    }
    export async function runClosureRefundJob(
      deps: ClosureRefundDeps,
      payload: ClosureRefundPayload,
      opts: { isFinalAttempt: boolean }
    ): Promise<void> {
      try {
        await settleClosureRefund(deps, payload);
      } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof ClosureRefundPermanentError || opts.isFinalAttempt) {
          await deps.store.markFailed(payload.outcomeId).catch(() => undefined);
        }
        throw error;
      }
    }
    export interface RefundLogger {
      error(context: Record<string, unknown>, message: string): void;
    }
    export class ClosureRefundEnqueueError extends Error {
      constructor(
        readonly enqueued: number,
        cause: unknown
      ) {
        super(`Scheduled ${enqueued} closure refund job(s) before the queue failed`, { cause });
        this.name = "ClosureRefundEnqueueError";
      }
    }
    export async function enqueueClosureRefunds(
      deps: {
        store: ClosureRefundStore;
        jobs: Pick<JobScheduler, "schedule">;
        log?: RefundLogger;
      },
      venueId: string,
      ruleId: string,
      statuses: readonly ClosureRefundStatus[],
      opts: { retry?: boolean; now?: () => number } = {}
    ): Promise<number> {
      const outcomes = await deps.store.listByRule(venueId, ruleId, statuses);
      let enqueued = 0;
      for (const outcome of outcomes) {
        const base = closureRefundJobId(ruleId, outcome.reservationId);
        const jobId = opts.retry ? `${base}_retry_${(opts.now ?? Date.now)()}` : base;
        try {
          if (opts.retry) await deps.store.resetToPending(outcome.id);
          await deps.jobs.schedule(
            JOB_TYPES.CLOSURE_REFUND,
            { outcomeId: outcome.id, venueId },
            0,
            jobId
          );
        } catch (error) {
          if (opts.retry && outcome.refund === "failed") {
            await deps.store.markFailed(outcome.id).catch((restoreError: unknown) => {
              // The row stays `pending` with no job; the next retry picks it up (it covers pending).
              deps.log?.error(
                { err: restoreError, venueId, ruleId, outcomeId: outcome.id },
                "closure refund retry: could not restore the failed outcome after a scheduling error"
              );
            });
          }
          throw new ClosureRefundEnqueueError(enqueued, error);
        }
        enqueued += 1;
      }
      return enqueued;
    }
    export interface ClosureRefunds {
      enqueue(venueId: string, ruleId: string): Promise<number>;
      retry(venueId: string, ruleId: string): Promise<number>;
    }
    export function createClosureRefunds(deps: {
      store: ClosureRefundStore;
      jobs: Pick<JobScheduler, "schedule">;
      log?: RefundLogger;
    }): ClosureRefunds {
      return {
        enqueue: (venueId, ruleId) => enqueueClosureRefunds(deps, venueId, ruleId, ["pending"]),
        retry: (venueId, ruleId) =>
          enqueueClosureRefunds(deps, venueId, ruleId, ["failed", "pending"], { retry: true }),
      };
    }

  <file path="services/reservations/src/services/confirm-hold.ts">
    type ConfirmHoldErrorCode =
      "NOT_FOUND" | "EXPIRED" | "SESSION_MISMATCH" | "CONFLICT" | "PACING_EXCEEDED" | "NOT_BOOKABLE";
    export interface ConfirmHoldInput {
      holdId: string;
      sessionId?: string;
      guestDetails: ConfirmHoldRequest;
      userId?: string;
      /**
       * When provided, the hold must belong to this venue. Set by the slug-scoped
       * public route (#4487) so a hold id from one venue cannot be confirmed
       * through another venue's URL. A mismatch is reported as `NOT_FOUND`, never
       * as a distinct error — the caller must not learn the hold exists elsewhere.
       * Checked in the same lookup as the session id, before any write.
       */
      venueId?: string;
      /** Who confirmed; recorded on the `created` event. Defaults to {@link SYSTEM_ACTOR}. */
      actor?: ReservationEventActor;
      /**
       * Runs inside the confirm transaction, after the reservation insert. Throwing
       * rolls the whole confirm back (the hold survives for the caller to release).
       */
      inTransaction?: (tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, reservationId: string) => Promise<void>;
    }
    export type ConfirmHoldResult =
      | { success: true; reservation: Reservation }
      | {
          success: false;
          error: string;
          errorCode: ConfirmHoldErrorCode;
          /** Set with `NOT_BOOKABLE`: the availability gate's refusal (route answers 422). */
          rejection?: GateRejection;
        };
    export async function confirmHold(input: ConfirmHoldInput): Promise<ConfirmHoldResult> {
      const { holdId, sessionId, guestDetails, userId, venueId, actor = SYSTEM_ACTOR } = input;
    
      // Step 1: Look up hold
      const hold = await prisma.reservationHold.findUnique({
        where: { id: holdId },
      });
    
      if (!hold) {
        return { success: false, error: "Hold not found", errorCode: "NOT_FOUND" };
      }
    
      // Step 1.5: Venue scoping (only when venueId is provided — slug-scoped public path)
      if (venueId !== undefined && hold.venueId !== venueId) {
        return { success: false, error: "Hold not found", errorCode: "NOT_FOUND" };
      }
    
      // Step 2: Session validation (only when sessionId is provided — internal path)
      if (sessionId !== undefined && hold.sessionId !== sessionId) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: "Session ID does not match the hold",
          errorCode: "SESSION_MISMATCH",
        };
      }
    
      // Step 2.5: Pacing pre-check — runs outside the transaction so pacing is
      // enforced on every confirm path, not just hold create. Fetch venue settings
      // and conflict slices once; pass to assertBookable (pure rule, no DB access).
      if (hold.venueId) {
        // ADR-026 §3.3 (sweep-discovered gap, #5369 PR 5): `venues` is RLS-scoped,
        // and `hold.venueId` is already a known, trusted scalar (the hold's own
        // column, not caller-supplied) — no ambiguity to resolve, so this reads
        // it inside that venue's own context rather than through `resolveVenueId`.
        const venue = await runWithVenueContext(hold.venueId, () =>
          prisma.venue.findUnique({ where: { id: hold.venueId } })
        );
        const settings = (venue?.settings ?? null) as VenueSettings | null;
        const dateStr = hold.date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        const { reservations, holds: holdSlices } = await availabilityService.fetchConflictData(
          hold.venueId,
          dateStr
        );
    
        const bookingError = assertBookable({
          tableId: hold.tableId,
          window: { startTime: hold.startTime, endTime: hold.endTime },
          partySize: hold.partySize,
          settings,
          reservations,
          holds: holdSlices,
          excludeHoldId: holdId,
        });
    
        if (bookingError?.code === "PACING_EXCEEDED") {
          return { success: false, error: bookingError.message, errorCode: "PACING_EXCEEDED" };
        }
        // CONFLICT from assertBookable is a pre-check only; bookSlot re-checks under
        // the advisory lock, which is the authoritative gate.
      }
    
      // Step 3: Atomic slot write under the advisory lock + transaction.
      const result = await bookSlot({
        tableId: hold.tableId,
        venueId: hold.venueId,
        date: hold.date,
        window: { startTime: hold.startTime, endTime: hold.endTime },
        partySize: hold.partySize,
        excludeHoldId: holdId,
        checkHoldConflict: true,
        checkPacing: hold.venueId != null,
        // Re-judge the slot against the committed availability, so a closure saved
        // after the hold was created wins over the hold.
        gate: { channel: "online" },
        // Re-check expiry under the lock so an expired hold never produces a
        // reservation, even if it expired between the lookup and acquiring the lock.
        guard: async () =>
          hold.expiresAt < new Date() ? { code: "EXPIRED", message: "Hold has expired" } : undefined,
        // Every unbookable outcome (expired, conflict, pacing) consumes the hold.
        onUnbookable: async (tx) => {
          await tx.reservationHold.delete({ where: { id: holdId } });
        },
        write: async (tx) => {
          const reservation = await tx.reservation.create({
            data: {
              date: hold.date,
              startTime: hold.startTime,
              endTime: hold.endTime,
              partySize: hold.partySize,
              tableId: hold.tableId,
              venueId: hold.venueId,
              guestName: guestDetails.guestName ?? null,
              guestEmail: guestDetails.guestEmail ?? null,
              guestPhone: guestDetails.guestPhone ?? null,
              guestId: guestDetails.guestId ?? null,
              notes: guestDetails.notes ?? null,
              occasion: guestDetails.occasion ?? null,
              seatingPreference: guestDetails.seatingPreference ?? null,
              userId: userId ?? null,
              // Ownership proof for the public deposit route (#6304).
              originSessionId: hold.sessionId,
              status: "CONFIRMED",
            },
            include: {
              table: true,
              guest: { select: { visitCount: true, communicationPreference: true } },
            },
          });
    
          await recordReservationEvent(tx, {
            reservationId: reservation.id,
            venueId: reservation.venueId,
            kind: "created",
            actor,
            from: null,
            to: toEventState(reservation),
          });
    
          // Delete the hold in the same transaction as the reservation insert.
          await tx.reservationHold.delete({ where: { id: holdId } });
    
          await input.inTransaction?.(tx, reservation.id);
    
          return reservation;
        },
      });
    
      if (!result.ok) {
        const { conflict } = result;
        if (conflict.code === "NOT_BOOKABLE") {
          const { message: error, rejection } = conflict;
          return { success: false, error, errorCode: "NOT_BOOKABLE", rejection };
        }
        if (conflict.code === "EXPIRED") {
          return { success: false, error: "Hold has expired", errorCode: "EXPIRED" };
        }
        if (conflict.code === "PACING_EXCEEDED") {
          return {
            success: false,
            error: "Pacing limit reached for this time slot",
            errorCode: "PACING_EXCEEDED",
          };
        }
        return { success: false, error: "Time slot is no longer available", errorCode: "CONFLICT" };
      }
    
      // Step 4: Map to domain type
      return { success: true, reservation: toReservation(result.value) };
    }

  <file path="services/reservations/src/services/contact-policy.ts">
    export type MessageClass = "transactional" | "marketing";
    export interface ContactState {
      /**
       * True when the guest has opted out of marketing/lifecycle email. Unset
       * (undefined) is treated as still-subscribed.
       */
      unsubscribed: boolean;
      /**
       * The guest's stored channel preference; null/undefined (or omitted) when
       * never set. Only consulted for marketing consent (transactional_only opts
       * out); callers that only carry the unsubscribe flag may omit it.
       */
      communicationPreference?: CommunicationPreference | null;
    }
    export function resolveChannel(
      preference: CommunicationPreference | null | undefined
    ): CommunicationPreference {
      return preference ?? "email_only";
    }
    export function canContact(state: ContactState, messageClass: MessageClass): boolean {
      if (messageClass === "transactional") {
        return true;
      }
      if (state.unsubscribed) {
        return false;
      }
      return resolveChannel(state.communicationPreference) !== "transactional_only";
    }
    export type NoticeChannel = "email" | "sms";
    export interface NoticeContacts {
      hasEmail: boolean;
      hasSms: boolean;
    }
    function preferredChannels(preference: CommunicationPreference): NoticeChannel[] {
      switch (preference) {
        case "sms_only":
          return ["sms"];
        case "both":
          return ["email", "sms"];
        default:
          return ["email"];
      }
    }
    export function closureNoticeChannels(
      preference: CommunicationPreference | null | undefined,
      contacts: NoticeContacts,
      urgent: boolean
    ): NoticeChannel[] {
      const has: Record<NoticeChannel, boolean> = { email: contacts.hasEmail, sms: contacts.hasSms };
      const preferred: NoticeChannel[] = urgent
        ? ["email", "sms"]
        : preferredChannels(resolveChannel(preference));
      const usable = preferred.filter((c) => has[c]);
      if (usable.length > 0) return usable;
      return (["email", "sms"] as const).filter((c) => has[c]);
    }

    export const depositMachine = createStateMachine<DepositStatus>(DEPOSIT_TRANSITIONS, "deposit");
    export function transitionDeposit(from: DepositStatus, to: DepositStatus): DepositStatus {
      depositMachine.transition(from, to);
      return to;
    }

  <file path="services/reservations/src/services/deposit.ts">
    export type StripePort = Omit<PaymentsPort, "createPaymentIntent">;
    export type DepositForfeitOrigin = "no_show" | "cancellation" | "staff";
    export interface DepositServiceLogger {
      error(details: object, msg: string): void;
    }
    function isOldEnoughToRollBack(capturedAt: Date): boolean {
      return Date.now() - capturedAt.getTime() >= ROLLBACK_SAFETY_WINDOW_MS;
    }
    export function setDepositServiceLogger(next: DepositServiceLogger): void {

    export class DepositNotFoundError extends Error {
      constructor(id: string) {
        super(`Deposit not found: ${id}`);
        this.name = "DepositNotFoundError";
      }
    }
    export class DepositConcurrentUpdateError extends Error {
      constructor(id: string, action: string) {
        super(
          `Deposit ${id} concurrent update conflict: lost race on ${action}. Another transition completed first.`
        );
        this.name = "DepositConcurrentUpdateError";
      }
    }
    export class DepositRefundLegIncompleteError extends Error {
      readonly depositId: string;
      override readonly cause: unknown;
    
      constructor(depositId: string, cause: unknown) {
        super(`Deposit ${depositId} refund leg failed after its capture leg already succeeded`);
        this.name = "DepositRefundLegIncompleteError";
        this.depositId = depositId;
        this.cause = cause;
      }
    }
    export class DepositCaptureAmbiguousError extends Error {

    export class DepositWrittenOffUncollectableError extends Error {
