        );
      }
    
      /**
       * Create a new reservation
       */
      async create(data: CreateReservationRequest): Promise<Reservation> {
        return this.client.postOne<Reservation>(RESERVATION_BASE_PATH, data, ReservationSchema);
      }
    
      /**
       * Update a reservation
       */
      async update(id: string, data: UpdateReservationRequest): Promise<Reservation> {
        return this.client.patchOne<Reservation>(
          `${RESERVATION_BASE_PATH}/${id}`,
          data,
          ReservationSchema
        );
      }
    
      /**
       * Mark a reservation as a no-show. A thin wrapper over the same PATCH
       * `update()` uses, but reads through `patch()` (not `patchOne()`'s
       * `{ data: T }`-only envelope) to also surface the optional top-level
       * `warning` the server sets when something non-fatal needs staff attention
       * (e.g. the deposit was still pending, or was written off as
       * uncollectable) — `patchOne()`'s envelope schema silently strips any key
       * besides `data` (#5719 M2).
       */
      async markNoShow(id: string): Promise<{ reservation: Reservation; warning?: string }> {
        const envelopeSchema = z.object({ data: ReservationSchema, warning: z.string().optional() });
        const response = await this.client.patch(
          `${RESERVATION_BASE_PATH}/${id}`,
          { status: "NO_SHOW" },
          envelopeSchema
        );
        return { reservation: response.data, ...(response.warning && { warning: response.warning }) };
      }
    
      /**
       * Cancel a reservation
       */
      async cancel(id: string): Promise<Reservation> {
        return this.client.deleteOne<Reservation>(`${RESERVATION_BASE_PATH}/${id}`, ReservationSchema);
      }
    
      /**
       * Cancel a reservation with an optional reason and note
       */
      async cancelWithReason(
        id: string,
        reason?: { cancellationReason?: string; cancellationNote?: string }
      ): Promise<Reservation> {
        return this.client.patchOne<Reservation>(
          `${RESERVATION_BASE_PATH}/${id}`,
          {
            status: "CANCELLED",
            ...reason,
          },
          ReservationSchema
        );
      }
    
      /**
       * Create a walk-in reservation
       */
      async walkIn(data: WalkInRequest): Promise<Reservation> {
        return this.client.postOne<Reservation>(
          `${RESERVATION_BASE_PATH}/walk-in`,
          data,
          ReservationSchema
        );
      }
    
      /**
       * Look up a reservation via a guest-facing manage token (public, unauthenticated).
       * Encodes the token internally and unwraps the `{ data }` envelope.
       */
      async manageReservation(token: string): Promise<ManageReservationData> {
        return this.client.getOne<ManageReservationData>(
          `/public/v1/reservations/manage?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}`,
          undefined,
          manageReservationDataSchema
        );
      }
    
      /**
       * Cancel a reservation via a guest-facing manage token (public, unauthenticated).
       * The token is sent as an `Authorization: Bearer` header rather than a query
       * param — the manage-token middleware prefers it for mutating requests.
       */
      async cancelManaged(
        token: string,
        reason?: { cancellationReason?: string; cancellationNote?: string }
      ): Promise<{ status: ReservationStatus }> {
        const schema = z.object({ status: ReservationStatusSchema });
        const response = await this.client.request<{ data: { status: ReservationStatus } }>(
          "/public/v1/reservations/manage",
          {
            method: "DELETE",
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
            body: reason ? JSON.stringify(reason) : undefined,
          },
          z.object({ data: schema })
        );
        return response.data;
      }
    
      /**
       * Rebook a venue-cancelled reservation into one of its offers (public,
       * token-authenticated). `offerId` is the offer's `id`. Refusals surface as
       * `ApiClientError`: 409 (already rebooked / slot gone) and 422 (the venue
       * takes a deposit, or the booking gate refuses the time).
       */
      async rebookManaged(token: string, offerId: string): Promise<RebookedReservation> {
        const schema = z.object({
          data: z.object({ reservationId: z.string(), startTime: z.string() }),
          manageToken: z.string(),
        });
        const response = await this.client.request<{
          data: { reservationId: string; startTime: string };
          manageToken: string;
        }>(
          "/public/v1/reservations/manage/rebook",
          {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
            body: JSON.stringify({ offerId }),
          },
          schema
        );
        return { ...response.data, manageToken: response.manageToken };
      }
    
      /**
       * Modify a reservation via a guest-facing manage token (public, unauthenticated).
       * When a hold is passed, its id goes in the body and its session in
       * `x-session-id` so the server can prove the guest owns the new slot.
       */
      async modifyManaged(
        token: string,
        changes: ManagedReservationChanges,
        hold?: { holdId: string; sessionId: string }
      ): Promise<ManagedReservation> {
        const headers: Record<string, string> = { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` };
        if (hold) headers["x-session-id"] = hold.sessionId;
        const response = await this.client.request<{ data: { reservation: ManagedReservation } }>(
          "/public/v1/reservations/manage",
          {
            method: "PATCH",
            headers,
            body: JSON.stringify(hold ? { ...changes, holdId: hold.holdId } : changes),
          },
          z.object({ data: z.object({ reservation: managedReservationSchema }) })
        );
        return response.data.reservation;
      }
    }

  <file path="packages/api-client/src/retry.ts">
    export interface RetryOptions {
      /** Maximum number of additional attempts after the first failure. */
      maxRetries: number;
      /** Base delay in ms for attempt 0; doubles each subsequent attempt. */
      baseDelayMs: number;
      /**
       * Whether to apply ±20% jitter to prevent thundering herd.
       * Defaults to true.
       */
      jitter?: boolean;
      /**
       * Predicate to decide whether an error is retryable.
       * Defaults to always-retry (all errors are retried).
       */
      isRetryable?: (error: unknown) => boolean;
    }
    function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
      return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
    }
    function backoffMs(attempt: number, baseDelayMs: number, jitter: boolean): number {
      const base = baseDelayMs * Math.pow(2, attempt);
      if (!jitter) return base;
      const jitterAmount = base * JITTER_FACTOR * (2 * Math.random() - 1);
      return base + jitterAmount;
    }
    export async function retry<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, options: RetryOptions): Promise<T> {
      const { maxRetries, baseDelayMs, jitter = true, isRetryable = () => true } = options;
    
      let lastError: unknown;
    
      for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
        try {
          return await fn();
        } catch (error) {
          lastError = error;
    
          if (attempt < maxRetries && isRetryable(error)) {
            await sleep(backoffMs(attempt, baseDelayMs, jitter));
            continue;
          }
    
          throw error;
        }
      }
    
      // Unreachable — loop always throws or returns, but TypeScript needs this.
      throw lastError;
    }

    export interface StreamConfig {
      /** URL to POST to */
      url: string;
      /** Request body (will be JSON-stringified) */
      body: unknown;
      /** Extra headers merged with Content-Type and Authorization */
      headers?: Record<string, string>;
      /** AbortSignal for cancellation */
      signal?: AbortSignal;
    }
    export class StreamRequestError extends Error {
      readonly status: number;
      readonly problemType?: string;
      readonly retryAfterSeconds?: number;
    
      constructor(
        message: string,
        fields: { status: number; problemType?: string; retryAfterSeconds?: number }
      ) {
        super(message);
        this.name = "StreamRequestError";
        this.status = fields.status;
        this.problemType = fields.problemType;
        this.retryAfterSeconds = fields.retryAfterSeconds;
      }
    }
    export async function* streamNDJSON<T>(config: StreamConfig): AsyncGenerator<T> {
      const response = await fetch(config.url, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
          ...config.headers,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(config.body),
        signal: config.signal,
      });
    
      if (!response.ok) {
        let detail = response.statusText || `HTTP ${response.status}`;
        let problemType: string | undefined;
        try {
          const body = (await response.json()) as Record<string, unknown>;
          detail = (body.detail as string) ?? (body.message as string) ?? detail;
          if (typeof body.type === "string") problemType = body.type;
        } catch {
          // Response body is not JSON — use status text
        }
        const retryAfter = Number(response.headers.get("Retry-After"));
        throw new StreamRequestError(`Request failed: ${detail}`, {
          status: response.status,
          problemType,
          retryAfterSeconds: Number.isFinite(retryAfter) && retryAfter > 0 ? retryAfter : undefined,
        });
      }
    
      if (!response.body) {
        throw new Error("Response body is not readable");
      }
    
      const reader = response.body.getReader();
      const decoder = new TextDecoder();
      let buffer = "";
    
      try {
        while (true) {
          const { done, value } = await reader.read();
    
          if (done) {
            break;
          }
    
          buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
    
          // Process complete lines from the buffer
          const lines = buffer.split("\n");
          // Keep the last (possibly incomplete) chunk in the buffer
          buffer = lines.pop() ?? "";
    
          for (const line of lines) {
            const trimmed = line.trim();
            if (!trimmed) continue;
    
            try {
              const parsed = JSON.parse(trimmed) as T;
              yield parsed;
            } catch {
              // Skip malformed JSON lines
            }
          }
        }
    
        // Process any remaining buffered content
        if (buffer.trim()) {
          try {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(buffer.trim()) as T;
            yield parsed;
          } catch {
            // Skip malformed JSON lines
          }
        }
      } finally {
        reader.releaseLock();
      }
    }

  <file path="packages/availability/src/apply-draft.ts">
    type ConfigTable = keyof AvailabilityConfig;
    type Row<T extends ConfigTable> = AvailabilityConfig[T][number];
    export const ARCHIVED_ON_REMOVE: ReadonlySet<ConfigTable> = new Set<ConfigTable>([
      "schedules",
      "venueServices",
    ]);
    function applyTable<T extends ConfigTable>(
      table: T,
      rows: AvailabilityConfig[T],
      changes: AvailabilityConfigChanges,
      nowIso: string
    ): AvailabilityConfig[T] {
      const upserts = (changes.upsert[table] ?? []) as Row<T>[];
      const removed = new Set(changes.remove[table] ?? []);
      const byId = new Map(upserts.map((r) => [r.id, r]));
      const kept = (rows as Row<T>[]).flatMap((row): Row<T>[] => {
        const replaced = byId.get(row.id) ?? row;
        if (!removed.has(row.id)) return [replaced];
        return ARCHIVED_ON_REMOVE.has(table) ? [{ ...replaced, archivedAt: nowIso }] : [];
      });
      const known = new Set((rows as Row<T>[]).map((r) => r.id));
      const added = upserts.filter((r) => !known.has(r.id) && !removed.has(r.id));
      return [...kept, ...added] as AvailabilityConfig[T];
    }
    export function applyChanges(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      changes: AvailabilityConfigChanges,
      nowIso: string
    ): AvailabilityConfig {
      return {
        schedules: applyTable("schedules", config.schedules, changes, nowIso),
        venueServices: applyTable("venueServices", config.venueServices, changes, nowIso),
        scheduleServices: applyTable("scheduleServices", config.scheduleServices, changes, nowIso),
        assignments: applyTable("assignments", config.assignments, changes, nowIso),
        dateRules: applyTable("dateRules", config.dateRules, changes, nowIso),
      };
    }
    export function applyDraft<S extends AvailabilitySnapshot>(
      snapshot: S,
      changes: AvailabilityConfigChanges,
      nowIso: string
    ): S {
      return { ...snapshot, config: applyChanges(snapshot.config, changes, nowIso) };
    }

    function toUtcMs(date: ServiceDate): number {
      const y = Number(date.slice(0, 4));
      const m = Number(date.slice(5, 7));
      const d = Number(date.slice(8, 10));
      return Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d);
    }
    function fromUtcMs(ms: number): ServiceDate {
      return new Date(ms).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    }
    export function addDays(date: ServiceDate, n: number): ServiceDate {
      return fromUtcMs(toUtcMs(date) + n * MS_PER_DAY);
    }
    export function weekdayOf(date: ServiceDate): Weekday {
      const sundayFirst = new Date(toUtcMs(date)).getUTCDay();
      // getUTCDay is 0..6, so the index is always in range.
      return WEEKDAYS[(sundayFirst + 6) % 7] as Weekday;
    }
    export function weekdayIndexOf(date: ServiceDate): number {
      return new Date(toUtcMs(date)).getUTCDay();
    }

  <file path="packages/availability/src/date-rules.ts">
    export type RuleOf<K extends DateRule["kind"]> = Extract<DateRule, { kind: K }>;
    export const WHOLE_DAY = { from: 0, to: 2 * MINUTES_PER_DAY } as const;
    function covers(rule: DateRule, serviceDate: ServiceDate): boolean {
      // A Tonight rule lives exactly one service day, whatever its stored range
      // says, so its expiry needs no clock and no cleanup job.
      if (rule.kind === "tonight") return rule.startsOn === serviceDate;
      // So does a skip or a one-date edit of a series: it never outgrows its date.
      if (rule.seriesId != null) return rule.startsOn === serviceDate;
      return (
        rule.startsOn <= serviceDate &&
        (rule.endsOn == null || serviceDate <= rule.endsOn) &&
        (rule.repeat == null || rule.repeat.weekdays.includes(weekdayIndexOf(serviceDate)))
      );
    }
    export function activeRules(rules: readonly DateRule[], serviceDate: ServiceDate): DateRule[] {
      const onDate = rules.filter((r) => covers(r, serviceDate));
      const replaced = new Set(onDate.flatMap((r) => (r.seriesId == null ? [] : [r.seriesId])));
      return onDate.filter((r) => !replaced.has(r.id));
    }
    export function ofKind<K extends DateRule["kind"]>(
      rules: readonly DateRule[],
      kind: K
    ): RuleOf<K>[] {
      return rules.filter((r): r is RuleOf<K> => r.kind === kind);
    }
    function timeRange(from: number, to: number): string {
      return `${formatMinute(from)} – ${formatMinute(to)}`;
    }
    export function targetLabel(rule: DateRule, serviceName: string | undefined): string {
      switch (rule.targetKind) {
        case "venue":
          return "Closed";
        case "service":
          return `${serviceName ?? "Service"} closed`;
        case "booking": {
          const types = (rule.bookingTypes ?? []).join(" and ");
          return `${types.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${types.slice(1)} booking closed`;
        }
        case "tables":
          return "Tables blocked";
      }
    }
    export function seriesLabel(rule: DateRule, serviceName: string | undefined): string {
      const days = rule.repeat?.weekdays.map((d) => WEEKDAY_NAMES[d]).join(", ");
      const range = `${rule.startsOn} – ${rule.endsOn ?? "until reopened"}`;
      return [targetLabel(rule, serviceName), days, range].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
    }
    export function windowEffect(rule: DateRule): string {
      return rule.window ? timeRange(rule.window.from, rule.window.to) : "All day";
    }
    export function tonightEffect(rule: RuleOf<"tonight">): string {
      const { payload } = rule;
      if ("closeAt" in payload) return `Closes at ${formatMinute(payload.closeAt)}`;
      if ("stop" in payload) return `Stopped ${timeRange(payload.stop.from, payload.stop.to)}`;
      return `Pacing ${payload.pacing.covers} covers`;
    }
    export function hoursEffect(
      services: readonly { name: string; opensAt: number; closesAt: number }[]
    ): string {
      return services.length === 0
        ? "Closed"
        : services.map((s) => `${s.name} ${timeRange(s.opensAt, s.closesAt)}`).join(", ");
    }

    export interface DayDiff {
      serviceDate: ServiceDate;
      /** Seating minutes (past the service day's midnight) guests gain, ascending. */
      added: number[];
      /** Seating minutes guests lose, ascending. */
      removed: number[];
    }
    export interface DiffDaysOptions {
      partySize: number;
      channel: BookingChannel;
      now: Date;
    }
    export function diffDays(
      before: BookingSnapshot,
      after: BookingSnapshot,
      dates: readonly ServiceDate[],
      options: DiffDaysOptions
    ): DayDiff[] {
      return dates.map((serviceDate) => {
        const was = minutesOn(before, serviceDate, options);
        const now = minutesOn(after, serviceDate, options);
        return { serviceDate, added: onlyIn(now, was), removed: onlyIn(was, now) };
      });
    }

    export function formatMinute(minute: number): string {
      const m = minute % MINUTES_PER_DAY;
      const hour24 = Math.floor(m / 60);
      const hour12 = hour24 % 12 === 0 ? 12 : hour24 % 12;
      return `${hour12}:${String(m % 60).padStart(2, "0")} ${hour24 < 12 ? "AM" : "PM"}`;
    }

  <file path="packages/availability/src/instant.ts">
    function formatterFor(tz: string): Intl.DateTimeFormat {
      const cached = formatters.get(tz);
      if (cached) return cached;
      const created = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
        timeZone: tz,
        hourCycle: "h23",
        year: "numeric",
        month: "2-digit",
        day: "2-digit",
        hour: "2-digit",
        minute: "2-digit",
      });
      formatters.set(tz, created);
      return created;
    }
    interface WallFields {
      year: number;
      month: number;
      day: number;
      hour: number;
      minute: number;
    }
    function wallFieldsOf(instantMs: number, tz: string): WallFields {
      const parts = formatterFor(tz).formatToParts(new Date(instantMs));
      const read = (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPartTypes) =>
        Number(parts.find((p) => p.type === type)?.value);
      return {
        year: read("year"),
        month: read("month"),
        day: read("day"),
        hour: read("hour"),
        minute: read("minute"),
      };
    }
    function offsetAt(instantMs: number, tz: string): number {
      const w = wallFieldsOf(instantMs, tz);
      const wallMs = Date.UTC(w.year, w.month - 1, w.day, w.hour, w.minute);
      const flooredInstant = Math.floor(instantMs / MS_PER_MINUTE) * MS_PER_MINUTE;
      return wallMs - flooredInstant;
    }
    export function serviceDayInstant(
      serviceDate: ServiceDate,
      minute: number,
      tz: string
    ): Date | null {
      const civil = addDays(serviceDate, Math.floor(minute / MINUTES_PER_DAY));
      const wallMs =
        Date.UTC(Number(civil.slice(0, 4)), Number(civil.slice(5, 7)) - 1, Number(civil.slice(8, 10))) +
        (minute % MINUTES_PER_DAY) * MS_PER_MINUTE;
      // Candidate offsets from either side of the wall time; a candidate is real
      // only if the zone actually uses that offset at the resulting instant.
      const offsets = new Set([offsetAt(wallMs - PROBE_MS, tz), offsetAt(wallMs + PROBE_MS, tz)]);
      const valid = [...offsets]
        .map((offset) => wallMs - offset)
        .filter((instantMs) => offsetAt(instantMs, tz) === wallMs - instantMs);
      return valid.length === 0 ? null : new Date(Math.min(...valid));
    }
    export function localDateTimeOf(instant: Date, tz: string): { date: ServiceDate; minute: number } {
      const w = wallFieldsOf(instant.getTime(), tz);
      const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
      return {
        date: `${String(w.year).padStart(4, "0")}-${pad(w.month)}-${pad(w.day)}`,
        minute: w.hour * 60 + w.minute,
      };
    }

    export type LegacyShape = "weekday" | "seed_array" | "v2";
    export interface LegacyWindow {
      name?: string;
      open: number;
      close: number;
      /** The stored close was at or before the open, so it was read as past midnight. */
      wrapped?: true;
    }
    export interface LegacyOverride {
      date: ServiceDate;
      windows: readonly LegacyWindow[];
      note?: string;
    }
    export interface LegacyHours {
      weekly: Readonly<Record<Weekday, readonly LegacyWindow[]>>;
      overrides: readonly LegacyOverride[];
    }
    export type LegacyHoursFailure =
      | { ok: false; reason: "no_hours" }
      | { ok: false; reason: "unknown_shape"; detail: string }
      | { ok: false; reason: "unknown_version"; detail: string }
      /** A day the legacy code treated as open has a time this parser cannot read. */
      | { ok: false; reason: "unreadable_time"; detail: string }
      /** A v2 override has a date that is not a plain YYYY-MM-DD; dropping it could open a closed date. */
      | { ok: false; reason: "unreadable_date"; detail: string };
    export interface LegacyHoursOptions {
      lenient?: boolean;
    }
    export type LegacyHoursResult =
      | {
          ok: true;
          shape: LegacyShape;
          hours: LegacyHours;
          /** Lenient mode only: weekdays closed because their times could not be read. */
          unreadableDays?: string[];
          /** Lenient mode only: what was read the legacy listing's way instead of refused. */
          coercions?: string[];
        }
      | LegacyHoursFailure;
    type Loose = Record<string, unknown>;
    function parseTime(value: unknown, lenient: boolean): number | null {
      if (typeof value !== "string") return null;
      const match = (lenient ? LENIENT_TIME : TIME).exec(value);
      if (!match) return null;
      const minutes = Number(match[1]) * 60 + Number(match[2]);
      return minutes > MINUTES_PER_DAY ? null : minutes;
    }
    type Problems = string[];
    interface Reader {
      problems: Problems;
      lenient: boolean;
      /** Lenient mode: problems that closed a single weekday instead of failing the venue. */
      unreadableDays: string[];
    }
    function toWindow(
      where: string,
      problems: Problems,
      lenient: boolean,
      open: unknown,
      close: unknown,
      name?: unknown
    ): LegacyWindow | null {
      const o = parseTime(open, lenient);
      const c = parseTime(close, lenient);
      if (o === null || c === null || o >= MINUTES_PER_DAY) {
        problems.push(`${where}: open ${JSON.stringify(open)}, close ${JSON.stringify(close)}`);
        return null;
      }
      if (o === c) return null;
      const wrapped = c < o;
      const window = {
        open: o,
        close: wrapped ? c + MINUTES_PER_DAY : c,
        ...(wrapped ? { wrapped: true as const } : {}),
      };
      return typeof name === "string" && name.length > 0 ? { name, ...window } : window;
    }
    function finish(shape: LegacyShape, reader: Reader, hours: LegacyHours): LegacyHoursResult {
      const { problems, unreadableDays } = reader;
      if (problems.length === 0) {
        return unreadableDays.length > 0
          ? { ok: true, shape, hours, unreadableDays }
          : { ok: true, shape, hours };
      }
      const reason = problems.some((p) => p.startsWith(DATE_PROBLEM))
        ? "unreadable_date"
        : "unreadable_time";
      return { ok: false, reason, detail: problems.join("; ") };
    }
    function weeklyFrom(
      reader: Reader,
      windowsFor: (day: Weekday, problems: Problems) => LegacyWindow[]
    ): Record<Weekday, readonly LegacyWindow[]> {
      const read = (day: Weekday): LegacyWindow[] => {
        const dayProblems: Problems = [];
        const windows = windowsFor(day, dayProblems);
        if (dayProblems.length === 0) return sortedByOpen(windows);
        (reader.lenient ? reader.unreadableDays : reader.problems).push(...dayProblems);
        return [];
      };
      return Object.fromEntries(WEEKDAYS.map((d) => [d, read(d)])) as unknown as Record<
        Weekday,
        readonly LegacyWindow[]
      >;
    }
    function fromWeekdayKeyed(raw: Loose, reader: Reader): LegacyHoursResult {
      if (!WEEKDAYS.some((day) => day in raw)) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "unknown_shape", detail: "no weekday keys" };
      }
      // As the legacy code: a missing day, or one flagged `closed` (truthy), is closed.
      const dayWindows = (day: Weekday, problems: Problems): LegacyWindow[] => {
        const value = raw[day];
        if (!isObject(value) || value.closed) return [];
        const window = toWindow(day, problems, reader.lenient, value.open, value.close);
        return window ? [window] : [];
      };
      const weekly = weeklyFrom(reader, dayWindows);
      return finish("weekday", reader, { weekly, overrides: [] });
    }
    function fromSeedArray(raw: unknown[], reader: Reader): LegacyHoursResult {
      const rows = raw.filter(isObject);
      const dayIndexOk = (row: Loose) =>
        typeof row.dayOfWeek === "number" &&
        Number.isInteger(row.dayOfWeek) &&
        row.dayOfWeek >= 0 &&
        row.dayOfWeek <= 6;
      if (rows.length === 0 || rows.length !== raw.length || !rows.every(dayIndexOk)) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "unknown_shape", detail: "array rows lack a 0-6 dayOfWeek" };
      }
      const windowsFor = (day: Weekday, problems: Problems) =>
        rows
          .filter((row) => !row.isClosed && SUNDAY_FIRST[row.dayOfWeek as number] === day)
          .map((row) => toWindow(day, problems, reader.lenient, row.openTime, row.closeTime))
          .filter(isWindow);
      const weekly = weeklyFrom(reader, windowsFor);
      return finish("seed_array", reader, { weekly, overrides: [] });
    }
    function toWindows(
      where: string,
      problems: Problems,
      lenient: boolean,
      raw: unknown
    ): LegacyWindow[] {
      if (raw === undefined) return [];
      if (!Array.isArray(raw)) {
        problems.push(`${where}: windows is not an array`);
        return [];
      }
      return raw.flatMap((w, i) => {
        if (!isObject(w)) {
          problems.push(`${where}: window ${i} is not an object`);
          return [];
        }
        const window = toWindow(where, problems, lenient, w.open, w.close, w.name);
        return window ? [window] : [];
      });
    }
    function toOverrides(problems: Problems, lenient: boolean, raw: unknown): LegacyOverride[] {
      if (raw === undefined) return [];
      if (!Array.isArray(raw)) {
        problems.push(`${DATE_PROBLEM}overrides is not an array`);
        return [];
      }
      const byDate = new Map<string, LegacyOverride>();
      for (const entry of raw) {
        if (!isObject(entry) || typeof entry.date !== "string" || !ISO_DATE.test(entry.date)) {
          problems.push(
            `${DATE_PROBLEM}override date ${JSON.stringify(isObject(entry) ? entry.date : entry)}`
          );
          continue;
        }
        if (byDate.has(entry.date)) continue;
        const where = `override ${entry.date}`;
        if (!entry.closed && !Array.isArray(entry.windows)) {
          problems.push(`${where}: open override has no windows array`);
        }
        const windows = entry.closed
          ? []
          : sortedByOpen(toWindows(where, problems, lenient, entry.windows));
        byDate.set(entry.date, {
          date: entry.date,
          windows,
          ...(typeof entry.note === "string" ? { note: entry.note } : {}),
        });
      }
      return [...byDate.values()].sort((a, b) => (a.date < b.date ? -1 : 1));
    }
    function fromV2(raw: Loose, reader: Reader): LegacyHoursResult {
      if (!isObject(raw.weekly)) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "unknown_shape", detail: "v2 document has no weekly object" };
      }
      const weeklyRaw = raw.weekly;
      const weekly = weeklyFrom(reader, (day, problems) =>
        toWindows(day, problems, reader.lenient, weeklyRaw[day])
      );
      // An override is a dated exception: one that cannot be read fails the venue even
      // in lenient mode, because dropping it could open a date the venue closed.
      const overrides = toOverrides(reader.problems, reader.lenient, raw.overrides);
      return finish("v2", reader, { weekly, overrides });
    }
    export function normalizeLegacyHours(
      raw: unknown,
      options: LegacyHoursOptions = {}
    ): LegacyHoursResult {
      const reader: Reader = { problems: [], lenient: options.lenient ?? false, unreadableDays: [] };
      if (raw === null || raw === undefined) return { ok: false, reason: "no_hours" };
      if (Array.isArray(raw)) return fromSeedArray(raw, reader);
      if (!isObject(raw)) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "unknown_shape", detail: `unexpected ${typeof raw} value` };
      }
      if ("version" in raw && raw.version === 1 && reader.lenient && WEEKDAYS.some((d) => d in raw)) {
        const result = fromWeekdayKeyed(raw, reader);
        return result.ok ? { ...result, coercions: ["version 1 key ignored (weekday shape)"] } : result;
      }
      if ("version" in raw) {
        return raw.version === 2
          ? fromV2(raw, reader)
          : { ok: false, reason: "unknown_version", detail: `version ${JSON.stringify(raw.version)}` };
      }
      return fromWeekdayKeyed(raw, reader);
    }

  <file path="packages/availability/src/legacy-migration.ts">
    export const DEFAULT_LAST_SEATING_BUFFER = 90;
    export const MAX_PAST_MIDNIGHT_SPAN = 16 * 60;
    export interface LegacyMigrationInput {
      hours: LegacyHours;
      /** `settings.slotIntervalMinutes`; absent means the legacy default (15). */
      slotIntervalMinutes?: number | null;
      /** `settings.lastSeatingBuffer`; absent means the legacy default (90). */
      lastSeatingBuffer?: number | null;
      /** Venue-local today; dated overrides before it are not migrated. */
      today: ServiceDate;
      newId: () => string;
      /**
       * The live listing fallback only: a day whose window spans implausibly far past
       * midnight is closed (the legacy listing offered nothing for it) instead of
       * failing the venue, and out-of-range settings are coerced (see
       * `lenientIntervalOrBuffer`). The backfill stays strict.
       */
      lenient?: boolean;
    }
    export interface PastMidnightWindow {
      /** A weekday name, or an override's date. */
      day: string;
      open: number;
      /** Minutes past the day's midnight, above 1440. */
      close: number;
      span: number;
    }
    export interface LegacyMigrationNotes {
      pastMidnightWindows: PastMidnightWindow[];
      /** Windows the legacy slot loop could never seat (last seating before opening). */
      droppedWindows: number;
      skippedPastOverrides: number;
      migratedOverrides: number;
      /** Lenient mode only: days closed because their hours could not be used. */
      unreadableDays?: string[];
      /** Lenient mode only: settings read the way the legacy loop read them instead of refused. */
      coercions?: string[];
    }
    export type LegacyMigrationResult =
      | { ok: true; config: AvailabilityConfig; notes: LegacyMigrationNotes }
      | {
          ok: false;
          reason: "invalid_interval" | "invalid_buffer" | "invalid_config" | "implausible_span";
          detail: string;
        };
    interface SeatedWindow {
      name?: string;
      open: number;
      close: number;
      last: number;
    }
    interface NamedWindow extends SeatedWindow {
      serviceName: string;
    }
    function seat(windows: readonly LegacyWindow[], buffer: number): SeatedWindow[] {
      return windows.map((w) => ({ ...w, last: w.close - buffer })).filter((w) => w.last >= w.open);
    }
    function nameWindows(windows: readonly SeatedWindow[], multiple: boolean): NamedWindow[] {
      const fallback = (i: number) => (multiple ? `Service ${i + 1}` : "Open hours");
      const names = windows.map((w, i) => w.name ?? fallback(i));
      const clash = new Set(names).size < names.length;
      return windows.map((w, i) => ({ ...w, serviceName: clash ? `Service ${i + 1}` : names[i]! }));
    }
    function validIntervalOrBuffer(input: LegacyMigrationInput): SeatingRule | LegacyMigrationResult {
      const interval = input.slotIntervalMinutes ?? DEFAULT_SLOT_INTERVAL;
      if (!Number.isInteger(interval) || interval < 1 || interval > MAX_INTERVAL) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "invalid_interval", detail: `slotIntervalMinutes ${interval}` };
      }
      const buffer = input.lastSeatingBuffer ?? DEFAULT_LAST_SEATING_BUFFER;
      if (!Number.isInteger(buffer) || buffer < 0) {
        return { ok: false, reason: "invalid_buffer", detail: `lastSeatingBuffer ${buffer}` };
      }
      return { interval, buffer, coercions: [] };
    }
    interface SeatingRule {
      interval: number;
      /** Lenient mode: an interval above the engine's maximum, kept as fixed seating times. */
      fixedStep?: number;
      buffer: number;
      coercions: string[];
    }
    function lenientIntervalOrBuffer(input: LegacyMigrationInput): SeatingRule {
      const coercions: string[] = [];
      const rawInterval = input.slotIntervalMinutes ?? DEFAULT_SLOT_INTERVAL;
      const intervalOk = Number.isInteger(rawInterval) && rawInterval >= 1;
      const fixedStep = intervalOk && rawInterval > MAX_INTERVAL ? rawInterval : undefined;
      const interval = intervalOk && !fixedStep ? rawInterval : DEFAULT_SLOT_INTERVAL;
      if (fixedStep) {
        coercions.push(`slotIntervalMinutes ${rawInterval} read as fixed seatings`);
      } else if (!intervalOk) {
        coercions.push(`slotIntervalMinutes ${rawInterval} read as ${DEFAULT_SLOT_INTERVAL}`);
      }
      const rawBuffer = input.lastSeatingBuffer ?? DEFAULT_LAST_SEATING_BUFFER;
      const numericBuffer = Number.isFinite(rawBuffer) ? rawBuffer : DEFAULT_LAST_SEATING_BUFFER;
      const buffer = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(numericBuffer));
      if (buffer !== rawBuffer) coercions.push(`lastSeatingBuffer ${rawBuffer} read as ${buffer}`);
      return { interval, ...(fixedStep ? { fixedStep } : {}), buffer, coercions };
    }
    function fixedSeatings(open: number, last: number, step: number): number[] {
      return Array.from({ length: Math.floor((last - open) / step) + 1 }, (_, k) => open + k * step);
    }
    function pastMidnightWindows(hours: LegacyHours): PastMidnightWindow[] {
      const entries = [
        ...WEEKDAYS.map((day) => ({ day: day as string, windows: hours.weekly[day] })),
        ...hours.overrides.map((o) => ({ day: o.date, windows: o.windows })),
      ];
      return entries.flatMap(({ day, windows }) =>
        windows
          .filter((w) => w.wrapped)
          .map((w) => ({ day, open: w.open, close: w.close, span: w.close - w.open }))
      );
    }
    function closeImplausibleDays(hours: LegacyHours): { hours: LegacyHours; closed: string[] } {
      const closed = pastMidnightWindows(hours)
        .filter((w) => w.span > MAX_PAST_MIDNIGHT_SPAN)
        .map((w) => `${w.day}: ${w.open}-${w.close} spans ${w.span} minutes`);
      const keep = (windows: readonly LegacyWindow[]) => (windows.some(isImplausible) ? [] : windows);
      return {
        hours: {
          weekly: Object.fromEntries(
            WEEKDAYS.map((d) => [d, keep(hours.weekly[d])])
          ) as unknown as LegacyHours["weekly"],
          overrides: hours.overrides.map((o) => ({ ...o, windows: keep(o.windows) })),
        },
        closed,
      };
    }
    export function buildLegacyConfig(input: LegacyMigrationInput): LegacyMigrationResult {
      const checked: SeatingRule | LegacyMigrationResult = input.lenient
        ? lenientIntervalOrBuffer(input)
        : validIntervalOrBuffer(input);
      if ("ok" in checked) return checked;
      const { interval, buffer, fixedStep, coercions } = checked;
      const { newId, today } = input;
      const lenient = input.lenient ? closeImplausibleDays(input.hours) : null;
      const hours = lenient?.hours ?? input.hours;
    
      const wrapped = pastMidnightWindows(hours);
      const tooLong = wrapped.find((w) => w.span > MAX_PAST_MIDNIGHT_SPAN);
      if (tooLong) {
        return {
          ok: false,
          reason: "implausible_span",
          detail: `${tooLong.day} ${tooLong.open}-${tooLong.close} spans ${tooLong.span} minutes`,
        };
      }
    
      const seatedWeek = WEEKDAYS.map((day) => seat(hours.weekly[day], buffer));
      const dropped = WEEKDAYS.reduce(
        (n, day, i) => n + hours.weekly[day].length - seatedWeek[i]!.length,
        0
      );
      const multiple =
        seatedWeek.some((w) => w.length > 1) ||
        hours.overrides.some((o) => seat(o.windows, buffer).length > 1);
    
      const venueServices = new Map<string, { id: string; name: string; position: number }>();
      const serviceId = (name: string): string => {
        const existing = venueServices.get(name);
        if (existing) return existing.id;
        const created = { id: newId(), name, position: venueServices.size };
        venueServices.set(name, created);
        return created.id;
      };
    
      // Group weekdays that share hours; first-seen order keeps the output stable.
      const groups = new Map<string, { days: number[]; windows: NamedWindow[] }>();
      seatedWeek.forEach((windows, i) => {
        if (windows.length === 0) return;
        const named = nameWindows(windows, multiple);
        const key = signature(named);
        const group = groups.get(key) ?? { days: [], windows: named };
        groups.set(key, { ...group, days: [...group.days, storedIndex(i)] });
      });
      const ordered = [...groups.values()].sort((a, b) => b.days.length - a.days.length);
    
      const hoursFields = (w: NamedWindow) => ({
        venueServiceId: serviceId(w.serviceName),
        opensAt: w.open,
        lastSeatingAt: w.last,
        closesAt: w.close,
        seating: fixedStep
          ? { version: 1 as const, fixed: fixedSeatings(w.open, w.last, fixedStep) }
          : { version: 1 as const, interval },
        bookingTypes: [...CHANNELS],
      });
    
      const schedules = ordered.length === 0 ? [null] : ordered;
      const rows = schedules.map((group, index) => {
        const id = newId();
        const schedule = {
          id,
          name: index === 0 ? "Regular week" : `Alternate week ${index}`,
          kind: index === 0 ? ("regular" as const) : ("alternate" as const),
          isRegular: index === 0,
        };
        const services: ScheduleService[] = (group?.windows ?? []).map((w) => ({
          id: newId(),
          scheduleId: id,
          ...hoursFields(w),
        }));
        const assignments = group
          ? [{ id: newId(), scheduleId: id, weekdays: [...group.days].sort(), precedence: 0 }]
          : [];
        return { schedule, services, assignments };
      });
    
      const futureOverrides = hours.overrides.filter((o) => o.date >= today);
      const dateRules: DateRule[] = futureOverrides.map((override) => {
        const seated = nameWindows(seat(override.windows, buffer), multiple);
        const base = {
          id: newId(),
          targetKind: "venue" as const,
          startsOn: override.date,
          endsOn: override.date,
          ...(override.note ? { staffNote: override.note.slice(0, MAX_STAFF_NOTE) } : {}),
        };
        return seated.length === 0
          ? { ...base, kind: "closure" as const }
          : {
              ...base,
              kind: "special_hours" as const,
              payload: { version: 1 as const, services: seated.map(hoursFields) },
            };
      });
    
      const config: AvailabilityConfig = {
        schedules: rows.map((r) => r.schedule),
        venueServices: [...venueServices.values()],
        scheduleServices: rows.flatMap((r) => r.services),
        assignments: rows.flatMap((r) => r.assignments),
        dateRules,
      };
    
      const issues = validateConfig(config);
      if (issues.length > 0) {
        const first = issues
          .slice(0, 3)
          .map((i) => `${i.path} ${i.code}`)
          .join("; ");
        return { ok: false, reason: "invalid_config", detail: first };
      }
      return {
        ok: true,
        config,
        notes: {
          pastMidnightWindows: wrapped,
          droppedWindows: dropped,
          skippedPastOverrides: hours.overrides.length - futureOverrides.length,
          migratedOverrides: futureOverrides.length,
          ...(lenient && lenient.closed.length > 0 ? { unreadableDays: lenient.closed } : {}),
          ...(coercions.length > 0 ? { coercions } : {}),
        },
      };
    }

    export type LegacyDayHours = {
      open: string;
      close: string;
      closed?: boolean;
    };
    export type LegacyOperatingHours = Record<Weekday, LegacyDayHours>;
    function clock(minute: number): string {
      const m = minute % MINUTES_PER_DAY;
      const hh = String(Math.floor(m / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
      const mm = String(m % 60).padStart(2, "0");
      return `${hh}:${mm}`;
    }
    export function projectLegacyOperatingHours(config: AvailabilityConfig): LegacyOperatingHours {
      // Archived rows stay in the config (others reference them) but no longer run.
      const liveSchedules = new Set(config.schedules.filter((s) => !s.archivedAt).map((s) => s.id));
      const liveServices = new Set(config.venueServices.filter((s) => !s.archivedAt).map((s) => s.id));
      const regularWeek = config.assignments.filter(
        (a) => !a.startsOn && !a.endsOn && liveSchedules.has(a.scheduleId)
      );
      const dayHours = (day: Weekday): LegacyDayHours => {
        const stored = (WEEKDAYS.indexOf(day) + 1) % 7;
        const covering = regularWeek
          .filter((a) => a.weekdays.includes(stored))
          .reduce<(typeof regularWeek)[number] | null>(
            (best, a) => (best === null || a.precedence > best.precedence ? a : best),
            null
          );
        const services = covering
          ? config.scheduleServices.filter(
              (s) => s.scheduleId === covering.scheduleId && liveServices.has(s.venueServiceId)
            )
          : [];
        if (services.length === 0) return CLOSED_DAY;
        const open = Math.min(...services.map((s) => s.opensAt));
        const close = Math.max(...services.map((s) => s.closesAt));
        return { open: clock(open), close: clock(close) };
      };
      return Object.fromEntries(WEEKDAYS.map((day) => [day, dayHours(day)])) as LegacyOperatingHours;
    }

    export const MAX_REBOOK_OFFERS = 3;
    export const REBOOK_WINDOW_DAYS = 14;
    export function rebookOfferId(start: Date): string {
      return start.toISOString();
    }
    export interface RebookReservation {
      startTime: Date;
      partySize: number;
    }
    export type RebookResult = { kind: "offers"; slots: Slot[] } | { kind: "picker" };
    function timeOfDayDistance(a: number, b: number): number {
      const diff = Math.abs(a - b) % MINUTES_PER_DAY;
      return Math.min(diff, MINUTES_PER_DAY - diff);
    }
    interface Ranked {
      slot: Slot;
      distance: number;
      dayRank: number;
    }
    function compareRanked(a: Ranked, b: Ranked): number {
      return (
        a.dayRank - b.dayRank ||
        a.distance - b.distance ||
        a.slot.start.getTime() - b.slot.start.getTime()
      );
    }
    function rankDay(slots: Slot[], originalMinute: number, timezone: string): Ranked[] {
      return slots
        .map((slot) => ({
          slot,
          distance: timeOfDayDistance(localDateTimeOf(slot.start, timezone).minute, originalMinute),
          dayRank: 0,
        }))
        .sort(compareRanked)
        .map((ranked, dayRank) => ({ ...ranked, dayRank }));
    }
    export function rebookOffers(
      snapshot: BookingSnapshot,
      reservation: RebookReservation,
      now: Date
    ): RebookResult {
      const { timezone } = snapshot;
      const originalMinute = localDateTimeOf(reservation.startTime, timezone).minute;
      const today = localDateTimeOf(now, timezone).date;
      const isOffer = (s: Slot) =>
        s.available &&
        s.start.getTime() > now.getTime() &&
        s.start.getTime() !== reservation.startTime.getTime();
    
      const chosen = Array.from({ length: REBOOK_WINDOW_DAYS + 1 }, (_, i) => addDays(today, i - 1))
        .flatMap((date) => {
          const open = listSlots(snapshot, date, reservation.partySize, "online", now).filter(isOffer);
          return rankDay(open, originalMinute, timezone);
        })
        .sort(compareRanked)
        .slice(0, MAX_REBOOK_OFFERS)
        .map((r) => r.slot)
        .sort((a, b) => a.start.getTime() - b.start.getTime());
    
      return chosen.length === 0 ? { kind: "picker" } : { kind: "offers", slots: chosen };
    }

  <file path="packages/availability/src/resolve-day.ts">
    export interface AvailabilitySnapshot {
      /** IANA zone of the venue. */
      timezone: string;
      config: AvailabilityConfig;
    }
    export interface ResolvedService extends Pick<
      ScheduleService,
      "venueServiceId" | "opensAt" | "lastSeatingAt" | "closesAt" | "seating" | "bookingTypes"
    > {
      /** `null` for a service from special hours. */
      scheduleServiceId: string | null;
      name: string;
    }
    export interface ResolvedClosure {
      ruleId: string;
      targetKind: DateRule["targetKind"];
      venueServiceId?: string;
      tableIds?: string[];
      bookingTypes?: NonNullable<DateRule["bookingTypes"]>;
      from: number;
      to: number;
    }
    export type BookingOpen = Record<"online" | "phone" | "waitlist", boolean>;
    export type LayerKind = "schedule" | DateRule["kind"];
    export interface Layer {
      kind: LayerKind;
      /** The assignment or date rule row. */
      id: string;
      label: string;
      effect: string;
      /** The day as it would resolve with this row removed. */
      removalResult: ResolvedDaySummary;
    }
    export interface ResolvedDaySummary {
      serviceDate: ServiceDate;
      /** The schedule in force; `null` when no assignment covers the date. */
      scheduleId: string | null;
      /** In opening order. */
      services: ResolvedService[];
      closures: ResolvedClosure[];
      bookingOpen: BookingOpen;
      /** Tonight's lowered pacing, in covers per seating interval. */
      pacingCovers?: number;
      guestMessage?: string;
    }
    export interface ResolvedDay extends ResolvedDaySummary {
      /** Contributing layers, bottom-up. */
      explanation: Layer[];
    }
    type PendingLayer = Omit<Layer, "removalResult">;
    interface Resolution {
      day: ResolvedDaySummary;
      layers: PendingLayer[];
    }
    function coversDate(assignment: ScheduleAssignment, serviceDate: ServiceDate): boolean {
      // "YYYY-MM-DD" strings order chronologically; open ends are unbounded.
      return (
        assignment.weekdays.includes(weekdayIndexOf(serviceDate)) &&
        (assignment.startsOn == null || assignment.startsOn <= serviceDate) &&
        (assignment.endsOn == null || serviceDate <= assignment.endsOn)
      );
    }
    function assignmentFor(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      serviceDate: ServiceDate
    ): ScheduleAssignment | null {
      const live = new Set(config.schedules.filter((s) => !s.archivedAt).map((s) => s.id));
      return config.assignments
        .filter((a) => live.has(a.scheduleId) && coversDate(a, serviceDate))
        .reduce<ScheduleAssignment | null>(
          (best, a) => (best === null || a.precedence > best.precedence ? a : best),
          null
        );
    }
    function toResolved(
      service: ScheduleService | SpecialHoursService,
      venueService: VenueService
    ): ResolvedService {
      return {
        scheduleServiceId: "id" in service ? service.id : null,
        venueServiceId: service.venueServiceId,
        name: venueService.name,
        opensAt: service.opensAt,
        lastSeatingAt: service.lastSeatingAt,
        closesAt: service.closesAt,
        seating: service.seating,
        bookingTypes: service.bookingTypes,
      };
    }
    function liveServices(
      services: readonly (ScheduleService | SpecialHoursService)[],
      venueServices: ReadonlyMap<string, VenueService>
    ): ResolvedService[] {
      return services
        .flatMap((s) => {
          const venueService = venueServices.get(s.venueServiceId);
          return venueService ? [toResolved(s, venueService)] : [];
        })
        .sort((a, b) => a.opensAt - b.opensAt);
    }
    function closureOf(rule: DateRule, band: { from: number; to: number }): ResolvedClosure {
      return {
        ruleId: rule.id,
        targetKind: rule.targetKind,
        ...(rule.targetKind === "service" && rule.venueServiceId
          ? { venueServiceId: rule.venueServiceId }
          : {}),
        ...(rule.targetKind === "tables" && rule.tableIds ? { tableIds: rule.tableIds } : {}),
        ...(rule.targetKind === "booking" && rule.bookingTypes
          ? { bookingTypes: rule.bookingTypes }
          : {}),
        from: band.from,
        to: band.to,
      };
    }
    function closeBookingTypes(open: BookingOpen, rule: DateRule): BookingOpen {
      const closed = rule.bookingTypes ?? [];
      return {
        online: open.online && !closed.includes("online"),
        phone: open.phone && !closed.includes("phone"),
        waitlist: open.waitlist && !closed.includes("waitlist"),
      };
    }
    function applyClosure(day: ResolvedDaySummary, rule: RuleOf<"closure">): ResolvedDaySummary {
      const closures = [...day.closures, closureOf(rule, rule.window ?? WHOLE_DAY)];
      if (rule.window) return { ...day, closures };
      switch (rule.targetKind) {
        case "venue":
          return { ...day, closures, services: [] };
        case "service":
          return {
            ...day,
            closures,
            services: day.services.filter((s) => s.venueServiceId !== rule.venueServiceId),
          };
        case "booking":
          return { ...day, closures, bookingOpen: closeBookingTypes(day.bookingOpen, rule) };
        case "tables":
          return { ...day, closures };
      }
    }
    function closeEarly(service: ResolvedService, closeAt: number): ResolvedService[] {
      if (service.opensAt >= closeAt) return [];
      return [
        {
          ...service,
          lastSeatingAt: Math.min(service.lastSeatingAt, closeAt),
          closesAt: Math.min(service.closesAt, closeAt),
        },
      ];
    }
    function applyTonight(day: ResolvedDaySummary, rule: RuleOf<"tonight">): ResolvedDaySummary {
      const { payload } = rule;
      if ("closeAt" in payload) {
        // Closing early is about services: a venue rule closes them all, a service
        // rule closes its own, and booking or table targets have no hours to cut.
        if (rule.targetKind !== "venue" && rule.targetKind !== "service") return day;
        const targeted = (s: ResolvedService) =>
          rule.targetKind === "venue" || s.venueServiceId === rule.venueServiceId;
        return {
          ...day,
          services: day.services.flatMap((s) => (targeted(s) ? closeEarly(s, payload.closeAt) : [s])),
        };
      }
      if ("stop" in payload) {
        return { ...day, closures: [...day.closures, closureOf(rule, payload.stop)] };
      }
      return {
        ...day,
        pacingCovers: Math.min(day.pacingCovers ?? Infinity, payload.pacing.covers),
      };
    }
    function withMessage(day: ResolvedDaySummary, rule: DateRule): ResolvedDaySummary {
      return rule.guestMessage ? { ...day, guestMessage: rule.guestMessage } : day;
    }
    function resolveLayers(config: AvailabilityConfig, serviceDate: ServiceDate): Resolution {
      const schedules = new Map(config.schedules.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
      const venueServices = new Map(
        config.venueServices.filter((v) => !v.archivedAt).map((v) => [v.id, v])
      );
      const rules = activeRules(config.dateRules, serviceDate);
      const servicesOf = (scheduleId: string | null) =>
        liveServices(
          config.scheduleServices.filter((s) => s.scheduleId === scheduleId),
          venueServices
        );
      const skippedLabel = (skip: DateRule) => {
        const series = config.dateRules.find((r) => r.id === skip.seriesId);
        return series ? `Skipped from: ${seriesLabel(series, serviceName(series))}` : "Skipped date";
      };
      const scheduleName = (id: string) => schedules.get(id)?.name ?? "Schedule";
    
      const assignment = assignmentFor(config, serviceDate);
      const useSchedule = ofKind(rules, "use_schedule")
        .filter((r) => schedules.get(r.useScheduleId)?.archivedAt == null)
        .at(-1);
      const scheduleId = useSchedule?.useScheduleId ?? assignment?.scheduleId ?? null;
      const special = ofKind(rules, "special_hours").at(-1);
      const services = special
        ? liveServices(special.payload.services, venueServices)
        : servicesOf(scheduleId);
      const closures = ofKind(rules, "closure");
      const tonights = ofKind(rules, "tonight");
      const serviceName = (rule: DateRule) =>
        rule.venueServiceId ? venueServices.get(rule.venueServiceId)?.name : undefined;
    
      const base: ResolvedDaySummary = {
        serviceDate,
        scheduleId,
        services,
        closures: [],
        bookingOpen: ALL_OPEN,
      };
      const afterClosures = closures.reduce(
        (day, rule) => withMessage(applyClosure(day, rule), rule),
        special ? withMessage(base, special) : base
      );
      const day = tonights.reduce((d, rule) => withMessage(applyTonight(d, rule), rule), afterClosures);
    
      const layers: PendingLayer[] = [
        ...(assignment
          ? [
              {
                kind: "schedule" as const,
                id: assignment.id,
                label: scheduleName(assignment.scheduleId),
                effect: hoursEffect(servicesOf(assignment.scheduleId)),
              },
            ]
          : []),
        ...(useSchedule
          ? [
              {
                kind: "use_schedule" as const,
                id: useSchedule.id,
                label: `Use ${scheduleName(useSchedule.useScheduleId)}`,
                effect: hoursEffect(servicesOf(useSchedule.useScheduleId)),
              },
            ]
          : []),
        ...(special
          ? [
              {
                kind: "special_hours" as const,
                id: special.id,
                label: "Special hours",
                effect: hoursEffect(services),
              },
            ]
          : []),
        ...ofKind(rules, "skip").map((r) => ({
          kind: "skip" as const,
          id: r.id,
          label: skippedLabel(r),
          effect: "Bookable as usual",
        })),
        ...closures.map((r) => ({
          kind: "closure" as const,
          id: r.id,
          label: targetLabel(r, serviceName(r)),
          effect: windowEffect(r),
        })),
        ...tonights.map((r) => ({
          kind: "tonight" as const,
          id: r.id,
          label: "Tonight",
          effect: tonightEffect(r),
        })),
      ];
    
      return { day, layers };
    }
    function withoutRow(config: AvailabilityConfig, id: string): AvailabilityConfig {
      return {
        ...config,
        assignments: config.assignments.filter((a) => a.id !== id),
        dateRules: config.dateRules.filter((r) => r.id !== id),
      };
    }
    export function resolveDay(snapshot: AvailabilitySnapshot, serviceDate: ServiceDate): ResolvedDay {
      const { config } = snapshot;
      const { day, layers } = resolveLayers(config, serviceDate);
      return {
        ...day,
        explanation: layers.map((layer) => ({
          ...layer,
          removalResult: resolveLayers(withoutRow(config, layer.id), serviceDate).day,
        })),
      };
    }

    export const DEFAULT_SLOT_INTERVAL = 15;
    export type EngineSettings = Pick<
      VenueSettings,
      | "durationRules"
      | "defaultReservationDuration"
      | "pacingRules"
      | "slotIntervalMinutes"
      | "maxPartySize"
    >;
    export interface TableFilter {
      id: string;
      capacity: number;
      minCovers: number;
      maxCovers: number | null;
      isActive: boolean;
    }
    export interface TableCandidate {
      id: string;
      capacity: number;
      priority: number;
    }
    export interface ReservationSlim {
      id: string;
      tableId: string;
      startTime: Date;
      endTime: Date;
      partySize: number;
    }
    export interface HoldSlim {
      id: string;
      tableId: string;
      startTime: Date;
      endTime: Date;
      partySize: number;
      expiresAt: Date;
    }
    type DateThreshold = { lt: Date } | { gt: Date };
    function passesThreshold(value: Date, threshold: DateThreshold): boolean {
      return "lt" in threshold ? value < threshold.lt : value > threshold.gt;
    }
    export function estimateDuration(partySize: number, settings?: EngineSettings | null): number {
      const rules = settings?.durationRules ?? DEFAULT_DURATION_RULES;
      const rule = rules.find((r) => partySize >= r.minPartySize && partySize <= r.maxPartySize);
    
      if (rule) return rule.durationMinutes;
    
      if (settings?.defaultReservationDuration) {
        return settings.defaultReservationDuration;
      }
    
      const largestRule = rules.reduce((max, r) => (r.maxPartySize > max.maxPartySize ? r : max));
      const extraGuests = partySize - largestRule.maxPartySize;
      const extraTime = Math.ceil(extraGuests / 2) * 15;
      return largestRule.durationMinutes + extraTime;
    }
    export function filterSuitableTables<T extends TableFilter>(tables: T[], partySize: number): T[] {
      return tables.filter((t) => t.isActive && partyFitsTable(t, partySize));
    }
    export function overlapWindow(
      startTime: Date,
      endTime: Date
    ): { startTime: DateThreshold; endTime: DateThreshold } {
      return {
        startTime: { lt: endTime },
        endTime: { gt: startTime },
      };
    }
    export function activeHoldWindow(now: Date): DateThreshold {
      return { gt: now };
    }
    export function checkTableConflict(
      tableId: string,
      startTime: Date,
      endTime: Date,
      reservations: readonly ReservationSlim[],
      holds: readonly HoldSlim[],
      now: Date
    ): boolean {
      const window = overlapWindow(startTime, endTime);
    
      const hasReservationConflict = reservations.some(
        (r) =>
          r.tableId === tableId &&
          passesThreshold(r.startTime, window.startTime) &&
          passesThreshold(r.endTime, window.endTime)
      );
    
      if (hasReservationConflict) return true;
    
      const activeWindow = activeHoldWindow(now);
      return holds.some(
        (h) =>
          h.tableId === tableId &&
          passesThreshold(h.expiresAt, activeWindow) &&
          passesThreshold(h.startTime, window.startTime) &&
          passesThreshold(h.endTime, window.endTime)
      );
    }
    export function checkPacingForSlot(
      startTime: Date,
      partySize: number,
      settings: EngineSettings | null | undefined,
      reservations: readonly ReservationSlim[],
      holds: readonly HoldSlim[],
      now: Date,
      coverCap?: number
    ): boolean {
      const rule = settings?.pacingRules?.[0];
      const cap = Math.min(rule?.maxCoversPerSlot ?? Infinity, coverCap ?? Infinity);
      if (cap === Infinity) return true;
    
      const windowMinutes =
        rule?.timeWindowMinutes ?? settings?.slotIntervalMinutes ?? DEFAULT_SLOT_INTERVAL;
      const windowEnd = new Date(startTime.getTime() + windowMinutes * MS_PER_MINUTE);
      const inWindow = (s: { startTime: Date }) => s.startTime >= startTime && s.startTime < windowEnd;
    
      const reservationCovers = reservations.filter(inWindow).reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.partySize, 0);
      const holdCovers = holds
        .filter((h) => h.expiresAt > now && inWindow(h))
        .reduce((sum, h) => sum + h.partySize, 0);
    
      return reservationCovers + holdCovers + partySize <= cap;
    }
    export function selectBestTable<T extends TableCandidate>(
      candidates: readonly T[],
      startTime: Date,
      endTime: Date,
      reservations: readonly ReservationSlim[],
      holds: readonly HoldSlim[],
      now: Date
    ): T | null {
      return (
        candidates.find(
          (table) => !checkTableConflict(table.id, startTime, endTime, reservations, holds, now)
        ) ?? null
      );
    }

  <file path="packages/availability/src/slots.ts">
    export type BookingChannel = "online" | "phone";
    export interface EngineTable extends TableFilter {
      name: string;
      priority: number;
    }
    export interface BookingSnapshot extends AvailabilitySnapshot {
      tables: EngineTable[];
      /** Non-cancelled reservations for the range, ±1 day. */
      reservations: ReservationSlim[];
      holds: HoldSlim[];
      settings: EngineSettings | null;
    }
    export interface Slot {
      start: Date;
      serviceDate: ServiceDate;
      /** Minutes past the service day's midnight; may exceed 1440. */
      minute: number;
      venueServiceId: string;
      /** Suitable tables that are free and not blocked, in snapshot order. */
      tables: EngineTable[];
      available: boolean;
      reason?: "no_table" | "pacing";
    }
    export type SoftLimit = "after_last_seating" | "pacing" | "party_size";
    export type HardReason =
      "closed" | "booking_closed" | "outside_service" | "table_blocked" | "conflict";
    export type Verdict =
      | { kind: "ok" }
      | { kind: "ok_with_override"; limits: SoftLimit[] }
      | { kind: "soft"; limits: SoftLimit[] }
      | { kind: "hard"; reason: HardReason; message?: string };
    export interface BookingRequest {
      start: Date;
      partySize: number;
      channel: BookingChannel;
      tableId?: string;
      /** The booking's real end; without it the estimated duration for the party size is used. */
      end?: Date;
      override?: { reason: string };
    }
    function seatingMinutes(service: ResolvedService): number[] {
      const { opensAt, lastSeatingAt, closesAt, seating } = service;
      const bookable = (m: number) => m >= opensAt && m <= lastSeatingAt && m < closesAt;
      if ("interval" in seating) {
        const count = Math.floor((lastSeatingAt - opensAt) / seating.interval) + 1;
        return Array.from(
          { length: Math.max(count, 0) },
          (_, k) => opensAt + k * seating.interval
        ).filter(bookable);
      }
      return [...new Set(seating.fixed)].filter(bookable).sort((a, b) => a - b);
    }
    function inBand(band: ResolvedClosure, minute: number): boolean {
      return band.from <= minute && minute < band.to;
    }
    function closesSeating(
      band: ResolvedClosure,
      minute: number,
      venueServiceId: string,
      channel: BookingChannel
    ): boolean {
      if (!inBand(band, minute)) return false;
      switch (band.targetKind) {
        case "venue":
          return true;
        case "service":
          return band.venueServiceId === venueServiceId;
        case "booking":
          return (band.bookingTypes ?? []).includes(channel);
        case "tables":
          return false;
      }
    }
    function blockedTables(day: ResolvedDaySummary, minute: number): Set<string> {
      return new Set(
        day.closures
          .filter((b) => b.targetKind === "tables" && inBand(b, minute))
          .flatMap((b) => b.tableIds ?? [])
      );
    }
    function freeTables(
      snapshot: BookingSnapshot,
      day: ResolvedDaySummary,
      minute: number,
      partySize: number,
      start: Date,
      now: Date,
      requestedEnd?: Date
    ): EngineTable[] {
      const end =
        requestedEnd ??
        new Date(start.getTime() + estimateDuration(partySize, snapshot.settings) * MS_PER_MINUTE);
      const blocked = blockedTables(day, minute);
      return filterSuitableTables(snapshot.tables, partySize).filter(
        (t) =>
          !blocked.has(t.id) &&
          !checkTableConflict(t.id, start, end, snapshot.reservations, snapshot.holds, now)
      );
    }
    function pacingOk(
      snapshot: BookingSnapshot,
      day: ResolvedDaySummary,
      start: Date,
      partySize: number,
      now: Date
    ): boolean {
      return checkPacingForSlot(
        start,
        partySize,
        snapshot.settings,
        snapshot.reservations,
        snapshot.holds,
        now,
        day.pacingCovers
      );
    }
    export function listSlots(
      snapshot: BookingSnapshot,
      serviceDate: ServiceDate,
      partySize: number,
      channel: BookingChannel,
      now: Date
    ): Slot[] {
      const day = resolveDay(snapshot, serviceDate);
      if (!day.bookingOpen[channel]) return [];
      return day.services
        .filter((service) => service.bookingTypes.includes(channel))
        .flatMap((service) =>
          seatingMinutes(service).flatMap((minute): Slot[] => {
            if (day.closures.some((b) => closesSeating(b, minute, service.venueServiceId, channel))) {
              return [];
            }
            const start = serviceDayInstant(serviceDate, minute, snapshot.timezone);
            if (!start) return [];
            const tables = freeTables(snapshot, day, minute, partySize, start, now);
            const paced = pacingOk(snapshot, day, start, partySize, now);
            return [
              {
                start,
                serviceDate,
                minute,
                venueServiceId: service.venueServiceId,
                tables,
                available: tables.length > 0 && paced,
                ...(tables.length === 0 ? { reason: "no_table" as const } : {}),
                ...(tables.length > 0 && !paced ? { reason: "pacing" as const } : {}),
              },
            ];
          })
        );
    }
    function plannedDay(snapshot: AvailabilitySnapshot, serviceDate: ServiceDate) {
      const dateRules = snapshot.config.dateRules.filter(
        (r) => r.kind !== "closure" && r.kind !== "tonight"
      );
      return resolveDay({ ...snapshot, config: { ...snapshot.config, dateRules } }, serviceDate);
    }
    function owningServiceDay(snapshot: AvailabilitySnapshot, start: Date) {
      const local = localDateTimeOf(start, snapshot.timezone);
      const candidates = [
        { serviceDate: local.date, minute: local.minute },
        { serviceDate: addDays(local.date, -1), minute: local.minute + MINUTES_PER_DAY },
      ];
      return candidates.flatMap(({ serviceDate, minute }) => {
        const planned = plannedDay(snapshot, serviceDate).services.find(containing(minute));
        return planned ? [{ serviceDate, minute, planned }] : [];
      })[0];
    }
    function hard(reason: HardReason, message?: string): Verdict {
      return message ? { kind: "hard", reason, message } : { kind: "hard", reason };
    }
    function tableVerdict(
      snapshot: BookingSnapshot,
      day: ResolvedDaySummary,
      minute: number,
      request: BookingRequest,
      now: Date
    ): Verdict | null {
      const free = freeTables(
        snapshot,
        day,
        minute,
        request.partySize,
        request.start,
        now,
        request.end
      );
      if (request.tableId === undefined) return free.length > 0 ? null : hard("conflict");
      if (blockedTables(day, minute).has(request.tableId)) return hard("table_blocked");
      return free.some((t) => t.id === request.tableId) ? null : hard("conflict");
    }
    function softLimits(
      snapshot: BookingSnapshot,
      day: ResolvedDaySummary,
      service: ResolvedService,
      minute: number,
      request: BookingRequest,
      now: Date
    ): SoftLimit[] {
      const maxParty = snapshot.settings?.maxPartySize;
      return [
        ...(minute > service.lastSeatingAt ? ["after_last_seating" as const] : []),
        ...(pacingOk(snapshot, day, request.start, request.partySize, now) ? [] : ["pacing" as const]),
        ...(maxParty !== undefined && request.partySize > maxParty ? ["party_size" as const] : []),
      ];
    }
    export function judge(snapshot: BookingSnapshot, request: BookingRequest, now: Date): Verdict {
      const owner = owningServiceDay(snapshot, request.start);
      if (!owner) return hard("outside_service");
      const { serviceDate, minute, planned } = owner;
      const day = resolveDay(snapshot, serviceDate);
      const message = day.guestMessage;
    
      const band = day.closures.find((b) =>
        closesSeating(b, minute, planned.venueServiceId, request.channel)
      );
      if (band) return hard(band.targetKind === "booking" ? "booking_closed" : "closed", message);
      if (!day.bookingOpen[request.channel]) return hard("booking_closed", message);
      const service = day.services
        .filter((s) => s.venueServiceId === planned.venueServiceId)
        .find(containing(minute));
      if (!service) return hard("closed", message);
      if (!service.bookingTypes.includes(request.channel)) return hard("booking_closed", message);
    
      const tableIssue = tableVerdict(snapshot, day, minute, request, now);
      if (tableIssue) return tableIssue;
    
      const limits = softLimits(snapshot, day, service, minute, request, now);
      if (limits.length === 0) return { kind: "ok" };
      const overridden = request.channel === "phone" && (request.override?.reason.trim() ?? "") !== "";
      return overridden ? { kind: "ok_with_override", limits } : { kind: "soft", limits };
    }

    export type ConfigIssueCode =
      | "invalid"
      | "overlap"
      | "close_before_open"
      | "last_seating_after_close"
      | "last_seating_before_open"
      | "multiple_regular_schedules"
      | "no_regular_schedule"
      | "precedence_tie"
      | "ends_before_start"
      | "seating_outside_service"
      | "window_ends_before_start"
      | "booking_types_required";
    export interface ConfigIssue {
      /** e.g. `scheduleServices[1].lastSeatingAt`; `""` is the whole config. */
      path: string;
      code: ConfigIssueCode;
      message: string;
    }
    type ServiceHours = Pick<SpecialHoursService, "opensAt" | "lastSeatingAt" | "closesAt" | "seating">;
    interface PathedService {
      path: string;
      hours: ServiceHours;
    }
    function issue(path: string, code: ConfigIssueCode, message: string): ConfigIssue {
      return { path, code, message };
    }
    function formatPath(segments: readonly PropertyKey[]): string {
      return segments
        .map((s, i) => (typeof s === "number" ? `[${s}]` : `${i === 0 ? "" : "."}${String(s)}`))
        .join("");
    }
    function fixedSeatingIssues({ path, hours }: PathedService): ConfigIssue[] {
      if (!("fixed" in hours.seating)) return [];
      return hours.seating.fixed.flatMap((minute, k) =>
        minute < hours.opensAt || minute > hours.lastSeatingAt
          ? [
              issue(
                `${path}.seating.fixed[${k}]`,
                "seating_outside_service",
                "Seating times must fall between opening and last seating."
              ),
            ]
          : []
      );
    }
    function hoursIssues({ path, hours }: PathedService): ConfigIssue[] {
      const { opensAt, lastSeatingAt, closesAt } = hours;
      if (closesAt <= opensAt) {
        return [issue(`${path}.closesAt`, "close_before_open", "Closing time must be after opening.")];
      }
      if (lastSeatingAt > closesAt) {
        return [
          issue(
            `${path}.lastSeatingAt`,
            "last_seating_after_close",
            "Last seating can't be after closing."
          ),
        ];
      }
      if (lastSeatingAt < opensAt) {
        return [
          issue(
            `${path}.lastSeatingAt`,
            "last_seating_before_open",
            "Last seating can't be before opening."
          ),
        ];
      }
      return fixedSeatingIssues({ path, hours });
    }
    function overlapIssues(services: readonly PathedService[]): ConfigIssue[] {
      const sorted = services
        .filter(({ hours }) => hours.closesAt > hours.opensAt)
        .sort((a, b) => a.hours.opensAt - b.hours.opensAt);
      return sorted.flatMap((later, i) => {
        const earlier = sorted.slice(0, i).find((e) => e.hours.closesAt > later.hours.opensAt);
        if (!earlier) return [];
        const range = `${formatMinute(earlier.hours.opensAt)} – ${formatMinute(earlier.hours.closesAt)}`;
        return [issue(`${later.path}.opensAt`, "overlap", `Overlaps another service (${range}).`)];
      });
    }
    function serviceListIssues(services: readonly PathedService[]): ConfigIssue[] {
      return [...services.flatMap(hoursIssues), ...overlapIssues(services)];
    }
    function scheduleServiceIssues(config: AvailabilityConfig): ConfigIssue[] {
      const pathed = config.scheduleServices.map((s, i) => ({
        scheduleId: s.scheduleId,
        path: `scheduleServices[${i}]`,
        hours: s,
      }));
      const scheduleIds = [...new Set(pathed.map((s) => s.scheduleId))];
      return scheduleIds.flatMap((id) => serviceListIssues(pathed.filter((s) => s.scheduleId === id)));
    }
    function specialHoursIssues(config: AvailabilityConfig): ConfigIssue[] {
      return config.dateRules.flatMap((rule, i) =>
        rule.kind === "special_hours"
          ? serviceListIssues(
              rule.payload.services.map((s, j) => ({
                path: `dateRules[${i}].payload.services[${j}]`,
                hours: s,
              }))
            )
          : []
      );
    }
    function regularScheduleIssues(config: AvailabilityConfig): ConfigIssue[] {
      const regular = config.schedules
        .map((s, i) => ({ s, i }))
        .filter(({ s }) => s.isRegular && !s.archivedAt);
      if (regular.length === 0) {
        return [issue("schedules", "no_regular_schedule", "Choose one schedule as the regular week.")];
      }
      return regular
        .slice(1)
        .map(({ i }) =>
          issue(
            `schedules[${i}].isRegular`,
            "multiple_regular_schedules",
            "Only one schedule can be the regular week."
          )
        );
    }
    function endsBeforeStart(
      startsOn: string | null | undefined,
      endsOn: string | null | undefined
    ): boolean {
      return startsOn != null && endsOn != null && endsOn < startsOn;
    }
    function rangeIssues(config: AvailabilityConfig): ConfigIssue[] {
      const message = "The end date can't be before the start date.";
      return [
        ...config.assignments.flatMap((a, i) =>
          endsBeforeStart(a.startsOn, a.endsOn)
            ? [issue(`assignments[${i}].endsOn`, "ends_before_start", message)]
            : []
        ),
        ...config.dateRules.flatMap((r, i) =>
          endsBeforeStart(r.startsOn, r.endsOn)
            ? [issue(`dateRules[${i}].endsOn`, "ends_before_start", message)]
            : []
        ),
      ];
    }
    function latest(a?: string | null, b?: string | null): string | null {
      if (a == null) return b ?? null;
      return b == null || a > b ? a : b;
    }
    function earliest(a?: string | null, b?: string | null): string | null {
      if (a == null) return b ?? null;
      return b == null || a < b ? a : b;
    }
    function assignmentsMeet(a: ScheduleAssignment, b: ScheduleAssignment): boolean {
      const shared = a.weekdays.filter((d) => b.weekdays.includes(d));
      // Open ends are unbounded; "YYYY-MM-DD" strings order chronologically.
      const from = latest(a.startsOn, b.startsOn);
      const to = earliest(a.endsOn, b.endsOn);
      if (shared.length === 0 || (from != null && to != null && from > to)) return false;
      if (from == null || to == null || addDays(from, 6) <= to) return true;
      // A common range shorter than a week may miss every shared weekday.
      const dates = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => addDays(from, i)).filter((d) => d <= to);
      return dates.some((d) => shared.includes(weekdayIndexOf(d)));
    }
    function precedenceIssues(config: AvailabilityConfig): ConfigIssue[] {
      const { assignments } = config;
      return assignments.flatMap((later, j) =>
        assignments
          .slice(0, j)
          .some((earlier) => earlier.precedence === later.precedence && assignmentsMeet(earlier, later))
          ? [
              issue(
                `assignments[${j}].precedence`,
                "precedence_tie",
                "Two assignments cover the same day; choose which one wins."
              ),
            ]
          : []
      );
    }
    function windowIssues(config: AvailabilityConfig): ConfigIssue[] {
      const message = "The end time must be after the start time.";
      return config.dateRules.flatMap((rule, i) => [
        ...(rule.window && rule.window.to <= rule.window.from
          ? [issue(`dateRules[${i}].window.to`, "window_ends_before_start", message)]
          : []),
        ...(rule.kind === "tonight" &&
        "stop" in rule.payload &&
        rule.payload.stop.to <= rule.payload.stop.from
          ? [issue(`dateRules[${i}].payload.stop.to`, "window_ends_before_start", message)]
          : []),
      ]);
    }
    function bookingTypesIssues(config: AvailabilityConfig): ConfigIssue[] {
      return config.dateRules.flatMap((rule, i) =>
        rule.targetKind === "booking" && !rule.bookingTypes?.length
          ? [
              issue(
                `dateRules[${i}].bookingTypes`,
                "booking_types_required",
                "Choose which booking types to close."
              ),
            ]
          : []
      );
    }
    export function validateConfig(input: unknown): ConfigIssue[] {
      const parsed = AvailabilityConfigSchema.safeParse(input);
      if (!parsed.success) {
        return parsed.error.issues.map((i) => issue(formatPath(i.path), "invalid", i.message));
      }
      const config = parsed.data;
      return [
        ...regularScheduleIssues(config),
        ...scheduleServiceIssues(config),
        ...specialHoursIssues(config),
        ...rangeIssues(config),
        ...precedenceIssues(config),
        ...windowIssues(config),
        ...bookingTypesIssues(config),
      ];
    }
